But ranch owner Logan Maury proves to be a more than formidable opponent. He'll stop at nothing, including murder, to turn the farmers' fields into grazing grounds for his cattle.

programme.title: The Man Behind the Gun
programme.desc: An Army major goes undercover to stop a dangerous plot to make Southern California a separate state, facing immense personal risk and complex challenges.

programme.title: Buchanan Rides Alone
programme.desc: Journeying from Mexico back home to West Texas, mercenary Tom Buchanan takes a break for the night in the border town of Agry. He soon discovers that almost every resident -- from the crooked sheriff to the shifty-eyed innkeeper -- is a member of the prominent Agry family. When Buchanan defends Juan de la Vega, a young man about to be lynched for shooting the town drunk, he himself is accused of murder and must struggle to escape town alive.

programme.title: Thunder Over the Plains
programme.desc: It's the late 1860s, and the U.S. government has yet to reclaim Texas as a state. A group of opportunistic and amoral Northerners head south to claim the territory as their own. Though Texas lawman Capt. Porter (Randolph Scott) believes it's his duty to honor the local leaders, he can't ignore the corruption of the Yankee politicians who are giving him orders. When Confederate veteran Ben (Charles McGraw) is unjustly sentenced to death, Porter decides he has had enough of his new bosses.

programme.title: Carson City

To do so, he'll need to employ the help of "Silent" Jeff Kincaid (Randolph Scott), the only man who can tunnel through the mountainous region. Unfortunately, Kincaid has more than just the mountains to deal with -- neither the locals nor the Champagne Bandits are happy about the new railway.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Jim Kipp (Randolph Scott) is a bounty hunter hired to find three robbers who committed a daring heist three years ago. When he arrives in a small town near the robbery, he senses that the thieves may be living there. However, many of the townspeople -- including Dr. Spencer (Harry Antrim), his daughter, Julie (Dolores Dorn), and barmaid Alice (Marie Windsor) -- are put on edge by Kipp's presence and want him gone. Kipp perseveres, hatching a plan that he thinks will draw out the bandits.

programme.title: Spec Miata Hammers Down at the Track
programme.desc: We show you painting tips on how to properly prep your aging clear coat for paint. Then we give our Mazda a fresh look before heading to the track to test those performance parts!

programme.title: Lifting Big with 8" BDS Coilover Conversion and 35" Tires
programme.desc: We jack up the '14 Silverado and add big wheels, tires, and brake upgrades.

programme.title: Stroking Our Favorite Big Blocks (and One Small Block) For More Power
programme.desc: There's no replacement for displacement! We stroke some of our favorite engines, looking for all the horsepower we can find.

programme.title: Dirt Oval Destroyer
programme.desc: The UNOH motor sports team pays a visit to Engine Power to build a race-ready small block to meet the new class rules at their local dirt track. The students help us put together a 434ci small block with 23 degree heads for the competitive stock car class. Once it's completed, we prove it's race-ready on the Dyno and look for big gains over their previous powerplants.

programme.title: Grandma's Beige Buick Regal Gets a Splash of Color
programme.desc: The '85 Buick is ready for some fit and finish with body work and candy paint.

programme.title: Why This Can Am Baja Bug Conversion Is So Retro Rad
programme.desc: Baja Style bug gets a 80's retro style paint job to go along with a long travel suspension before the Carcass team takes this incredible combo to Dirty Turtle Offroad Park. This is Part 3 of 3 of the BajAwesome build.

programme.title: Taking our '69 Camaro into the Modern Era
programme.desc: We take our '69 Camaro and upgrade the suspension, brakes and tires to give it better handling and performance on the street.

programme.title: Building a Man-Sized Go-Kart from a Junkyard Bound Chassis
programme.desc: The Carcass team revives a junkyard bound Buick Regal. The left for dead chassis gets a slew of guerrilla-style upgrades that triples the horsepower, improves the handling, and roasts some tires!

programme.title: Super Nova Swap
programme.desc: Drag Strip Swap - Tommy and Joel elevate the curb appeal of an old 1967 Chevy Nova race car, showing you how to swap out some shiny stuff, which includes new bumpers and trim, as well as beef up the fire suppression system to get it looking cool and staying cool.

programme.title: Transforming the VW Bug From Cool to Bajawesome
programme.desc: The Carcass duo adds a custom fit roll cage, fabricated louvers out back, and a whole bunch of style points to this baja style bug. This is part 2 of 3 of the BajAwesome build.

programme.title: Mopar Big Block and Transmission Drop
programme.desc: Today, our 1969 Dodge Dart, Project Bullseye, gets a major power upgrade. We also get our brakes lined out and connect all the steering linkage for total control. The icing on the cake, we paint the scooped hood and add our Swinger stripe.

programme.title: AMC Javelin Paint Goes From Boring To Bright Candy Apple Red
programme.desc: Our AMC Javelin gets a freshen-up in the paint department with some help from an old friend. We show you some simple and easy ways to make your paint look amazing.

programme.title: Extreme Diesel Rigs at Ultimate Callout Challenge
programme.desc: LT & Austin purchase a 2011 Sierra Denali HD, plus they are on the road in Indy for coverage of the Ultimate Callout Challenge.

programme.title: Turbo Tahoe 383 SBC : Part 2
programme.desc: We're putting the final touches on our turbocharged Gen 1 small block and prove you don't need big money to make big power. Once this dead reliable 383 is assembled, it hits the Dyno for NA power pulls before we add boost to Blacktop Speed Shop's pump-gas show stopper.

programme.title: G-Body Buck Regal Build, Checking Glass and Trim Off the List
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc give us some tips on painting trim and glass installation before our '85 Buick gets a new interior. Plus a Chevelle owner in need of a little rescuing.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 2 - Medical Checkup
programme.desc: The warden's calling for diagnostics for Detroit Muscle's next prisoner, their 1969 Pontiac GTO. They'll have to tear down and look inside the skeleton of this old muscle car before they fix it up.

programme.title: Taking A 1970 Mustang From Pony To Stallion
programme.desc: This 1970 Mustang will take a 50 year leap into the future, and we're building it to give away! EBC Brakes is teaming up with Detroit Muscle to turn this pony car into a stallion.

programme.title: Boosted 4.3L V6 Makes Over 500 lb-ft On The Dyno!
programme.desc: We crank up the power on our old-school GM 4.3L V6 with some turbocharged forced induction.

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 2
programme.desc: We're getting our Coyote engine and transmission installed in our 2002 Ford Ranger!

programme.title: Building Up a New 6.4L Gen III HEMI For Reliable Muscle Car Power
programme.desc: Starting with a bare block, we build a piece of big modern Mopar muscle! Complete with a Holley High-Ram Intake and Terminator X Max Fuel Injection, we get a big jump in power that's dyno proven!

programme.title: How To Choose A Square Body
programme.desc: We're at Stovalls collision and wrecking service searching through their private inventory for our next project. We're after a 4 wheel drive square body.

programme.title: EBC Mustang Gets a New Suspension, Wheels, and Tires
programme.desc: Our EBC Mustang Sweepstakes car gets all new suspension, wheels and tires, as well as an upgraded brake and rotor package. Then we take it out for a little testing and some fun!

programme.title: 509ci W-Series Big Block Chevy Part 2
programme.desc: We continue the buildup of our 509ci W-Series engine as we get it ready to hit the engine dyno. We wrap up this vintage looking hot rod power plant with high flowing induction and throttle body EFI before we see how much power it makes in the dyno.

programme.title: The Great Intake Debate: Dual Vs. Single Plane Intake Manifolds
programme.desc: We test multiple configurations of our V8 to see what makes the biggest difference on the engine dyno.

programme.title: Triple Threat Completion
programme.desc: It's down to the wire, as we ready our Camaro race car for the track.

programme.title: Solid Roller 318 LA
programme.desc: Our 318 Mopar is back AGAIN, so we can take it to the next level! This already stout small block gets a solid roller camshaft and a single plane intake to crank up the RPM and turn up the horsepower.

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 2 Chassis Chaos
programme.desc: The OBS Chevy is in the shop to mock up it's new suspension. We'll have to make a few modifications to the spring pockets before installing our front suspension. In the rear we'll address frame issues before we can add a c-notch to get our rear suspension in place before our chassis heads out to poweder coat.

programme.title: Brake the Pavement
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes and Pedal Commander Dodge Charger gets its final touches on brakes and cosmetics before hitting the track.

programme.title: Bedtime
programme.desc: It's bedtime! Today, Eric and Joel are laying down the freshly painted back end on our 1993 Dodge W350-Project Nightshift. We'll address the fuel system and core support, and slap on an all-new exhaust, getting us one step closer to the finish line.

programme.title: Turn The Volume Up For The AMC Javelin's New Set Of Side Pipes
programme.desc: Javelin gets a new sick sound with a set of side pipes, before hitting the road for a little fun.

programme.title: SCCA SPEC Mustang Part 1
programme.desc: Engine Power embarks on a new project for SCCA's inaugural SPEC Mustang class. We'll take a 2008 Mustang GT and begin getting it ready for this entry level, but competitive class.

programme.title: 505ci Monster Mopar
programme.desc: A big block legend returns, as Pat and Frankie from Engine Power bring their 505ci RB Mopar out of the moth balls and into the shop for a few upgrades in the search for more power! With some well-placed parts changes and a complete color makeover, they will get this pump gas beast ready to slip between the frame rails of a worthy hotrod.

programme.title: Project Leadfoot Gets a New Heart
programme.desc: Chris and Eric team up to tackle the monumental task of finally installing the 600 horsepower Ford 460 Big Block into Project Leadfoot with a brand new Tremec TR4050 transmission.

programme.title: One-of-a-Kind Cadillac Becomes a Chameleon!
programme.desc: The finish line is in sight! The Blacktop Speed Shop crew is putting the final touches on one of the rarest wagons ever built. Color-shift wrap, custom lighting, and a racing simulator we can haul in a trailer. SEMA, here we come!

programme.desc: A marriage made in heaven - Our Fat Stack Caprice gets reunited with our updated chassis. Then it gets lined out with a new fuel system to ensure this LS can handle all of the horsepower of this heavy Chevy.

programme.desc: Rust Revival - Brian and Joel are back in the shop with their sleeves rolled up and ready to bust the rust in their Chevy 210, Project Shell Shock. Watch as they cut, fit, and weld fresh floor pans into place, to help give this classic a solid foundation inside and out. Then it's full steam ahead as the guys strip Shell Shock down to bare metal, prepping every inch for a new paint job.

programme.title: Retro Hurst Olds Exterior Gets Restored Back To Its Showroom Finish - Part 2

programme.title: Prison Tats

programme.title: Installing a Mustang Foxbody Wing

programme.title: OEM Ford F-100 Suspension Swap
programme.desc: Shockingly, a sixty-year-old suspension needs replacing. So, Eric and Joel kick it old school with some OEM parts for Clint Black's 1960 Ford F-100.

programme.title: Dirty JL
programme.desc: We're on the trail! We are taking our Jeep JL to Burning Rock Off Road park, and the Hatfield McCoy Trail system in West Virginia to see just how dirty our Jeep can get!

programme.title: The Falcon Ford Should Have Built

We didn't pick this car for its engine though...we picked it because we are going to improve everything you wish it had, turning it into the Falcon Ford should have built. First thing we've got to do is see if those dismal dyno numbers are true.

programme.title: Valvoline Camaro Part 1
programme.desc: A 2017 Camaro SS is upgraded to be given away to one lucky viewer.

programme.title: Will There Be A Big Power Difference On A Mildly Modded AMC 258 Straight 6?
programme.desc: What started as a simple "aerosol overhaul" for a Postal Jeep's powerplant gets a little more complicated!

programme.title: Over 13:1 on Pump Gas! Chevy 350 Dyno Mule - Part 2

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger: Headers & Shocks
programme.desc: Cagetube, Rollcage, Shock loops and more, our Prerunner Ranger is getting custom headers and long travel shocks.

programme.title: Engine Powers' Favorite Dyno Days

programme.title: 2011 Diesel Denali Gets Lowered

programme.title: Junkyard Ford 390 FE Teardown

programme.desc: Does a '15 F150 Ford EcoBoost stand a chance against a '05 Dodge Ram SRT-10? It's a head-to-head build-off that starts with a track and dyno baseline. Let the tear down begin!

programme.title: Memorial

programme.desc: As Tommy and Peyton resume work on their 1966 Chevy Nova, they suddenly learn that this project may go from Starstruck to Struck Out. With that, they switch gears into another historic muscle car, 1969 Pontiac GTO.

programme.desc: History is full of miracle cures, far-fetched products, and astonishing feats, but not all of them are legitimate; a miracle snake oil that cures all? These are the stories of some of history's most spectacular cons, each deception more unbelievable than the last.

programme.title: Weird Discoveries

programme.title: Curious Crimes
programme.desc: A robber successfully snatching Einstein's brain; a thief who makes out with hundreds of dollars all while dressed as Santa Claus; these are some of history's most curious crimes.

programme.title: Abaddon
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: The Grid
programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.title: Revival
programme.desc: A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

programme.title: Gettysburg
programme.desc: Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future...but the future of the country as well.

programme.title: Something About Harry
programme.desc: A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission...a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

programme.title: Zig Zag
programme.desc: An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

programme.title: Nest
programme.desc: When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

programme.title: Final Appeal (Part 1)
programme.desc: Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

programme.title: Family Values
programme.desc: An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

programme.title: Patient Zero
programme.desc: A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

programme.title: A New Life
programme.desc: A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

programme.title: The Surrogate
programme.desc: Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

programme.title: The Vessel
programme.desc: The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Mona Lisa
programme.desc: Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

programme.title: Replica
programme.desc: A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

programme.title: Think Like A Dinosaur
programme.desc: A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

programme.title: Alien Shop
programme.desc: An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

programme.title: Worlds Within
programme.desc: A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

programme.title: In The Blood
programme.desc: A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

programme.title: Flower Child
programme.desc: When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

programme.title: Free Spirit
programme.desc: After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another...and is after her.

programme.title: Mindreacher
programme.desc: In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

programme.title: Time To Time
programme.desc: A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

programme.title: Rule Of Law
programme.desc: A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

programme.title: Lion's Den
programme.desc: A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning...but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

programme.title: The Tipping Point
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination

programme.title: Dark Child
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: The Human Factor
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right...

programme.title: Human Trials
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Sandkings (Parts One and Two)
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits."

programme.title: Valerie 23
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: The Second Soul
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: White Light Fever
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Virtual Future
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Living Hell
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Corner Of The Eye
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Under The Bed
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Dark Matters
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: The Conversion
programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: Quality Of Mercy
programme.desc: On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

programme.title: Caught In The Act
programme.desc: Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

programme.title: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

programme.title: The New Breed
programme.desc: To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

programme.title: The Message
programme.desc: Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something...from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: I, Robot
programme.desc: When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

programme.title: If These Walls Could Talk
programme.desc: Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of a haunted house and a senseless death?

programme.title: Birthright
programme.desc: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

programme.title: Voice Of Reason
programme.desc: Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

programme.title: A Stitch In Time
programme.desc: FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.title: Unnatural Selection
programme.desc: Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: I Hear You Calling
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.title: Mind Over Matter
programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.title: Beyond The Veil
programme.desc: After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

programme.title: First Anniversary
programme.desc: As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

programme.title: Straight And Narrow
programme.desc: Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

programme.title: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: On the first day of his presidency, Charles Halsey (Robert Foxworth) is faced with the first galactic foreign policy decision. As aliens are approaching Earth, the peace-loving president must determine if they are invaders or benevolent explorers.

programme.title: Worlds Apart
programme.desc: In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

programme.title: The Refuge
programme.desc: A man (James Wilder) finds himself in what seems to be a refuge in a post-apocalyptic world, lorded over by a sadistic industrialist (M. Emmet Walsh) who pits his guests against one another for enjoyment...but all is not what it seems to be.

programme.title: Inconstant Moon
programme.desc: When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

programme.title: From Within
programme.desc: Howie (Neil Patrick Harris), a boy with intellectual disabilities, is the last unaffected person in a town overrun by a strange, parasitic madness. On his own for the first time, Howie has only himself to rely upon if he wants to save his sister!

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: After a friend's betrayal cost him his Army career, Lee Taylor (Costas Mandylor) helps a self-styled militia Major hijack an Army shipment. Expecting missiles, they find a mysterious cargo and a lone Army Guard who warns of its deadly capability.

programme.title: Afterlife
programme.desc: Convicted of a murder he didn't commit, Linden Stiles can either accept execution or become the subject of a military experiment. Choosing to live, he finds himself slowly dehumanized by the alien DNA that has been injected into him.

programme.title: The Deprogrammers
programme.desc: With Earth under alien rule, humanity has been programmed into slavery. A band of rebels kidnap Evan (Erich Anderson), one of the alien leader's slaves. After a twist of fate, Evan agrees to assassinate his former master...with devastating results.

programme.title: Paradise
programme.desc: When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

programme.title: The Light Brigade
programme.desc: On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

programme.title: Window Of Opportunity
programme.desc: O'Neill and Teal'c find themselves repeating the same day over and over again.

programme.title: Watergate
programme.desc: SG-1 joins forces with a Russian scientist to investigate a rogue Stargate in Siberia.

programme.title: The First Ones
programme.desc: During an archaeological survey of fossils on a Goa'uld planet, Daniel is abducted by a fearsome creature.

programme.title: Scorched Earth
programme.desc: SG-1 must stop aliens from incinerating the surface of a safe planet, along with all its new inhabitants.

programme.title: Beneath The Surface
programme.desc: With memories erased, SG-1 find themselves trapped below a domed city on a planet of ice, toiling as laborers.

programme.title: Point Of No Return
programme.desc: A quirky conspiracy theorist contacts SG-1 claiming to know classified information about the Stargate.

programme.title: Tangent
programme.desc: O'Neill and Teal'c take a modified Goa'uld glider out for a test flight, and are sucked into outer space.

programme.title: The Curse

programme.title: The Serpent's Venom

A decade in the future, Earth's alliance with a highly intelligent race of aliens has rendered SGC obsolete.

programme.title: Absolute Power

programme.title: The Light
programme.desc: SG-1 travels to a planet to investigate a machine that induces narcotic pleasure.

programme.title: Prodigy
programme.desc: Carter takes a cadet under her wing on a mission to a remote planet inhabited by unique electronic beings.

programme.title: Entity

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters a tricky situation when they join forces with androids designed to look like them.

The Aschen, the danger of whom the future SG-1 team warned about, contact SG-1 with an offer of an alliance.

programme.title: Wormhole X-Treme!

programme.title: Summit

programme.title: Last Stand

programme.title: Fail Safe
programme.desc: SG-1 uses an abandoned Goa'uld ship as a launch pad for a mega-bomb designed to destroy an asteroid.

programme.title: The Warrior

programme.title: Menace

programme.title: The Sentinel

programme.desc: As Teal'c and his son battle to save Earth, O'Neill pilots a ship to carry the Stargate into deep space.

programme.title: Descent
programme.desc: O'Neill and his crew are trapped inside a ship that plummets deep into the ocean and time is running out.

programme.title: Frozen

programme.title: Nightwalkers
programme.desc: When a scientist disappears, SG-1 investigate and discover that the scientist's town is infested with Goa'uld.

programme.title: Abyss
programme.desc: A Goa'uld lord holds O'Neill captive and tortures him for information about the Tok'ra.

programme.title: Shadow Play
programme.desc: Quinn is conflicted when a professor from his home planet asks SG-1 to help stage a coup in Kelowna.

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Two scientists working off-world witness SG-1 captured in a Goa'uld raid and attempt to rescue them.

programme.title: Allegiance
programme.desc: The Tok'ra must take refuge from the Goa'uld at the SGC Alpha Site occupied by Jaffa.

programme.title: Cure
programme.desc: SG-1 visits a planet inhabited by humans who have developed a drug that makes their immune systems perfect.

programme.title: Prometheus

programme.title: Unnatural Selection
programme.desc: Convinced they will attack earth, O'Neill stages a daring mission to stop the Replicators once and for all.

programme.title: Paradise Lost

programme.title: Prophecy

programme.title: Fallen

programme.title: Homecoming

programme.title: Space Race

programme.title: Avenger 2.0

programme.title: Autumn Croakus
programme.desc: Grandpa writes to a matrimonial agency hoping to find a wife.

programme.title: The Midnight Ride of Herman Munster
programme.desc: Robbers mistake Herman.

programme.title: Eddie's Nickname

programme.desc: Herman falls asleep in a mummy case.

programme.desc: Eddie volunteers to have Herman perform in a school talent show.

programme.desc: In the first of Bud Abbott and Lou Costello's horror vehicles for Universal Pictures, the inimitable comic duo star as railway baggage handlers in northern Florida. When a pair of crates belonging to a house of horrors museum are mishandled by Wilbur (Lou Costello), the museum's director, Mr. McDougal (Frank Ferguson), demands that they deliver them personally so that they can be inspected for insurance purposes, but Lou's friend Chick (Bud Abbott) has grave suspicions.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Invisible Man
programme.desc: Two detective-school graduates (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) help a framed boxer who can make himself disappear.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Killer, Boris Karloff
programme.desc: A hotel detective (Bud Abbott) and bellhop (Lou Costello) find dead bodies and a fake swami (Boris Karloff).

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Mummy
programme.desc: Two guys stuck in Egypt follow a medallion to the crypt of Klaris.

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

programme.title: The Black Cat
programme.desc: Stranded Budapest honeymooners follow a mad doctor (Bela Lugosi) to a black-lipped architect's (Boris Karloff) Art Deco manor.

programme.title: The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
programme.desc: A boy (Scott Sealey) upset by his parents' divorce must also tell the sheriff his father (Kerwin Mathews) is a werewolf.

programme.title: Bride of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After recovering from injuries sustained in the mob attack upon himself and his creation, Dr. Frankenstein (Colin Clive) falls under the control of his former mentor, Dr. Pretorius (Ernest Thesiger), who insists the now-chastened doctor resume his experiments in creating new life. Meanwhile, the Monster (Boris Karloff) remains on the run from those who wish to destroy him without understanding that his intentions are generally good despite his lack of socialization and self-control.

programme.title: The Brides of Dracula
programme.desc: Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) drives a stake through the heart of a vampire baron (David Peel) who even bites his own mother (Martita Hunt).

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Creature From the Black Lagoon
programme.desc: Remnants of a mysterious animal have come to light in a remote jungle, and a group of scientists intends to determine if the find is an anomaly or evidence of an undiscovered beast. To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.

programme.title: The Creature Walks Among Us
programme.desc: Scientists (Jeff Morrow, Rex Reason) capture the creature from the black lagoon and turn him into an air breather.

programme.title: Curse of the Undead
programme.desc: A cow-town preacher (Eric Fleming) shoots a custom bullet at a vampire gunfighter (Michael Pate) in the Old West.

programme.title: The Curse of the Werewolf
programme.desc: A man with brutal and macabre origins, Leon Corledo (Oliver Reed) was raised in the home of Don Alfredo Corledo (Clifford Evans), his kind and loving adopted father. When he leaves Don Alfredo to find work, Leon discovers that he has increasingly violent urges. Although these tendencies are calmed by Leon's love for the beautiful Christina (Catherine Feller), he ultimately cannot contain his curse and transforms into a werewolf, terrorizing the Spanish countryside.

programme.title: Curucu, Beast of the Amazon
programme.desc: A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.

programme.title: The Deadly Mantis
programme.desc: A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

programme.title: Dr. Cyclops
programme.desc: To assist with his work due to his failing eyesight, renowned biologist Dr. Alexander Thorkel invites two prominent scientists and a mineralogist to his hidden Amazon jungle laboratory. Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: In Tulsa, Okla., a homeless man is beaten and stabbed to death, leading detectives to witnesses that live under the bridge where he was discovered.

programme.title: Bad Romance; Out of Control
programme.desc: The investigation into the execution of a Somali girl leads Minneapolis police to uncover a secret relationship that may have turned deadly; a shooter kills a beloved son when a house party in Tulsa, Okla., gets out of control.

programme.title: Justice
programme.desc: McCoy opposes his former colleague, Jamie Ross, in the murder of another attorney for which a man may be wrongly convicted.

programme.title: Marathon
programme.desc: Briscoe, resentful at being second-guessed by fellow officers, feuds with Green over an exasperating murder case.

programme.title: Patsy
programme.desc: Even with key DNA evidence, a new witness jeopardizes the conviction of a man suspected of bludgeoning a woman into a coma.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green think a life insurance salesman's valuable information about his policies was a motive for his murder.

programme.title: Sundown
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green track a gigolo and con artist who is suspected of murder, but they run into problems when McCoy and Carmichael interview a victim's family.

programme.title: Loco Parentis
programme.desc: When a teenager is found murdered, Detectives Briscoe and Green suspect a school bully who displays an avid interest in martial-arts weapons.

programme.title: Collision
programme.desc: A mentally disturbed suspect refuses to take his antidepressant medicine, rendering him incapable of standing trial for murder.

programme.title: Mother's Milk
programme.desc: The parents of a missing child accuse each other of having the baby until a gruesome discovery is made.

programme.title: Panic
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green believe a possible love triangle was the motive behind the attempted assassination of a best-selling author.

programme.title: Entitled
programme.desc: The detectives continue searching for a shooter who may be responsible for several unsolved murders years earlier.

programme.title: Fools for Love
programme.desc: McCoy has trouble holding a case against a teenager's boyfriend suspected of killing two girls when she refuses to talk about his abuse.

programme.title: Trade This
programme.desc: The murder of a stockbroker points to organized crime when the prime suspect is killed by a hired hit man.

programme.title: Black, White and Blue
programme.desc: McCoy and Carmichael find two patrolmen partially responsible for the killing of a white teenager in Harlem.

programme.title: Mega
programme.desc: When a bomb kills six on a helicopter flight, evidence points to a victim's wife who is influenced by two financial advisers (Annette O'Toole, Michael McKean).

programme.title: Surrender Dorothy
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green first suspect gang members when a woman is found stuffed inside a car trunk, until they find out that she was married and having an affair.

programme.title: Untitled
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green learn that a murdered woman was not only a patron of the arts, but that an artist she supported created a painting similar to the crime scene.

programme.title: Narcosis
programme.desc: The detectives' investigation into the strangulation of an Asian-American stripper leads them to corrupt officers.

programme.title: High & Low
programme.desc: The detectives struggle to determine the motive of a club owner who hired two men to kill a stripper.

programme.title: Stiff
programme.desc: The detectives suspect a comatose woman's husband tried either to commit a mercy killing or to kill her for her money.

programme.title: Vaya con Dios
programme.desc: McCoy seeks to prosecute a high-level foreign dignitary for the torture and murder of a New York student 27 years earlier.

programme.title: Sweeps
programme.desc: After a child molester is killed by a victim's father on the set of a talk show, Stone investigates the host to prove he masterminded the meeting for ratings.

programme.title: Volunteers
programme.desc: Two tenants of an apartment building decide to cancel a homeless man's lease on life after his screaming frustrates the neighborhood.

programme.title: Discord
programme.desc: A heavy-metal rock star known for videos that are degrading to women is investigated for raping a college student.

programme.title: Profile
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan search for a serial killer after an African-American woman's murder matches a pattern of recent racial attacks.

programme.title: Black Tie
programme.desc: Logan and Briscoe investigate the children and widow of a tycoon after evidence is uncovered that he may have been murdered.

programme.title: Pride and Joy
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan investigate when a man is killed after being emotionally and physically abused for years by his gifted son.

programme.title: Apocrypha
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan bring a religious cult's leader to court after a woman is killed while planting a car bomb.

programme.title: American Dream
programme.desc: Stone and Kincaid (Michael Moriarty, Jill Hennessy) investigate further when a businessman (guest star Zeljko Ivanek) is acquitted of murder.

programme.title: Born Bad
programme.desc: Defense attorneys for a foster child who killed argue that he was genetically predisposed to violence.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happiness
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan's (Jerry Orbach, Chris Noth) investigation into a man's death leads them to a Russian mail-order bride (guest star Natalya Negoda). With Michael Moriarty.

programme.title: Golden Years
programme.desc: An emaciated elderly woman is found dead of an apparent heart attack; her granddaughter is charged with neglect and grave indifference to human life.

programme.title: Snatched
programme.desc: Kidnappers abduct the son of Schiff's friend and entomb him in the basement of an abandoned building.

programme.title: Breeder
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan help a young mother who claims her newborn baby was stolen from her after she gave birth in a taxi on the way to the hospital.

programme.title: Censure
programme.desc: Stone faces a tough court battle when a judge is placed on trial and claims the case against him is the vendetta of a former lover.

programme.title: Kids
programme.desc: Briscoe finds it difficult to arrest the son of his former partner when the teen is charged with the murder of a boy in a drive-by shooting.

programme.title: Big Bang
programme.desc: A physicist is linked to a package delivered through the mail that exploded and killed a rival's wife.

programme.title: Mayhem
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan (Jerry Orbach, Chris Noth) investigate five homicides in one chaotic day at the 27th Precinct. Guest stars: Alice Drummond, Victor Colicchio.

programme.title: Wager
programme.desc: The detectives investigate the death of a famous baseball player's father, who gambled his son's earnings on sporting events.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Racial tensions explode into violence after a middle-aged Jewish man leaves the scene of an accident involving a 12-year-old African-American boy.

programme.title: Nurture
programme.desc: A 10-year-old disappears after being taken from her alcoholic mother and placed with an abusive couple.

programme.title: Doubles
programme.desc: An investigation reveals a strange plot when a professional tennis player's wrist is broken after she finishes a practice session with a former rival.

programme.title: Old Friends
programme.desc: Stone contemplates resigning when the mob retaliates against his prosecution of a member of a notorious crime family.

programme.title: Second Opinion
programme.desc: A doctor is charged with murder for prescribing a treatment that caused toxic fumes to emit from a breast-cancer patient's body.

programme.title: Coma
programme.desc: Kincaid and McCoy have to decide whether to risk killing a comatose woman to recover the bullet they need as evidence.

programme.title: Blue Bamboo
programme.desc: A young actress claiming to have been the victim of a white slavery ring becomes the prime suspect when a wealthy Japanese businessman is murdered.

programme.title: Family Values
programme.desc: After the body of a wealthy woman is found in the East River, her daughter and her husband become murder suspects.

programme.title: White Rabbit
programme.desc: A safe-deposit-box company eventually exposes a political activist who went underground 20 years earlier to avoid a murder charge.

programme.title: Competence
programme.desc: Briscoe, Logan, McCoy and Kincaid try to clear Van Buren's name after she shoots a pair of young men who accost her at an automated teller machine.

programme.title: Precious
programme.desc: A girl found dead in a cooler may have been the victim of parents suffering from an unusual psychological illness.

programme.desc: Grace worries that Will is keeping secrets from her after Jack discloses Will's past affair with a client.

programme.title: Where There's a Will, There's No Way
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) blames Will (Eric McCormack) for her lack of a social life and decides that they can no longer have fun.

programme.title: The Buying Game
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) seeks Will's (Eric McCormack) advice on buying a studio, then sets out to prove she can make the deal.

programme.title: The Truth About Will and Dogs
programme.desc: Will (Eric McCormack) develops a dog obsession after Grace (Debra Messing) brings home a puppy, forcing her to take action.

programme.title: The Big Vent
programme.desc: Will and Grace (Eric McCormack, Debra Messing) eavesdrop on the couple downstairs (guest stars Tom Sullivan, Corinne Bohrer), who are involved in a marital conflict.

programme.title: Will on Ice
programme.desc: Jack and Grace (Sean Hayes, Debra Messing) surprise Will (Eric McCormack) on his birthday with tickets to an ice-skating show with Rudy Galindo (as himself). With Megan Mullally.

programme.title: My Fair Maid-y
programme.desc: Will hires a cleaning lady to help Grace with her preparations for an upcoming decorators' contest; Jack dates a guy he meets at the bookstore.

programme.title: The Unsinkable Mommy Adler
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) gets a visit from her mother (guest star Debbie Reynolds), who wreaks havoc by suggesting that she marry Will (Eric McCormack).

programme.title: Big Brother Is Coming
programme.desc: Will's estranged, older brother turns up at Jack's birthday party; Karen flashes her platinum card for Jack.

programme.title: Big Brother Is Coming
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) tells Will (Eric McCormack) about her romance with his brother (guest star John Slattery); Karen (Megan Mullally) helps Jack (Sean Hayes) deal with turning 30.

programme.title: Yours, Mine or Ours
programme.desc: Will and Grace (Eric McCormack, Debra Messing) compete for the affections of their new neighbor (guest star David Newsom). With Megan Mullally.

programme.title: Secrets & Lays
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) romances an old flame (guest star David Sutcliffe) while in Vermont and tries to hide the fling from Will (Eric McCormack). Tom Bosley also guest stars.

programme.title: Grace, Replaced
programme.desc: Will uses his new neighbor, Val, for his plans while Grace works; Jack is sentenced to pick up trash.

programme.title: Will Works Out
programme.desc: Will learns a lesson about prejudice from Jack; Karen tells Grace about her rocky marriage.

programme.title: Saving Grace
programme.desc: A successful publicist hires Grace to decorate his office with the condition that Will dates him.

programme.title: Alley Cats
programme.desc: Grace tones down her competitiveness during game playing, while Will's focus changes to winning; Karen saves a workman.

programme.title: Object of My Rejection
programme.desc: Grace and Will (Debra Messing, Eric McCormack) rethink their living arrangement; Jack (Sean Hayes) agrees to marry Karen's (Megan Mullally) maid (guest star Shelley Morrison).

programme.title: Guess Who's Not Coming to Dinner
programme.desc: To assert her independence, Grace moves to the apartment across the hall and throws a dinner party without Will's help.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: A jealous Grace runs against Will for president of the board of tenants when she finds out about the position's perks.

programme.title: Das Boob
programme.desc: Grace tries to live up to her new "dimensions" when a deceiving, but flattering, picture of her appears in a newspaper.

programme.title: Whose Mom Is It Anyway?
programme.desc: Grace's mom (guest star Debbie Reynolds) shows Will (Eric McCormack) a little too much attention for her jealous daughter's taste. With Debra Messing.

programme.title: Polk Defeats Truman
programme.desc: Will lets his ego get the better of him when he dismisses the clients who believed in him before he became a success.

programme.title: To Serve and Disinfect
programme.desc: Jack (Sean Hayes) challenges Will (Eric McCormack) to become a waiter on his staff; Grace (Debra Messing) finds out a dirty secret about Karen (Megan Mullally).

programme.title: Homo for the Holidays
programme.desc: Jack's (Sean Hayes) mother (guest star Veronica Cartwright) doesn't know he is gay and thinks he once had a romantic relationship with Grace (Debra Messing).

programme.title: Terms of Employment
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) looks to Will (Eric McCormack) for representation when a lawyer (guest star Gregory Hines) doesn't pay her for a consulting assignment.

programme.title: I Never Promised You an Olive Garden
programme.desc: Rob and Ellen become jealous when Will and Grace begin to pal around with a photographer and an art gallery manager.

programme.title: Tea and a Total Lack of Sympathy
programme.desc: Will has until Friday to find a new client or lose his job; Jack and Grace try to get on their favorite TV show.

programme.title: Seeds of Discontent
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) is upset when Will's (Eric McCormack) best friend (guest star Megyn Price) from high school wants him to be the father of her baby.

programme.title: He's Come Undone
programme.desc: Will suffers from strange dreams when he learns that Grace is dating his therapist; Jack and Karen argue about the treatment of Rosario.

programme.title: Oh Dad, Poor Dad, He's Kept Me in the Closet and I'm Feeling So Sad

programme.title: Aloha Slater

programme.title: The Substitute
programme.desc: When Ms. Simpson injures her back, a substitute teacher named Tony Crane takes over her class at Bayside; when all the girls fall for Mr. Crane, Zack and Slater become jealous.

programme.title: Cream for a Day

programme.title: Pinned to the Mat

programme.title: Beauty and the Screech

programme.title: The Friendship Business
programme.desc: Zack and his friends form a company selling friendship bracelets for a business class project. He names himself as boss, but Kelly, Jessie, and Slater feel he is treating them poorly.

programme.title: The Mamas and the Papas
programme.desc: Everyone is put into pairs for a class assignment to act out married life, so they can be prepared for marriage as adults.

programme.title: The Election
programme.desc: Jessie and Zack (Elizabeth Berkley, Mark-Paul Gosselaar) run for student president, each for different reasons.

programme.title: The Zack Tapes
programme.desc: Zack's use of a subliminal tape to get Kelly to fall for him has results he never intended.

programme.title: The Zack Tapes
programme.desc: Zack's use of a subliminal tape to get Kelly to fall for him has results he never intended.

programme.title: King of the Hill
programme.desc: Zack's (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) schemes to get Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) to be his girl land him in detention with a rival for her affections.

programme.title: Save That Tiger
programme.desc: The pranks between rival schools Bayside and Valley escalate during the week of the city cheerleading finals.

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Nerd Kind
programme.desc: Screech's (Dustin Diamond) alien disguise is so believable it attracts a government UFO investigator.

programme.title: Screech's Birthday
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) decides to throw a surprise birthday party for Screech (Dustin Diamond) in the principal's office.

programme.title: Slater's Friend
programme.desc: Slater's (Mario Lopez) pet dies while in Zack's (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) care.

programme.title: The Prom

programme.title: Zack's War
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) becomes a leader of men when he joins a cadet corps to get out of detention.

programme.title: Save the Max

programme.title: Driver's Education

programme.title: House Party

programme.title: Blind Dates

programme.title: Rent-a-Pop
programme.desc: Zack has a waiter impersonate his father for a meeting with the principal.

programme.title: Miss Bayside

programme.title: Jessie's Song
programme.desc: Jessie (Elizabeth Berkley) becomes addicted to caffeine pills as she strives to be a perfect student. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Tiffani-Amber Thiessen.

programme.title: Breaking Up Is Hard to Undo

programme.title: The Last Dance

programme.title: The Aftermath

programme.title: The Video Yearbook
programme.desc: Zack's (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) latest moneymaking scheme involves a "Girls of Bayside" video-dating tape.

programme.title: Palm Springs Weekend: Part 2
programme.desc: Jessie (Elizabeth Berkley) does everything in her power to break up her father's wedding. With Dustin Diamond.

programme.title: The Last Weekend

programme.title: All in the Mall

programme.title: Palm Springs Weekend: Part 1
programme.desc: Jessie's father invites everyone to his Palm Springs resort to attend his wedding. With Elizabeth Berkley and Mario Lopez.

programme.title: Palm Springs Weekend: Part 2
programme.desc: Jessie (Elizabeth Berkley) does everything in her power to break up her father's wedding. With Dustin Diamond.

programme.title: Rockumentary
programme.desc: Casey Kasem (guest starring as himself) chronicles the rise of the rock group Zack Attack. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar.

programme.title: Home for Christmas: Part 1
programme.desc: The students are shocked during the Christmas season to discover the new girl working in Mr. Moody's store is homeless.

programme.title: Home for Christmas: Part 2
programme.desc: Zack's family invites Laura and her father home for Christmas.

programme.title: Mystery Weekend
programme.desc: Lisa (Lark Voorhies) wins a mystery weekend at Mr. Jameson's mansion and invites the gang to participate. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar.

programme.title: Screech's Spaghetti Sauce
programme.desc: Screech (Dustin Diamond) is targeted by a gold digger when his spaghetti sauce business becomes a huge success.

programme.title: The Bayside Triangle
programme.desc: The gang agrees to pitch in and stage a fashion show to exhibit Lisa's designs for a visiting fashion recruiter.

programme.title: Isn't It Romantic?
programme.desc: Valentine's Day finds the gang at the Max reminiscing about past relationships. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar and Dustin Diamond.

programme.title: The Senior Prom

programme.title: Teen-Line

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Stand-In
programme.desc: Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain Ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas refuses since they are taking a murderer named Rudy Croft to be hanged in Yuma. Later, Croft escapes and the guards take Lucas as their prisoner.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Journey Back
programme.desc: Mark takes a job on new neighbor Will Temple's ranch but is taken back by Temple's badly scarred face. When a cavalry officer stops by the McCain Ranch looking for a deserter who committed murder, both Mark and Lucas question who Temple really is.

programme.title: Maverick - The Troubled Heir
programme.desc: When Bart Maverick's friend, Pearly Gates, steals money in a poker game, an outlaw threatens to kill Pearly. To save his life, Bart is forced to concoct a fake inheritance scheme to get money and pay off the outlaw.

programme.title: Maverick - Greenbacks, Unlimited
programme.desc: Bret's friend, Foursquare Farley, a blackjack dealer with a secret vault tunnel to the Denver State Bank, races to stop a safecracker, Big Ed Murphy, from robbing it. Murphy must be stopped and Farley's own borrowing from the bank must be repaid.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Vengeance Is Mine
programme.desc: Cheyenne is the interim sheriff for the town of Gunnison. He quickly learns that his old friend Ray Masters wants revenge on Rod Delaplane due to a previous debt. Cheyenne must go to extreme measures to avoid tragedy.

programme.title: The Rifleman - A Matter of Faith
programme.desc: A trail bum rides into North Fork during one of the worst droughts in years. He claims that he can bring rain to their town. Many believe that he's a water witcher, but a railroad boss resents his intrusion and wants him gone.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Lucas finds a wounded man, takes him to the North Fork doctor, and gives blood to help save the stranger's life. Marshal Torrance won't help as he says he knows the man and wants him dead. Things become more complicated when vigilantes ride to town.

programme.title: Maverick - The Judas Mask
programme.desc: A Norwegian showgirl named Karen lures Bart Maverick into partnering on a hotel casino business proposition. However, after she steals $20,000 and flees to Mexico, Bart gives chase, set on retrieving his cash from the woman before she disappears.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - Burton Mossman Crosses the Line
programme.desc: After failing to capture the ruthless murderer Augustine Chacon on U.S. soil, Arizona Ranger Burton Mossman relinquishes his badge to cross the border. In Mexico, he goes undercover as a horse thief to join Chacon's gang and spring his trap.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - Sister Blandina and the Killer
programme.desc: When a bloodthirsty mob storms a jailhouse holding a man accused of attempted murder, they are confronted by a 22-year-old missionary from the Sisters of Charity. Only Sister Blandina can stop the vigilantes from taking the law into their own hands.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - Jim Beckwourth: War Chief of the Crow
programme.desc: When former slave Jim Beckwourth heads west to seek work as a trapper, he begins what will become one of the most eventful, heroic lives of all the mountain men. As a joke, one of Beckwourth's fellow trappers tells a group of Crow warriors that Beckwourth is a long-lost member of their tribe, and the adventure begins. Adopted by the Crow, Beckwourth joins them in a series of ferocious battles with other tribes, becomes a war chief, and falls in love with a fierce female warrior named Pine Leaf.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - Kiddie Corral
programme.desc: The cowboys step a little outside of their comfort zones. Looking to offload their new herd, the guys head down to the local stockyard to hone their bartering skills. Cody bounces a crazy rodeo idea off the boys - then uses them guinea pigs. Bubba plans a short getaway with Kaley, but there's a big catch: Booger's been tapped as the babysitter, with Jaclyn lending a helping hand. Kaley wonders if Booger is up to the challenge. His first attempts to feed and dress little Andie suggest he most cer

programme.title: Maverick - The Rivals
programme.desc: Jack Vandergelt III is a millionaire set on courting a woman who despises rich men. Bret Maverick agrees to switch identities with Vandergelt so he can be loved as a humble man, but his father arrives to complicate matters.

programme.title: Cheyenne - The Return of Mr. Grimm
programme.desc: During an arrest, Cheyenne shoots and kills the lawless son of Nathanael Grimm, a wealthy man who controls the town. Cheyenne faces a murder charge, and the townspeople are out of work when Grimm closes his mine in revenge.

programme.title: Cheyenne - The Beholden
programme.desc: Cheyenne arrives in Winslow with a letter recommending him for the marshal's job. As he delivers it to the banker the next morning, Elijah McGuire and his men rob the bank, and Cheyenne finds himself caught in the middle.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Stand-In
programme.desc: Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain Ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas refuses since they are taking a murderer named Rudy Croft to be hanged in Yuma. Later, Croft escapes and the guards take Lucas as their prisoner.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Journey Back
programme.desc: Mark takes a job on new neighbor Will Temple's ranch but is taken back by Temple's badly scarred face. When a cavalry officer stops by the McCain Ranch looking for a deserter who committed murder, both Mark and Lucas question who Temple really is.

programme.title: Maverick - The Troubled Heir
programme.desc: When Bart Maverick's friend, Pearly Gates, steals money in a poker game, an outlaw threatens to kill Pearly. To save his life, Bart is forced to concoct a fake inheritance scheme to get money and pay off the outlaw.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: When a gunslinger with a bad disposition is nursed back to health and desired by a Quaker girl, he finds himself having to choose between his lawless life or the peaceful world of his newfound love.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Stranger at Night
programme.desc: Coming home from school, Mark stumbles upon a dead man's body. Lucas discovers he was stabbed and the only clue is a belt with the initials R.M. Lucas leaves Mark with Artemus Quarles, a cousin who is visiting. Quarles, however, is not who he seems.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Raid
programme.desc: A renegade Apache named Chaqua raids the McCain Ranch and kidnaps Mark. Lucas gathers a group of men to get Mark back, but Chaqua plans to make him an Apache warrior since he lost his own son. Lucas will stop at nothing to get his son back to safety.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Border Showdown
programme.desc: Cheyenne and Smitty travel to Mexico to bring a gang of outlaws accused of killing Cheyenne's close friend to justice. However, after they arrive, they discover that the small Mexican town is under the rule of the gang's leader.

programme.title: Cheyenne - The Last Train West
programme.desc: Cheyenne is on the run from the law after being falsely accused of murder. He boards a west-bound train for California, but a reverend's daughter interrupts his plans when she threatens to turn him in.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Spiked Rifle
programme.desc: Lucas agrees to ride shotgun on a stagecoach carrying $20,000 in gold for North Fork banker John Hamilton after a man fails to show up. When three men rob the stage and take Mark hostage, Lucas must get both the gold and Mark back safely.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Smoke Screen
programme.desc: A beautiful headstrong young woman named Marge Crandell doesn't like to be told what to do by anyone. Several men vie for her attention and when Lucas finds her dead, one of the men becomes a prime suspect due to a simple clue, a half-smoked cigar.

programme.title: Maverick - Stage West
programme.desc: Bret Maverick meets Linda Harris, who has come West after her husband struck gold. However, a violent rancher and his sons have already murdered her husband. They take Bret and Linda hostage to find the mine's location. Maverick jumps into action.

programme.title: Maverick - Duel at Sundown
programme.desc: While traveling to a high-stakes poker game, Bret Maverick's friend asks him to visit his ranch. Bret finds himself caught up in his friend's desire to end his daughter's relationship with a gunslinger.

programme.title: War of the Wildcats
programme.desc: During the early days of the Oklahoma oil boom, a greedy, self-assured oilman and a quiet, yet determined cowboy fight for the rights to oil on Indian land. All the while a pretty schoolteacher steals both men's hearts.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Big Ghost Basin
programme.desc: Cheyenne finds a dead man's body and strange signs from the mysterious killer on a trail to Crowheart. When he arrives in town with the body, the townspeople suspect him to be a member of the rustler gang that's responsible.

programme.title: Maverick - The Money Machine
programme.desc: Bart Maverick travels to Kansas City to collect money from his cousin, Jackie, to pay off a family debt. However, Jackie has been conned into buying a counterfeit money printing machine with it. Bart must find the swindlers and recoup the money.

programme.title: The Young Land
programme.desc: When an American gunslinger kills a Mexican man in California immediately in the aftermath of the Mexican-American War, he is arrested and put on trial for murder. The local population is anxious to see if justice will prevail.

programme.title: Bonanza - The Savage
programme.desc: On his way to Nevada, Adam rides up on some Indians wanting to harm a white woman they believe is a mountain spirit. They escape but Adam is wounded. The woman nurses him back to health but the tribe is on their trail.

programme.title: Bonanza - Silent Thunder
programme.desc: Angry at the way a young deaf woman is treated by her father, Little Joe decides to teach her sign language so they can communicate better. However, his plan backfires when she falls in love with him.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: A cattle baron awaits the return of his daughter from school and is surprised that his wife has returned to take their daughter away. He tries to keep the peace and do what is best for everyone.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Guest
programme.desc: A charming man named Mario Rosati arrives at the McCain Ranch and introduces himself as an acquaintance of an old family friend. Lucas and Mark offer him a place to stay for a few days, but they learn that he has an ulterior motive: to kill Lucas.

programme.title: Welcome to Willits
programme.desc: Deep in the woods of Northern California lies the off-the-grid town of Willits, a haven for marijuana growers, meth addicts and conspiracy theorists. When a gaggle of vacationing teens unknowingly set up their campsite on the property of Willits' most disturbed resident, a psychotic, drug-addled pot farmer who is convinced that extraterrestrials are out to get him, they're in for one hell of a bad time.

On their trek home, they begin to realize that a lone hiker has been following them. After a series of disturbing encounters, they are forced to confront their deepest fears when the stranger's true motives are revealed.

As tensions escalate throughout a debaucherous night, things take an unexpected turn when a woman claiming to be a neighbor with car trouble shows up at the door. She seems harmless enough, or so they think.

programme.desc: Corky (Anthony Hopkins), a failed magician, adopts a new ventriloquist act with an abrasive dummy named Fats, and suddenly finds himself lined up for a television show. When the unbalanced Corky fears he won't pass the required mental exam, he runs away with Fats to his hometown, where he meets an old love from high school, Peggy (Ann-Margret). Corky persuades Peggy to leave her loveless marriage -- but Fats, who seems to be taking on a mind of his own, doesn't approve of the relationship.
