programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Richard Pryor (12/14/76)
programme.desc: Tis the season --- for Richard Pryor to reminese about...serving time - 10 days - for tax evasion. Animal expert Dr. Michael Fox advises on getting a pet at Christmas.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Richard Pryor (5/4/77)
programme.desc: Comic legend Richard Pryor chats about his California-style divorce and SNL alum and movie star Chevy Chase shares the secret behind his famous spot on Gerald Ford impression.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Richard Pryor (1/12/79)
programme.desc: Was Richard Pryor's grandmother really a tyrant? Hear Pryor's recollections of grandma battle ax. Comic genius Tim Conway remembers his early days in Vegas.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Richard Pryor (7/27/79)
programme.desc: Richard Pryor goes ham on Blacks who play tennis as tennis great Roscoe Tanner compares his 101 mph serve to Johnny's (74 mph). Actress Patti D'Arbanville imitates Streisand's cough.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Richard Pryor (5/20/81)
programme.desc: Celebrated comic Richard Pryor shares his experience recovering from extensive burns and reminisces with comic George Carlin about starting out together in 1960s Greenwich Village.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Richard Pryor (2/9/83)
programme.desc: The brilliant Richard Pryor describes his transforming time in Zimbabwe and quitting drugs and booze. Hollywood legend and non-singer Bette Davis talks about her new record!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Richard Pryor (6/9/83)
programme.desc: Famed comedian Richard Pryor pokes fun at his failure at marriage and reflects on his new sobriety. Fellow guest and The Breakfast Club star Ally Sheedy describes life as a senior at USC.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Richard Pryor (10/9/86)
programme.desc: Newly slender super-comic Richard Pryor discusses dropping 20 pounds for a movie role and driving his Ferrari across the US. Madonna spouse Sean Pean chats about life with the Material Girl.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Richard Pryor (5/11/89)
programme.desc: Father and daughter night! Comedian Richard Pryor accompanies his daughter, actress Rain Pryor. They chat about Rain's boyfriend Tony, and Dad's string of 5 - count 'em 5 - wives!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Charlton Heston (5/22/74)
programme.desc: Screen legend Charlton Heston talks drivers' ed: how learned chariot racing for Ben Hur and flying a 747 for Airport '75. Author Norman Mailer describes his dream book subject -- Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Orson Welles (9/23/76)
programme.desc: One of the world's greatest filmmakers, Orson Welles (Citizen Kane) discusses his radio, theatre and movie career which spanned over 5 decades.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Jimmy Stewart (7/12/77)
programme.desc: Hollywood legend Jimmy Stewart admits he would rather play the accordion in the movies than sing and dance. He's joined by Tracy Austin, the youngest tennis player ever invited to Wimbledon.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Elia Kazan (8/17/78)
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winning director Elia Kazan (On the Waterfront and Gentleman's Agreement) explains why writing his novel, Acts of Love, was harder than filmmaking.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Charlton Heston (2/14/79)
programme.desc: Charlton Heston describes his role in diffusing the hijacking of a United Airlines jet. The hijacker had demanded that Heston read her message of "revolution" on national TV.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Charlton Heston (4/30/80)
programme.desc: Before his big break, movie legend Charlton Heston made ends meet in New York City by working as an artist's model. The two-time Oscar winner describes his world travels and his two Oscars.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Jimmy Stewart (12/11/80)
programme.desc: Oscar winner James Stewart (Philadelphia Story) chats about his holiday shopping and plans for Christmas. He talks about getting older and his new hearing aid.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Shelley Winters (6/20/84)
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Shelley Winters reveals her distaste for marriage once the honeymoon ends. She also discusses writing her memoirs.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Shelley Winters (8/28/87)
programme.desc: Johnny chats with Shelley Winters.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Bette Davis (1/7/88)
programme.desc: Superstar Bette Davis comments on her Kennedy Center award and President Reagan. She and Johnny compare notes on quitting smoking. Comedian Martin Short does celebrity impressions.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Jimmy Stewart (9/7/89)
programme.desc: Hollywood great Jimmy Stewart reads a poem about his beloved dog, Boe. Then animal trainer Jim Fowler introduces Johnny to a tightly wound 220 pound python.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Jimmy Stewart (12/27/89)
programme.desc: Oscar winner Jimmy Stewart describes an evening at the celebrity-fave nightclub when teenager Judy Garland showed up and sang for the gang.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Elizabeth Taylor (2/21/92)
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Elizabeth Taylor chats about, her new perfume, addiction programs, her seven husbands, and her most marriage to construction worker Larry Fortensky.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Lauren Bacall (6/23/83)
programme.desc: Screen star and two-time Tony winner Lauren Bacall talks about her new play, life in LA and quitting smoking...for the fifth time.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Jack Palance (5/10/74)
programme.desc: Hollywood's best bad guy, Jack Palance says he doesn't like playing villains but loved his role a psychotic antiques dealer in his latest movie, Craze.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Danny Thomas (1/20/76)
programme.desc: Comedian, TV star and noted humanitarian Danny Thomas chats about working with fellow funny man Jonathan Winters and his latest show on NBC.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Dinah Shore (11/10/77)
programme.desc: Fellow talk show host and chart-topping vocalist Dinah Shore sings 2 of her hits and says she'd rather be the one asking the questions. Her dream interview is Israeli Prime Minister Golda Meir.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Tony Curtis (6/21/78)
programme.desc: Movie star Tony Curtis discusses his steamy new novel about Hollywood and the mob. Also shows a clip from his first movie, at age 23, in which he played a rumba dancer.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Jack Palance (5/10/91)
programme.desc: The ultimate Hollywood bad guy, Jack Palance chats with Johnny about his break-out role in Shane (1949). Palance also describes his current line of work -- running a cattle ranch.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Gregory Peck (8/3/77)
programme.desc: Hollywood leading man Gregory Peck dishes on WW2 hero General Douglas MacArthur, whom he played in the biopic, and the General's overlooked sense of humor.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Eli Wallach (9/1/77)
programme.desc: Remember The Thorn Birds? Meet Colleen McCullough, who wrote the blockbuster novel-turned-mini series. Lou Brock discusses his base-stealing record and acting legend Eli Wallach chats about his craft. Don Rickles plugs his show C.P.O. Sharkey.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Peter O'Toole (1/13/78)
programme.desc: Screen star Peter O'Toole was Oscar nom'd 8 times! Never won. Finally bagged the golden statue for lifetime achievement. O'Toole discusses The Stunt Man. Comic Buddy Hackett brings some laughs.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Robert Mitchum (6/16/78)
programme.desc: The gorgeous and talented Ann-Margret says she disguises herself in a black wig when out in public. Screen legend Robert Mitchem reveals he did time on a chain gang, at age 15.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (12/10/81)
programme.desc: Hollywood heavyweights Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau regale Johnny with tales of making 5 movies together and one near-death stunt gone very wrong.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (3/23/82)
programme.desc: Stardom is bad for your health. Walter Matthau dons dark glasses to disguise an eye problem, jokes about his roommate in the hospital and the awful food.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Sean Connery (10/5/83)
programme.desc: Sean Connery gives a Bond trivia quiz, and recalls his scariest stunts. Comic Keenan Ivory Wayans says dating white girls is like being on Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom; people can't stop staring.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Mickey Rooney (3/13/84)
programme.desc: Mickey Rooney compares notes with Johnny on their many marriages. Comic Paul Rodriguez riffs on Mexicans picking fruit and the fun of annoying white drivers on LA freeways.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (7/22/86)
programme.desc: We're spelling tonight! Walter Matthau and Johnny quiz one another on difficult words. Matthau recalls filming Tunisia and shows a clip from his movie, Pirates.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Raquel Welch (6/22/88)
programme.desc: Hog wild: That's Jay Leno who owns 17 motorcycles. Leno describes a chopper breakdown in LA with a busload of tourists cheering him on. Raquel Welch discusses her children and getting older.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Dennis Hopper (8/15/91)
programme.desc: Not your typical leading man, Dennis Hopper talks about his unusual roles in Blue Velvet and Easy Rider, and his up and down career which began in his Kansas hometown.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Clint Eastwood (5/15/92)
programme.desc: Mr. "make-my-day" Clint Eastwood reminisces about Gunsmoke, Outlaw Josey Wales and Dirty Harry, while Bob Hope and David Letterman also appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Jane Fonda (10/6/77)
programme.desc: Activist and two-time Oscar winner Jane Fonda details her suit against the US government for invading her privacy. Also plugs her move, "Julia."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Dean Martin (12/12/75)
programme.desc: Star party guy, Dean Martin recounts the wild fun celebrating Frank Sinatra's big 6-0. Also fills in Johnny on playing Las Vegas and his frequent forays into the casinos.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Joey Bishop (2/24/76)
programme.desc: Brat packer & longtime TV personality Joey Bishop talks about his career, politics, how he gave up smoking and lost weight.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Raquel Welch (11/21/80)
programme.desc: The great actress and great beauty Raquel Welch chats about Presidents Reagan and Carter, her 2nd marriage, getting negative press and how she imagines her life in the year 2000.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - James Garner (11/4/88)
programme.desc: James Garner shares the gruesome details of his recent bypass surgery and thanks well-wishers for the 9,000 get well cards he received. The operation has not, thankfully, hurt his golf game.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Victor Buono (8/16/73)
programme.desc: The very funny Victor Buono drops in to talk about his recently released book of poetry, and to cut up with Johnny and Ed.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - James Garner (9/13/91)
programme.desc: Actor James Garner stops by to talk about his latest television series, "Man Of The People," and discusses some one of the biggest clinkers of his career, his induction into the Television Hall Of Fame, and his fear of public speaking.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (12/14/72)
programme.desc: Watch a Tea Time movie with Carol Wayne. Plus Doris Day has a bad neck, Rodney Dangerfield performs and Burt Mustin discusses his first visit to Hollywood in 1925.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Diane Keaton (12/28/72)
programme.desc: Diane Keaton talks about Christmas in her childhood. Gene Hackman also appears.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Ricardo Montalban (8/1/73)
programme.desc: Remember Ricardo Montalban's "rich Corinthian leather?" The king of kitsch (Fantasy Island, 3 Planet of the Apes movies and Star Trek tv series and movie) reveals his obsession with bullfighting!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (10/2/73)
programme.desc: No one rocks a polyester leisure suit like sex god Burt Reynolds. Comic Buddy Hackett's orgasm-sneeze makes for really compelling TV. Master complainer Don Rickles rounds out the show.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Peter Falk (10/5/73)
programme.desc: Catch a rack of iconic rumpled raincoats worn by 4-time Emmy winner Peter Falk in his detective show Columbo. Dallas star Victoria Principal chats about quitting booze and cigarettes.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Gene Hackman (3/21/74)
programme.desc: Oscar winner Gene Hackman shows a watery clip from ocean liner disaster flick Poseidon Adventure. Also on this episode is Diane Keaton

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Jim Henson (5/24/74)
programme.desc: Even celebs like Suzanne Pleshette go to the dentist and suffer with ordinary phobias. Of course, Jim Henson's Muppets are the exception; they have perfect teeth!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (9/26/74)
programme.desc: Decked out in head-to-toe leather, Burt Reynolds shares a clip from The Longest Yard. Comic genius Dom DeLuise discusses his dog's issues and Honeymooners star Art Carney plays "September Song."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Lilly Tomlin (2/20/75)
programme.desc: Lily Tomlin describes her Detroit childhood, creating a character by working a check-out counter and her career as a shoplifter.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Michael Caine (12/5/75)
programme.desc: Oscar clubbers Michael Caine and Sean Connery share a clip from their movie The Man who would be King. Connery announces he's retiring from James Bond movies and Caine says he's now a wine merchant.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (3/2/77)
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds shows his vacation videos and talks about moving in next door to Barbra Streisand.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (3/30/77)
programme.desc: Oscar winner Bruce Dern talks about getting his big break and his neighbor Robert Redford. Psychiatrist Sam Dunkell analyzes dreams and sleep positions. `

programme.title: Shrinks Don't Talk and Kids Don't Sing
programme.desc: Mark adjusts to his first day of college as a commuter student; Becky gets into a disagreement with Beverly Rose's music teacher over a song.

programme.title: When Sisters Collide and the Return of the Grifters
programme.desc: Darlene crashes Mark's college trivia night to prove how smart she is; Neville finds out the money he loaned Dan was used for something other than its intended purpose.

programme.title: Hanging in Dorms With Boys and the Secret Life of Men
programme.desc: Darlene urges Ben to make some male friends as he feels anxious about turning 50; Mark asks Harris to buy him and his friends beer for their dorm room.

programme.title: Smash and Grab and Happy Death Day

programme.title: Toilet Hacks and the Management Track
programme.desc: After feeling the cafeteria staff could use some organization, Darlene seeks to be the manager of food services at Mark's college; Dan teaches housewives the basics of DIY home projects to make some extra money toward paying off the house.

programme.title: Manifesting, Marriage Testing and Cheeseballs

programme.title: Campaign U-Turn and a Hard Write
programme.desc: Dan gets asked to write an article for a hardware magazine, making Ben long for his days as a writer; Jackie inserts herself into Louise's run for the school board when her retirement leads to too much free time.

programme.title: Fire and Vice

programme.title: Flying, Applying and Rassling Gators

programme.title: Less Money, More Problems
programme.desc: Mark takes on odd jobs, determined to find a way to pay for school; Darlene grapples with her emotions when she discovers her household is about to change dramatically.

programme.title: Keep on Truckin'

programme.title: Tangled up in Blue

programme.title: There Won't Be Blood
programme.desc: An email from the school banning certain Halloween costumes, including Mark's, sets off an argument between Dan and Darlene; Jackie introduces someone to the family at the Halloween party and insists that Dan vet him, but she immediately regrets it.

programme.title: The Separation of Church and Dan

programme.title: Miracles
programme.desc: A member of the family makes a life-changing announcement; Dan suspects Becky isn't holding up her end of the bargain with regard to her drinking; Darlene continues to look for a job; Jackie offers English lessons to a busboy.

programme.title: One Flew Over the Conners' Nest
programme.desc: Jackie convinces Dan to build a chicken coop in the backyard, so the family can eat organic eggs; Becky meets with Andrea for the first time since the surrogacy mishap; Darlene deals with a sleazy customer at her casino job.

programme.title: Hold the Salt
programme.desc: Dan questions Peter's motives when he learns about the pricey Christmas gift Jackie purchased for her new, unemployed beau; Mark and Mary write up their Christmas wish lists; Darlene receives advice from an unlikely source.

programme.title: O Sister, Where Art Thou?
programme.desc: Becky helps Harris keep a secret from Darlene, which causes a rift between the sisters; Jackie supports Peter with his project; Dan and an old friend reunite.

programme.title: Rage Against the Machine
programme.desc: When Dan gets injured while covering D.J.'s vending machine route, the decision to sue the company could cost D.J. his job; Jackie is appalled when Becky seeks life coaching from her nemesis.

programme.title: Don't Shoot the Piano Teacher
programme.desc: When Ben offers Mark free piano lessons, Darlene uses it as an opportunity to test his parenting skills; Jackie throws Becky a baby shower; Emilio continues his efforts to be part of the baby's life.

programme.title: We Continue to Truck
programme.desc: As Darlene grapples with a life-changing offer from Ben, an unexpected conversation with David turns her world even more upside down; relationship problems lead Jackie to the bottom of the bottle; Dan delivers alarming news.

programme.title: Preemies, Weed and Infidelity
programme.desc: In the wake of Emilio's deportation, Jackie steps into the role of a paternal figure and creates a meticulous birth plan for Becky; Darlene is tangled in a complex love triangle with David and Ben; Harris is caught up in a problem of her own.

programme.title: A Kiss Is Just a Kiss
programme.desc: Darlene struggles to decide between David and Ben; Becky begins to doubt herself as a mom; Mark gets in trouble at school when a picture of him and his boyfriend kissing goes viral; Jackie avoids her problems by keeping busy with everyone else's.

programme.title: The Preemie Monologues
programme.desc: Harris is forced to confront Darlene about her lifestyle; Jackie involves herself in other people's problems to avoid confronting her own; Becky is overwhelmed by the costs of raising a baby, so her family steps in to help.

programme.title: Landford... Landford
programme.desc: Desperate for more income, Becky seeks a bartending position at Casita Bonita, causing major concern for Dan due to her struggle with alcoholism; Darlene finally nears a decision between David and Ben; Harris' new friend, Odessa, means new trouble.

programme.title: Nightmare on Lunch Box Street
programme.desc: Halloween brings nothing but horror for Jackie after she uncovers a shocking secret when trying to reopen the Lunch Box; Mary gets upset when a woman assumes she is adopted; Darlene continues to deal with her complicated love life.

programme.title: Tempest in a Stew Pot
programme.desc: Jackie and Becky pitch their business plan to Darlene in hopes of getting the Lunch Box back, but Darlene's decision leads to hostility; Dan bans Odessa from the house, causing a rift with Harris; Mark makes extensive Thanksgiving plans.

programme.title: Slappy Holidays
programme.desc: Chaos ensues when Dan finally gets the entire family together for Thanksgiving dinner; mixed feelings about the Lunch Box continue to build tension in the house; Harris makes an unexpected move.

programme.title: Lanford, Toilet of Sin
programme.desc: Jackie is faced with a difficult decision that brings the family and community together; Becky starts working a new late-night shift at Casita Bonita; Darlene goes to extreme measures to mend her relationship with Harris.

programme.title: Smoking Penguins and Santa on Santa Action
programme.desc: Dan is disappointed when everyone but Becky forgets about his birthday; Darlene faces another issue; Dan excludes Jackie from the family Christmas Santa photo for mistreating Louise.

programme.title: Throwing a Christian to a Bear
programme.desc: The Conners struggle to accept Becky's new boyfriend, a Green Bay Packers fan; Dan tries to impress upon Mark the importance of the family's die-hard loyalty to the Bears; Ben and Darlene try to get a loan for their new magazine.

programme.title: Mud Turtles, a Good Steak and One Man in a Tub
programme.desc: Becky thinks that Jackie's new friend, a restaurant supplier, is taking advantage of them; Darlene is thrilled when Harris gets into Central Illinois State, but Harris might have found a better offer; Dan finds himself in an embarrassing situation.

programme.title: Live From Lanford
programme.desc: The Conners share their differing takes on why they all think everyone should vote; Louise gets an opportunity that might send her away from Lanford, prompting the family to interfere in Dan's complicated relationship.

programme.title: Brothers, Babies and Breakdowns

programme.title: Bad Dads and Grads

programme.title: Beards, Thrupples and Robots

programme.title: Tats and Tias

programme.title: The Icewoman Cometh
programme.desc: Bev is back from Arizona and realizes she'd like to use her finances to spread happiness; Bev decides to fund Mark's tuition to a prestigious coding camp, but Darlene tries to convince her to give the money to Harris instead.

programme.title: Pilot Lights & Sister Fights

programme.title: Birthdays, Babies and Emotional Support Chickens

programme.title: Friends in High Places and Horse Surgery

programme.title: A Cold Mom, a Brother Daddy and a Prison Baby

programme.title: Young Love, Old Lions and Middle-Aged Hyenas

programme.title: A.K.A Cassius Clay
programme.desc: A look at the incredible life and achievements of one of the most courageous, outspoken and charismatic figures of boxing: Muhammad Ali.

programme.title: The Jackie Robinson Story
programme.desc: By playing hard and overcoming unbelievable odds, Jackie proved that he was not only one of the best players to set foot on a major league diamond, but also one of the bravest men ever to grace American sports!

programme.title: Amazing Grace (1974)
programme.desc: Pious, church-going widow and grandma Grace (Jackie "Moms" Mabley) has a mouth that could take on the devil himself and the resolve to smack down an even bigger evil: politics!

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: When wild child Anna Lucasta (Eartha Kitt) is thrown out of the house by her self-righteous father, she falls into the life of prostitution... and into the arms of street-wise sailor Danny Johnson (Sammy Davis, Jr.).

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Fed up with patriarch Mr. John Henry Brooks Jr.'s tyrannical rule, Mrs. Brooks and the kids are fighting back!

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: A straight-laced and successful executive's world is turned upside-down when he discovers the 17-year-old son he never knew he had: Roger (Denzel Washington in his feature film debut)!

programme.title: A Family Thing
programme.desc: When Earl (Robert Duvall) learns he has a Black half-brother (James Earl Jones) in Chicago, he heads north.

programme.title: Holiday Heart
programme.desc: Holiday (Ving Rhames), a choirmaster by day and a talented female impersonator by night, is lonely and grieving the death of his lover...until he befriends a bright young girl and her drug-addicted mother (Alfre Woodard).

programme.title: What's The Worst That Could Happen?
programme.desc: Martin Lawrence and Danny DeVito escalate a battle of egos to epic proportions in this hilarious comedy.

programme.title: Soul Plane
programme.desc: An all star comedy cast are ready to board the newest airline -- one that gives "fly" a whole new meaning!

programme.title: Jason's Lyric
programme.desc: Two inner city youths (Allan Payne, Jada Pinkett) find love amidst the violence around them and dream of a better life away from the slick ghetto streets of Houston.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones (1958)
programme.desc: Two convicts on the run are bound together by an unbreakable chain and separated by unbridled hatred.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones (1986)
programme.desc: Two convicts (one black, one white) serving time on a chain gang are set free by an accident. Handcuffed together, they flee into treacherous swampland hunted by helicopter and bloodhound teams.

programme.title: The Angel Levine
programme.desc: When a Jewish tailor (Zero Mostel) decides to give up on God, a mysterious man (Harry Belafonte) appears, claiming to be his Jewish guardian angel!

programme.title: Sheba, Baby
programme.desc: Pam Grier plays Sheba Shayne, a private eye who is called back to her hometown to stop the local mob boss from moving in on her father's loan business.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: A photojournalist Friday Foster (Pam Grier) witnesses the attempted assassination of a prominent African-American figure. Now she is a target!

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: In this powerful drama, respected teacher Quincy Davis accepts an offer to become Vice Principal of an inner-city school poised to be integrated.

programme.title: Fame (2009)
programme.desc: An inspiring story of a group of dancers, singers, musicians and actors at the NYC School of Performing Arts.

programme.title: Barbershop (2002)
programme.desc: Ice Cube headlines a stellar cast this hit comedy about a southside Chicago barbershop.

programme.title: Barbershop 2: Back In Business
programme.desc: The buzz is back in this hit sequel! Calvin (Ice Cube) is struggling to keep his father's shop alive, competing with a name-brand chain opening up next door! Queen Latifah, Eve, Michael Ealy, Troy Garity and Cedric The Entertainer co-star.

programme.title: Beauty Shop
programme.desc: When her egotistical boss pushes her a hair too far, top stylist Gina decides to open her own beauty shop with an eccentric group of stylists!

programme.title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
programme.desc: A slick comedy that blows the 70s Blaxploitation movies right out of the hood! A decorated war hero, returns to the ghetto and enlist an army of original gangstas to clean it up in this mixture of nostalgia, silliness and unpredictable humor.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Struggling actor Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) dreams of landing a role, but soon learns you have to "dream" up your own roles. Keenen Ivory Wayans and Anne-Marie Johnson also star.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African American horror film.

programme.title: Scream, Blacula, Scream!
programme.desc: Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: A boxer on-the-rise is asked to throw a fight by the local mob that has figured prominently in his success.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programme.desc: Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.

programme.title: Bucktown
programme.desc: Fred Williamson and Pam Grier star in this tense action drama about a man who comes to Bucktown to bury his slain brother.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, the black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. Three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk that could either bring down the Cuban Mafia or get the two killed.

programme.title: Gang Related
programme.desc: Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw 3D
programme.desc: Decades ago, residents of Newt, Texas, long suspected that the Sawyer family was responsible for the disappearances of many people. When their suspicions finally were confirmed, vigilantes torched the Sawyer compound and killed every member of the family -- or so they thought. Much later, a young woman named Heather (Alexandra Daddario) learns that she has inherited Texas property from an unknown relative, and she is unaware of horrors that await in the mansion's dank cellar.

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: Each week Kable, a death-row inmate, battles his fellow prisoners in a violent online game called "Slayers," his every move controlled by a young gamer's remote device. To the players, Kable and the other inmates are just simulated characters. But, to a resistance group that opposes the game's inventor, Kable is a critical component of their plan to end the inventor's form of high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Punisher: War Zone
programme.desc: Frank Castle, aka The Punisher (Ray Stevenson), turns the streets of New York City red as he wages a one-man war against the crime syndicate responsible for the death of his wife and two kids. Aided by his trusted sidekick, Microchip (Wayne Knight), he almost kills Billy Russoti (Dominic West) and leaves him horribly disfigured. Billy renames himself Jigsaw and with the help of his crazed brother Loony Bin Jim, recruits criminals from every corner of the city to do battle with Frank.

programme.title: Borderlands
programme.desc: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Mega City One is a vast, violent metropolis where felons rule the streets. The only law lies with cops called "judges," who act as judge, jury and executioner, and Dredd (Karl Urban) is one of the city's most feared. One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

Aided by his trusted sidekick, Microchip (Wayne Knight), he almost kills Billy Russoti (Dominic West) and leaves him horribly disfigured. Billy renames himself Jigsaw and with the help of his crazed brother Loony Bin Jim, recruits criminals from every corner of the city to do battle with Frank.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Separated from their father (Michael Kelly), two teenage sisters (Sofia Black-D'Elia, Analiegh Tipton) try to survive an apocalyptic viral outbreak that leads to a quarantine.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programme.desc: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: Ten years ago, an inexperienced coal miner named Tom Hanniger caused an accident that killed five men and put a sixth, Harry Warden, into a coma. A year later, on Valentine's Day, Harry woke up and murdered 22 people with a pickaxe before dying. Now Tom has returned home, still haunted by the past. And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.

programme.title: Nurse
programme.desc: A young nurse (Katrina Bowden) begins to suspect that a sexy colleague (Paz de la Huerta) is responsible for murdering a string of unfaithful men.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Separated from their father (Michael Kelly), two teenage sisters (Sofia Black-D'Elia, Analiegh Tipton) try to survive an apocalyptic viral outbreak that leads to a quarantine.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself.

An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.desc: Ten years ago, an inexperienced coal miner named Tom Hanniger caused an accident that killed five men and put a sixth, Harry Warden, into a coma. A year later, on Valentine's Day, Harry woke up and murdered 22 people with a pickaxe before dying. Now Tom has returned home, still haunted by the past. And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.

programme.title: Nurse
programme.desc: A young nurse (Katrina Bowden) begins to suspect that a sexy colleague (Paz de la Huerta) is responsible for murdering a string of unfaithful men.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Separated from their father (Michael Kelly), two teenage sisters (Sofia Black-D'Elia, Analiegh Tipton) try to survive an apocalyptic viral outbreak that leads to a quarantine.

programme.title: Iron Mask
programme.desc: To save his homeland from certain doom, a kung fu master must escape from the maniacal James Hook in order to send his daughter a secret talisman that will allow her to control a massive and mythical dragon.

programme.title: Hirokin
programme.desc: A warrior (Wes Bentley) leads an uprising against the ruler (Julian Sands) of a planet.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: Highlander II: Renegade Version
programme.desc: In this sci-fi/fantasy sequel, Connor MacLeod (Christopher Lambert) has become an elderly man after losing his immortality. Living in a bleak future where the world is protected from solar radiation by a massive shield, MacLeod regains his youth when he kills two assassins from his home planet. This results in an ongoing battle with the villainous and powerful Gen. Katana (Michael Ironside), but MacLeod receives help when the noble Juan Ramirez (Sean Connery) returns.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: While battling a trio of rampaging giants, the legendary half-demon Hellboy encounters Nimue the Blood Queen, an ancient resurrected sorceress who's out to avenge a past betrayal. Suddenly caught in a clash between the supernatural and the human, Hellboy soon becomes hell-bent on stopping Nimue without triggering the end of the world.

programme.title: Nazi Concentration Camps
programme.desc: This film is the official documentary report compiled from over 80,000 feet of film shot by Allied military photographers in the German concentration camps immediately after liberation. The footage is a camp-by-camp record taken in order to provide lasting objective proof of the horrors the liberators witnessed. Some emphasis is also placed on the humanitarian work done in camps by the liberators.

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: By 1942, Soviet industry-rebuilt in the east-fueled the Red Army with mass-produced tanks, planes, and weapons, reversing the tide at Stalingrad. But while the war economy thrived, civilians starved under famine and rationing. With Allied aid and relentless sacrifice, the USSR rose as an industrial giant-at a staggering human cost.

programme.title: The Reason Why
programme.desc: The first program looks at the reasons behind the war, and why Britain allied itself against Imperial Russia.

programme.title: Blitzed: Nazis on Drugs
programme.desc: In 1938 a drug called Pervitin was created in Nazi Germany. This drug was distributed to German soldiers during the course of WW2 and Hitler was no exception to these drug highs receiving drug cocktails from his personal physical Theodor Morell. This film explores the use of drugs in WW2 and looks at the potential effects that drugs could have had on Hitler, soldiers and the war itself.

programme.title: The Normandy Campaign
programme.desc: From the hedgerows of Normandy to the liberation of Paris, this episode retraces the 100 critical days after D-Day. Witness the fierce battles, the resilience of soldiers, and the toll on civilians as the Allies push through German defenses, paving the way for Europe's liberation and altering the course of World War II.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries: 1940
programme.desc: In '1940,' we follow Hitler's trail of occupation into Denmark and Norway, the invasion of Belgium and France & the Miracle Of Dunkirk where Churchill initiated Operation Dynamo to rescue the thousands of BEF that were stranded & helpless on the beaches under relentless Nazi attack. See how Hitler's Blitzkrieg ripped through France and how the British survive The Blitz & win the Battle Of Britain.

programme.title: The Siege of Leningrad
programme.desc: Leningrad, a vital and large Baltic sea port, is facing the entire weight of Army Group North. The Soviets have no reserves to spare as the Battle of Moscow is about to begin. Wilhelm von Leeb's Army Group North fails to take Leningrad, but begins a horrible siege that will last 872 days, in which over a million civilians will die of starvation and disease.

programme.title: Ma Horner
programme.desc: This is the story of a young apple-cheeked Sergeant nick-named 'Ma' by his men because of his protective nature toward their scouting unit. It is also the tale of Pat Cassidy, a looter of watches and wine and a member of Horner's unit. How these two opposites combine their talents to single-handedly capture a German-held land mine control center, makes a spellbinding, action-packed episode.

programme.title: The Atom Strikes
programme.desc: First experimental blast set off in New Mexico; bombing and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: Hitler: A Strategy of Failure
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler, considered himself to be the world's greatest military strategist - superior even to Napoleon Bonaparte - and early Blitzkrieg successes could be said to easily confirm this assertion. So why did the Nazis lose the war? Hitler also made colossal strategic military blunders: Dunkirk, Operation Barbarossa and many others that were ultimately a strategy of failure.

programme.title: The Reason Why
programme.desc: The first program looks at the reasons behind the war, and why Britain allied itself against Imperial Russia.

programme.title: Death in the Bunker
programme.desc: Death In The Bunker: The True Story of Hitler's Downfall examines the final 10 days in the Berlin Führerbunker deep below the Chancellery of the Reich. Includes interviews with Hitler's confidants and eyewitnesses including Hitler's Secretary Traudl Junge who after typing out Hitler's will, remained in the bunker until his death. Learn firsthand what happened in the bunker right to the very end.

programme.title: Big Picture: The Army Medical Corps
programme.desc: Graphically shown here is the treatment given our wounded in battle. We see the care a man receives from medics all along the line; from the time the wounded soldier calls 'Medic' until he is released for duty. The Medical Corps is saving more lives than in any other time of combat. Lieutenant Colonel S. J. Newsom of San Diego, California tells the story in an interview with Captain Zimmerman.

programme.title: Partners, Plans, and Provisions
programme.desc: In the pacific, in Europe, and on the continents of Africa and Asia, every branch of the air services now forms close partnerships with the other branches of the armed forces. The roles of transport and supply must now be balanced with combat, and the Army Air Force focuses on protecting allied interests on land and across the oceans.

programme.title: Nazi Concentration Camps
programme.desc: This film is the official documentary report compiled from over 80,000 feet of film shot by Allied military photographers in the German concentration camps immediately after liberation. The footage is a camp-by-camp record taken in order to provide lasting objective proof of the horrors the liberators witnessed. Some emphasis is also placed on the humanitarian work done in camps by the liberators.

programme.title: Shackled
programme.desc: Historians call the December 1950 evacuation from Hungnam in North Korea 'The greatest evacuation movement by sea in U.S. military history'.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was fought for the defense of democracy. Ten long years of vicious combat - including the Tet Offensive and bloodshed at Hue and Saigon - permanently embedded the Vietnam War in the American consciousness.

programme.title: Kuwait
programme.desc: The war really begins from the moment Saddam Hussein, the president of Iraq, launches his troops into Kuwait. These are spearheaded by 100,000 of his republican guard. Supported by helicopter gunships, armored personnel carriers, mobile artillery and tanks.

programme.title: Autopsy of a Mass Murder
programme.desc: On 20 November 1945, the trial of the top brass of the Third Reich, including Göring, opened in Nuremberg, the city where the anti-Jewish laws were drawn up in 1935. One year later, the international military tribunal sentenced 12 of the accused to death, and seven to jail. Some Jewish witnesses testified, and only Hans Frank, the Governor General of Poland, acknowledged the persecution of Jews.

programme.title: The War at Sea
programme.desc: The Navy copes with supply shortages.

programme.title: Hitler's Evil Scientists
programme.desc: It is a word that sends a chill down the spine: 'Ahnenerbe'. This was the name of the research institute set up to prove the scientific foundation of Nazi ideology. Driven by a scientific megalomania, the race for new discoveries led the institution to carry out countless acts of barbarism.

programme.title: The Tide Begins to Turn: October-December 1942
programme.desc: As 1942 drew to a close, the Allies were really beginning to make headway. The British made a crucial breakthrough in North Africa, and the Americans pushed the Japanese out of Burma and New Guinea. In Russia the Germans found themselves surrounded.

programme.title: Facing the Music: January-March 1943
programme.desc: The only option for the German Sixth Army at Stalingrad was surrender, while all across Russia the Red Army consolidated their advantage. Also, as German cities encountered the kind of bombing that Britain faced back in 1940, courtesy of the RAF.

programme.title: Gateway to Victory
programme.desc: The aerial and amphibious assault on the beaches of Normandy and the allied convoys landing on the Normandy beaches. Shows Gens. Eisenhower and Montgomery and Adm. Sir Bertram Ramsey.

programme.title: Desert Shield
programme.desc: With the Iraqi invasion of Kuwait a great confrontation began. A host of forces around the world were deployed against the Iraqi army. This video ordinance program looks at the weapons of operation Desert Shield.

programme.title: We Strike Back
programme.desc: Pearl Harbor day has etched itself in our history. The entire nation was motivated in a fighting fury. We will see the Japanese seize Hong Kong, Singapore, Philippines, and the Dutch East Indies. General McArthur is profiled.

programme.title: Bandits at Three O'clock
programme.desc: The speed of sound had probably been broken before by several Second World War aircraft. Some British and American fighters may have unintentionally exceeded the speed of sound in an evasive dive. In November 1945, a British jet fighter the Gloster Meteor set a new official world speed record of 606.25 mph. Two years later the sound barrier was broken by an American aircraft, the Bell X-1.

programme.title: Beachhead and Breakthrough
programme.desc: Eisenhower inspects the landing beaches and we see the 'Mulberry' harbors put in place along the Normandy beaches. Airfields are built and supplies are offloaded. V-1 rockets attack London. We see the Germans build V-2 rockets. Storms wreck a Mulberry harbor and damage the other. Cherbourg is taken but is wrecked by the Germans. The British and Canadians work to take Caen.

programme.title: Heinrich Himmler
programme.desc: The Occult Roots of the Third Reich. The creator of the infamous Gestapo, the Waffen SS and the concentration camp network. Perhaps the strangest individual of all the Nazi crew. Himmler was inspired by mystic visions, runes, horoscopes and a longing for a heroic German past.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode, the pilots of a Soviet aviation regiment face challenges during World War II. They engage in combat, search for a downed German pilot, and receive a new recruit. The episode explores the camaraderie and determination of the pilots in the face of adversity.

programme.title: The Cold War
programme.desc: The Cold War sheds a new light on the clandestine wars fought between the US and the Soviet Union. This documentary takes us across the world in the turbulent 50s, 60s and 70s: an era of spies, secrets and lies. Thanks to recently disclosed images and files from the CIA and Russia's KGB, and with access to rare archive footage, we reveal a clearer picture of what was happening behind the scenes.

programme.title: Vietnam Firefight
programme.desc: In the Vietnam War, flying into jungle produces a different kind of hazard. In a daring rescue mission a desperate pilot cuts his own landing zone in forty foot tall bamboo. They come under heavy fire as they return again and again to pick up more survivors from the bamboo circle.

programme.title: Theater Commanders
programme.desc: Outstanding military Naval leaders, soldiers, sailors, and marines are discussed and the Theater commanders of General Dwight D. Eisenhower are also discussed.

programme.title: Victory
programme.desc: Monash takes up the challenge of vigorous pursuit of the Germans and in one day advance 10 kilometres and takes two and a half thousand prisoners - one week later the war is over.

programme.title: Little Private
programme.desc: Nothing prepares soldiers to be surrounded by enemy tanks and infantry. When tasked with defending a recently captured town in Bastogne, Belgium, Joe's aging platoon awoke to find themselves surrounded, outnumbered and outgunned. His platoon dumbfounded; Private Joseph Richardson took matters into his own hands. Grasping a bazooka Joe sought to break up the German counterattack.

programme.title: 1944 - Ardennes' Battle/Battle of the Bulge
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Ardennes massif that will take place one of the bloodiest battles of the Second World War. A few days before Christmas, 500,000 Germans are preparing to stampede on the allied forces stationed in the sector. In the early hours of the assault on December 16th, 1944, the American forces are taken by surprise. Discover what actually happened in Ardennes in the winter 1944.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Makeev's team rescues Smereko from the chemical test site; he survived with a stolen protective mask and reports mass poisonings, including women and children. Zvonareva urges aerial destruction, but Nenarokov demands firmer proof. Shevchenko proposes a risky low pass over the warm-spring lake to drop scouts into the water without parachutes.

programme.title: Hitler's Eastern Front: Army Group North
programme.desc: As Europe staggered toward war, Stalin saw opportunity to gain territory for Russia and stand apart from imperialist conflict between Britain, France and Germany. He abandoned cooperation from western pals. By agreeing to share polish territory between the 3rd Reich and the Soviet Union after invasion, Hitler kept the Russians at bay on his eastern borders to devote attention to war with the west.

programme.title: Big Picture: The 7th Infantry in Korea
programme.desc: At the end of World War 2 the 7th accepted Japanese surrender in Korea. In 1950 they return to the new war.

programme.title: One Demerit to Go
programme.desc: On the brink of failure, many give up but some fight twice as hard. Establishing a military academy in Munich, the Seventh Army trained non-commissioned officers. One of these students, Sgt. Leon Carroll had, to this point, received twenty demerits. He mobilized all his intelligence and leadership to complete his course avoiding the final demerit which would result in discharge.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: At an airfield, Ivan, a new recruit, meets Lyudmila, a skilled pilot concealing an ailment. She mentors him as Lenya, the strict trainer, pushes Martynov, a rebellious trainee. When scouts go missing, aerial battles ensue, forging deep bonds, and unveiling secrets. Amidst peril and personal struggles, they find courage, love, and hope.

programme.title: Victory at Last
programme.desc: The victories at Manila and Okinawa are discussed.

programme.title: Bloody Iwo
programme.desc: To help their long-range bombers over Japan, the Allied forces need the island of Iwo Jima, but face strong Japanese resistance on the beach.

programme.title: Atomic Test at the Bikini
programme.desc: No event in the history of cinema had ever been so thoroughly covered. Why so many cameras and equipment to film two atomic explosions just after the end of the Second World War ? Moreover, what's the relationship between atomic testing and the famous bathing suit?

programme.title: Bonhoeffer Agent of Grace
programme.desc: The story of Dietrich Bonhoeffer, a German clergyman of great distinction, who actively opposed Hitler and the Nazis. His convictions cost him his life.

programme.title: Lull Before the Storm: Between the Wars
programme.desc: Here's a front row seat to Japanese attack on Manchuria and the rise of Hitler and the Nazi Party. As the world was undergoing significant changes so was the military air power.

programme.title: Marines at Tarawa
programme.desc: The 2nd US Marines' bloody assault on Tarawa.

programme.title: The Pacific in Erruption
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at U.S. involvement in the the Pacific theater starting in 1933. It looks at Pearl Harbor, the Burma theater, the Battle of the Coral Sea, the Battle of Midway, the invasion of Iwo Jima and Okinawa, the dropping of the atomic bomb and the surrender of Japan. It also looks at the start of the Korean War.

programme.title: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The outbreak of war in Europe forces the US to review its readiness for war. Whilst the American Air Force recruits and trains, adapting to Germany's new battle tactics, the Empire of Japan creates bring about a global conflict with its surprise attack. Now at war in the east and the west, America's air power must start to push back the forces of aggression.

programme.title: Resistance is Never Futile: April-June 1943
programme.desc: The Polish Jews of the Warsaw Ghetto rose up against their oppressors and although facing the horrors of the Nazi Concentration Camps, German army units were needed to deal with the situation. The French Resistance was also formed.

programme.title: Tentative Steps: July-September 1943
programme.desc: After success in North Africa the Allies returned to occupied Europe, first landing on Sicily before moving north into Italy under command of Montgomery, known fondly by his men as Monty. But as the Italians surrendered, the Germans occupied Rome.

programme.title: The Invasion of France
programme.desc: The Greatest coordination of arms ever portrayed in the world. Every scene made during the greatest victory of Allied power, to date. 11,000 Allied planes plant their tons of pulverizing bombs on shore installations, strategic roads and bridges, then swoop down to strafe enemy trains, ships and planes. The air poundings continue, and the mop-up search for snipers is on. The invasion is successful.

programme.title: Helena Bonham Carter
programme.desc: Helena Bonham Carter's grandparents were unconventional war heroes. They didn't fight in battle, but saved many lives. Helena's maternal grandfather Eduardo Propper de Callejón, a Spanish diplomat who defied his government's orders, helped Jewish people escape the Holocaust. Helena's paternal grandmother Lady Violet Bonham Carter volunteered as an air raid warden and campaigned for women's rights.

programme.title: THE FAMOUS THIRD ARMY
programme.desc: Historical record of the 281 days of the 3rd army offensive through France, Belgium and Germany, with air support from the 19th tactical air command.

programme.title: Sky Blitz
programme.desc: Captured German film of the attack on Holland, May 1940. Paratroopers assemble the planes and head for Moerdijk, Holland, and drop the troops. A field fortification is stormed and a Dutch bunker defending the Moerdijk Bridge is attacked and captured. Mines are removed from the bridge. The bridge is shelled by Dutch artillery. German planes are directed to targets by signal panels.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The U-Boat War
programme.desc: Twenty years after Kaiser Wilhem's exile in 1919, the German navy, Kriegsmarine, had once again grown into a powerful weapon, nurtured this time by Hitler's Third Reich. By 1939, Germany was eager and ready to wipe out the stain in her naval history. They possessed a terrifying weapon to make sure Hitler's victory and vision was realized, especially over Great Britain. The U-Boat.

programme.title: 1944 - Hitler Youth Strike Back
programme.desc: June 6, 1944, at dawn, 156,000 men are preparing to disembark with five objectives of the Normandy coast. This is Operation Overlord. Among them, combatants which we often forget about their active participation in the liberation of Europe... These are the 15,000 Canadians of the 3rd Infantry Division. They must arrive on a beach five miles wide, code name: Juno.

programme.title: Infantry Firepower
programme.desc: Documentary looking at the weapons used by infantry soldiers in the Second World War. Includes such weapons as the mortar, the landmine, the bazooka and the hand grenade. The programme features graphics, animation, archive footage and interviews with expert Robin Clifton.

programme.title: The Graves
programme.desc: The armies of the Third Reich invaded the USSR on June 22, 1941. Mobile commandos, the Einsatzgruppen, were following their advance to Stalingrad with the mission of eliminating all Jews on the conquered territories.

programme.title: Vietnam Peace Negotiations
programme.desc: 27 January 1973. After five years of negotiations in Paris, the Americans and the Vietnamese made peace, in what had been a difficult process.

programme.title: Daily Bread
programme.desc: The most fundamental need of any society is a reliable food supply. During WW2, every combatant nation introduced some form of rationing - but that was only the start of the business of keeping the population fed.

programme.title: Part 1 - The Invasion
programme.desc: The series begins with the German invasion of Poland on September 1, 1939, a surprise attack that ignited the Second World War. This episode explores the swift and brutal tactics of Blitzkrieg, the political miscalculations of European leaders, and the failure of appeasement. Through rare footage and expert analysis, we witness how the seeds of global conflict were sown.

programme.title: The Battle of the Atlantic
programme.desc: The struggle to control the Atlantic and maintain the Allies supply chain in WWII.

programme.title: Holding On
programme.desc: The arrival of the 1st Provisional Marine Brigade in August 1950 bolstered the U.S. forces in the Pusan perimeter. The attacking North Korean army was stalled in the attempt to overrun the perimeter.

programme.title: I'm Alright 1932 - 1933
programme.desc: In different ways, in different places, new leaders take centre stage: Hitler in Germany, Roosevelt in the US. Militarism triumphs in Japan, which consolidates its invasion of China's north east. By the time the offices of president and chancellor have been combined into a single Fuhrer, Hitler has achieved absolute power in a one-party state without acting unconstitutionally.

programme.title: The Iraq War
programme.desc: Precision airstrikes have become the big stick of international relations. When diplomacy fails and military action is chosen, the missile armed strike aircraft is at the center of combat. Many nations deploy advanced jet aircrafts and high-tech missiles, but only one has the broad range of technologies and forces to deploy such weapons on a global scale, the United States.

programme.title: War of Korea: On to the Yalu
programme.desc: This episode dramatically details the outbreak of the world's first jet war. On June 24, 1950, Communist North Korea invaded her sister to the south, forcing a war. Within days, America had F-80s knocking out Communist supply lines.

programme.title: The Time of Revolts
programme.desc: Stalin's death in 1953 unleashes revolt: Berlin workers strike, Hungary rises in 1956, and Khrushchev's denunciation stirs hope. But Soviet tanks crush uprisings, leaving repression harsher than ever. People live double lives-outwardly loyal, privately critical. In 1961, the Berlin Wall seals the Iron Curtain, trapping Eastern Europe in Moscow's grip.

programme.title: Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The ultimate test of tank technology is the battlefield. American tanks form the sharp end of the sword in Desert Storm. The U.S. marine corp was still using the older M-60 tank, although with some modifications.

programme.title: THE NAZI CONCENTRATION CAMPS
programme.desc: This film was made by the U.S. Army and directed by George Stevens. As the Allies reached Germany, General Eisenhower ordered George Stevens to film the concentration camps. The camps are filmed and survivors interviewed. This film was evidence at the Nuremberg Trials.

programme.title: Mushrooms
programme.desc: Buckwheat crêpes filled with a mushroom mixture; vegetarian mushroom ragù served on rigatoni; French mushroom soup; mushroom risotto made with farro.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: Traditional turkey; roasting turkey in parchment paper; braising turkey legs; roasted rolled turkey breast with herbs.

programme.title: Everything's Coming Up Turkeys
programme.desc: From cranberry sauce to buttery rolls to incredible chocolates, Martha is shaping everything this holiday into a turkey; it all comes together on a beautifully festive dining table.

programme.title: The Perfect Thanksgiving Turkey Three Ways
programme.desc: Martha makes Thanksgiving turkeys three ways; she goes step-by-step through her roast turkey stuffed with classic stuffing, a herb-roasted spatchcocked bird and a deep-fried, herb-rubbed turkey.

programme.title: Spectacular Thanksgiving Sides
programme.desc: Martha's Thanksgiving side dishes.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Countdown (Cranberry Glazed Turk)
programme.desc: Cranberry-cornbread stuffing; stocking the bar; almond tart; cranberry glaze; cranberry-glazed turkey.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Countdown (Parker House Rolls)
programme.desc: Corn-husk votive holder; Parker House rolls; pork scaloppine with orange sauce; cleaning crystal; endive and pomegranate salad; currant cake.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Prep: Turkey; Stuffing; Gravy; Decorations
programme.desc: Thanksgiving prep; preparing the turkey; making stuffing; gravy; holiday decorations.

programme.title: Martha's Thanksgiving Pies
programme.desc: Every year, Martha makes pies to give to everyone working on the farm during the holiday, and this year she's sharing three of her delicious recipes.

programme.title: Thanksgiving With a Southern Twist
programme.desc: Martha invites her long-time friend and former catering partner, Sara Foster to Bedford to cook up a Southern-style Thanksgiving meal.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Pies

programme.desc: Arleashoan Davis loves to cook, go to church, and spend time with her son. Having fallen on hard times in her life, she's been assisted by Family Promise of Lower Cape Fear and now lives in a house that needs extensive outdoor improvement. The yard gets a serious makeover, complete with leisure furniture, while inside the house, an antiquated washer/dryer is replaced. Some delightful surprises are provided to both mother and son.

programme.title: Dad Wants Son to Be a Man
programme.desc: Dwayne sues his 19-year-old son, Jason, for money to pay rent and bills. Dwayne says he's fed up with Jason's lack of respect and responsibilities around the house.

programme.title: Season 1, Paranormal Truth 103: Devil Worship
programme.desc: From vampires, exorcisms, devil worship to supernatural hauntings. Each episode will take you behind the myths and realities of these subjects. With interviews from leading investigators around the world.

programme.desc: If you remove oil, cheese, alcohol and meat, what's left? Anna and Kristina test this bestselling lifestyle cookbook to see if this spare fare tempts the palette of diet and exercise guru Harley Pasternak.

programme.title: Whitewater Cooks With Friends
programme.desc: Anna and Kristina indulge in the sweet, fresh taste of summer with a menu including gazpacho with Dungeness crab and pacific sashimi towers. Will this meal have summer sizzle or are storm clouds moving in?

programme.title: Applegate River Lodge
programme.desc: Gordon visits Applegate, Oregon, to try to rescue the failing Applegate River Lodge. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Applegate's owner, Richard Davis, is more interested in smoking cannabis in his "Butt Hut".

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: This reality series follows six women immersed in dancehall culture as they navigate friendships, rivalries, and personal ambitions within a dynamic and competitive scene.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: This reality series follows six women immersed in dancehall culture as they navigate friendships, rivalries, and personal ambitions within a dynamic and competitive scene.

programme.title: Toy Time
programme.desc: A garage stuffed with vintage toys could mean big bucks. Lionel train sets have sold for as much as $250,000, so how much will Kraig get for the set he's discovered? His crew also finds a vintage Barbie playhouse, an Austin Healey roadster and a Yankee Clipper. But a set of vintage Ford dog dish hubcaps surprises Kraig when he discovers their value.

programme.title: Top of the World
programme.desc: The Electra flies to Alert, the northernmost settlement on Earth, forcing Adam and new senior manager Duane to work things out.

programme.title: Wind Turbine Towers, Rockwool, Locomotive
programme.desc: An inside look at the largest freight operator.

programme.title: Storm Front
programme.desc: Crews search for vessels in distress overtaken by powerful storms, a sailboat calls for help, and a rookie rescue swimmer gets his first case.

programme.title: Cry Baby Gallery & Project Gigglewater (Toronto)
programme.desc: Welcome to Toronto's Cry Baby Gallery. Kyle joins bartender Yuri Kuroiwa to sample their famous Zombie cocktail. It is a cocktail with many different flavours, a perfect mix of sweet, sour and spicy. Kyle savours other top cocktails before making his way to Project Gigglewater where Kyle meets owner Andrew Siu and samples classic tequila-based cocktails and tropical drinks.

programme.title: Jamwest
programme.desc: Normally Negril, Jamaica is a tranquil oasis, but when the Caribbean Motor Racing Championship comes to town, soothing is replaced with speeding. Bragging rights are up for grabs in a showdown between the top racers from Trinidad, Guyana, Jamaica and Barbados.

programme.title: The Haunted Savannah Theatre
programme.desc: Connor and India travel to Savannah, GA to investigate the haunted historic Savannah Theatre. With three ghosts said to roam the building, the duo use three different paranormal investigation methods in an attempt to contact them.

programme.title: The Haunting At The Abbey
programme.desc: Connor and India's paranormal adventures take them to a haunted monastery in the state of Colorado. What happens behind Connor in the basement? Did a spirit communicate with India on the building's most haunted floor? Do the nuns and monks still roam the hallways? Watch to find out what lurks in the dark at The Holly Cross at The Abbey.

programme.title: White Collar Crime
programme.desc: A middle-class suburban housewife is forced to sell the family home and start over when her husband is sentenced for multi-million dollar fraud.

programme.title: Bridal Sweets

programme.title: Between a Crock and Hard Place

programme.title: Preggers Can't Be Choosers
programme.desc: At a surprise baby shower for Kendra, she tells her friends and family that she's pregnant.

programme.title: Haunted Crank Caves

programme.title: The Jersey Devil, Alien Big Cats, and Chupacabras

programme.desc: Holly comes face to face with Hef and his new fiancée Crystal Harris

programme.title: The Trouble With Angel

As it's been 6 hours and she still can't bear weight on it. the concern is that Natasha has a fracture.

programme.title: In a Marathon Minute

programme.desc: Tech entrepreneurs present game-changing ventures to the 'Killer Whales,' elite judges, competing for $1,500,000 in prizes. Success could supercharge their startups, but they must thrive in this relentless sink-or-swim arena.

Bartender Stewart Hawthorne introduces Kyle to some very original exotic cocktails.

programme.desc: Half of the 14 all-star cowboys have been eliminated. The remaining seven contestants must demonstrate skill and grit in a grueling relay race made up of a series of cowboy challenges. Host Trace Adkins and his expert judges send another cowboy home.

programme.desc: Eileen is suing her son, Ramund, for the money she says he owes her for unpaid utilities, school tuition and fines for violating their homeowner's rules.

programme.title: Pet Cancer

programme.desc: Bobbie grapples with her tell-all book deal amid Jani Lane's death. Comfort from Sharise and Athena clashes with Blue's barbs, sparking heated confrontations that reveal cracks in the Ex-Wives' bonds.

programme.title: Cuando sabes lo que siembras no le tienes miedo a la cosecha
programme.desc: Los padres de dos jóvenes sufren una accidente donde fallece su madre y su padre queda inválido. Uno de los jóvenes acepta la propuesta de su tío para robar y obtener dinero fácil, mientras que el otro comienza a trabajar en un taller.

programme.title: Para qué te metes de payaso si no aguantas las carcajadas
programme.desc: Chicharito tiene 15 años y lleva una doble vida, por la mañana va a la secundaria y por la tarde trabaja de payaso. Mena, niña de 15 años, casi es atropellada por mirar el celular. Chicharito se da cuenta y en una hábil maniobra la salva.

programme.title: El hábito no hace al monje, pero lo distingue
programme.desc: Una joven tiene que vivir con su padre y su madrastra tras la muerte de su madre, su actitud frente a la vida es de sufrimiento y opta por no estudiar, ni trabajar, pero al conocer un joven que perdió las ganas de vivir, logrará ver la realidad.

programme.title: Donde fuego se hace, humo sale
programme.desc: Por culpa de la vida sexual de su padre, la madre, el novio y una compañera de la escuela de Margarita terminan contagiados de SIDA.

programme.title: Al peligro con tiento y al remedio con tiempo
programme.desc: Lucía es una adolescente que vive con su mamá, pero ella es tan estricta que prefiere vivir con su papá. Sin embargo, no imagina que él aún está en el tiempo de la fiesta y las mujeres.

programme.title: A fácil perdón, frecuente ladrón
programme.desc: Una mujer sufre un asalto y su pareja le aconseja que vaya a poner una denuncia, pero ella teme hacerlo. La policía logra atrapar al ladrón que asaltó a la mujer, pero por falta de pruebas queda libre.

programme.title: Quien no cree a buena madre, cree a mala madrastra
programme.desc: Sonia es una mujer enamorada de Samuel; él decide tener una relación con Vania, una mujer vividora que solo lo quiere por su dinero y pretende robarle todo.

programme.title: La nueva dueña
programme.desc: Los López se preocupan porque la nueva dueña del edificio correrá a las familias que excedan de cuatro integrantes. Plácido le explica el porqué son 10.

programme.title: Mala suerte
programme.desc: La dueña del edificio comunica a los López que subirá la renta, pero Plácido por andar apostando, no tiene dinero para pagar. Los López consiguen dinero como pueden.

programme.title: Limitados
programme.desc: Plácido implementa un plan de austeridad en su casa para ahorrar, pero todo lo juega en sorteos. De pronto se entera de que se ganó un automóvil, pero no tiene teléfono para hacer la llamada y reclamarlo.

programme.title: Orígenes
programme.desc: Licha interroga a Adolfo y por fin se entera de dónde viene el novio de La Nena. Mientras tanto Martina hace una obra de caridad, convirtiendo a Tecla en una chica agradable.

programme.title: El secreto
programme.desc: Martina escucha que La Nena tiene novio y la chantajea con decirle a la familia si no obedece sus órdenes. Cansada de los abusos decide hablar con la familia.

programme.title: El novio
programme.desc: Lichita lleva semanas sin hablarle a la Nena porque tiene novio y le exige que termine su relación. Renata propone que hagan una comida para que puedan conocer al novio de la Nena.

programme.title: Prueba de embarazo
programme.desc: Nena averigua que ella está embarazada.

programme.title: Votación
programme.desc: Adolfo se niega a ayudar con la manutención del hogar de la familia López y se lleva a La Nena a vivir a una comuna. La familia al extrañar a La Nena propone un acuerdo.

programme.title: La casa del millón
programme.desc: Esteban Arce contacta a Plácido para que concurse por una enorme casa libre de impuestos. Los López tendrán que contestar a cinco preguntas, sin embargo, como en la última se tardan, pierden el premio. Aun así, reciben una sorpresa.

programme.title: El regreso
programme.desc: La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.

programme.title: Los muebles
programme.desc: Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.

programme.title: A trabajar todos
programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: La venta del edificio
programme.desc: El administrador del edificio notifica a la familia López la venta del edificio donde viven, por lo que deben desalojar el departamento en menos de 24 horas, ya que un nuevo supermercado será construido ahí.

programme.title: Ahí va el agua
programme.desc: La familia López es notificada de que se les cortará el servicio del agua en su departamento. Los miembros de la familia intentan averiguar quién es el responsable de que les hayan retirado el servicio del agua.

programme.title: Tome su turno
programme.desc: Plácido expresa ante su familia su sentir acerca de la falta de intimidad que existe en su hogar. La nueva dinámica para poder vivir en casa de los López es aportar dinero, de lo contrario deben tomar su turno para poder residir ahí.

programme.title: El embarazo no deseado
programme.desc: La familia López se reúne con Tecla para que confiese la verdad sobre su embarazo. Tecla admite que lo hizo porque le gustó y reitera que lo volvería hacer. Tecla confiesa que fue con Adolfo y que fueron tres veces.
