programme.title: El socio
programme.desc: Plácido se preocupa por una llamada de Don Justo y le expresa a su familia que tendrá una reunión con su jefe. Don Justo va a nombrar socio a quien le tenga su café caliente.

programme.title: ¿Quién se comió los tamales?
programme.desc: Se va la luz en el apartamento de la familia López y comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas. Tecla es confundida con un fantasma. Don Arnoldo se da cuenta de que, mientras se fue la luz, han desaparecido sus tamales.

programme.title: Las vacaciones
programme.desc: Plácido y Plutarco se muestran muy contentos ante su familia y explican que Don Justo les ha dado sus primeras vacaciones pagadas. La familia López se organiza para salir juntos de paseo a Pepetongo.

programme.title: El abuelo pierde la memoria
programme.desc: Don Arnoldo, mientras duerme, menciona que tiene un tesoro en el pueblo de Apaseo el Grande, Guanajuato. La familia López implementa un plan para la búsqueda del tesoro.

programme.title: Cartas a la bruja
programme.desc: Plácido es despedido de su trabajo a causa de un incidente de Plutarco con Don Justo. Licha, mientras lee una revista, encuentra un artículo de la bruja Madame Patú, experta en la lectura de cartas.

programme.title: Esperando a Justo
programme.desc: Plácido busca trabajo desesperadamente. El único trabajo que logra encontrar Plácido es vendiendo tamales. Justito invita a su abuelo materno a cenar a su casa. Tecla abandona a la familia López.

programme.title: Cenizas
programme.desc: Licha fallece de manera inesperada y los López organizan un emotivo funeral, donde cumplen su última voluntad con sus cenizas. Llega alguien a la casa que amenaza con quedarse para siempre.

programme.title: El ultimátum
programme.desc: Los López deben tres meses de alquiler y la Chivis los amenaza con el desalojo si no le entregan el dinero en 24 horas. Por otra parte, Carlos, el padre de la Nena, ha regresado con la intención de quedarse.

programme.desc: Doña Romina escucha ruidos extraños en el departamento que ha invadido la familia López, en el que murió don Genaro el mes pasado. Por eso, doña Romina cree que un fantasma habita el lugar.

programme.title: Ácido fólico
programme.desc: Con todas las medicinas que dejó Licha, Justito y Victoria crean un compuesto químico que Plutarco se toma por accidente. La Nena finge estar enferma para quedarse con el cuarto de Gaby.

programme.title: Plácido inactivo
programme.desc: Plácido no encuentra empleo, por lo que prefiere quedarse cómodamente en su sofá, al igual que hace su padre. Plácido exige a los miembros de la familia que atiendan todos sus deseos para no levantarse del sofá, y ellos ya no lo soportan más.

programme.title: Justo para todos
programme.desc: Plácido tiene la posibilidad de recuperar su antiguo trabajo; pero don Justo le señala que ese puesto vacante solo es para Adolfo. Plutarco trabajará como sujeto de prueba de productos milagrosos.

programme.title: Una noche de estreno
programme.desc: Plácido acaba de recordar que es su aniversario de bodas con Renata, por lo que le organizará una cena romántica. Martina invita al cine a la familia a ver el estreno de una película.

programme.title: El yerberito llegó

programme.title: Last Year's Model
programme.desc: Barnaby begins to question the guilt of a Midsomer Malham woman who is on trial for the murder of her best friend. The evidence is stacked against her, but she doesn't appear deluded or obsessed with the dead woman's husband as the prosecution claim. With the help of a frail pensioner - the key witness, can Barnaby and Jones discover what really happened on the night of the murder?

programme.title: Tainted Fruit
programme.desc: When the body of arrogant local beauty Melissa Townsend is discovered by the pool at her manor house, DCI Barnaby uncovers a seedy world of adultery and deceit within the affluent rural community.

programme.title: Ring Out Your Dead
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby investigates the murders of bell ringers from the village church who are being mysteriously murdered one by one. Barnaby and Troy find that they must solve a riddle from the past before the killer strikes again.

programme.title: Murder on St Malley's Day
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby uncovers an elite Mafia-like sect called the Pudding Club at private boys' school Devington College while investigating a murder, and must get to the bottom of the mystery before another victim turns up dead.

programme.title: Market for Murder
programme.desc: When the leader of a reading club used as a cover to run an investment portfolio is found battered to death, the club's secret activities are exposed and long-held secrets and desires return to haunt its members.

programme.title: A Worm in the Bud
programme.desc: When Susan Bartlett's body is discovered in a wood, villagers assume she killed herself because she could not have children. However, when it comes to light that her suicide note - in the form of an email - was sent too late, Barnaby soon finds himself in the midst of witchcraft, ancient potions, infidelity and land feuds.

programme.title: Death's Shadow
programme.desc: The Barnabys plan to renew their wedding vows for their 25th anniversary when Tom is distracted by a murder of a dying man committed with an Indian sword in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: Strangler's Wood
programme.desc: The naked body of a young woman is found strangled in a local woodland nine years after three identical murders took place there. As DCI Barnaby and DS Troy investigate the killings, they are led further and further into the murky, clandestine world of Midsomer Worthy.

programme.title: Beyond the Grave
programme.desc: Mysterious events and the discovery of his relative's body lead the residents of Aspern Tallow to believe that Jonathan Lowrie's ghost is at large in their community. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy attempt to determine whether these strange occurrences are supernatural or if there is a more rational explanation.

programme.title: Blood Will Out
programme.desc: In the sleepy village of Martyr Warren, two opposing groups of travellers have set up home. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy are called in to investigate when the local magistrate, principal adversary of the new arrivals in the village, is found shot dead at his home.

programme.title: The Devil's Work
programme.desc: The demise of the Shirewell patriarch sparks a vicious inheritance dispute when eldest son Lucian announces plans to break up an estate that's been in his family for centuries.

programme.title: Book of the Dead
programme.desc: When the author of a book that sparked a nationwide treasure hunt is found dead, Barnaby and Winter must unravel the cryptic clues to find the killer among a group of dedicated seekers.

programme.title: Claws Out
programme.desc: After a pet detective turns up dead inside the kennel of a dog he was searching for, Barnaby and Winter are drawn into the world of dognapping, cat seduction, and animal investigation.

programme.title: A Climate of Death
programme.desc: Sleepy Goodman's Land is known as the Greenest Village in Midsomer. But when the entire village is bought by a Texas oilman, a string of grisly murders ensues.

programme.title: The Christmas Haunting
programme.desc: It may be Christmas, but Charlie is given no time to familiarise himself with his new surroundings. He finds himself thrown straight into an intriguing mystery in the village of Morton Shallows, as furniture maker and serial philanderer Conor Bridgeman is stabbed to death with an antique sword during a ghost-hunting party at the manor house.

programme.title: Let Us Prey
programme.desc: Barnaby and Nelson investigate a series of murders in Midsomer St Claire. The crimes appear to be inspired by the macabre images on a medieval fresco recently discovered in the church crypt.

programme.title: Wild Harvest
programme.desc: When wealthy farmer Martin Strickland is covered in truffle oil and mauled to death by a wild boar, the investigation leads to restaurant Wyvern House and its tyrannical celebrity chef Ruth Cameron.

programme.title: The Flying Club
programme.desc: The owner of Finchmere Airfield drops dead from a plane. Astonished, Barnaby and Nelson enter the world of stunt pilots and aviation heroes, and discover a web of lies and intrigue.

programme.title: The Killings of Copenhagen
programme.desc: When the boss of Calder's Biscuit Company is murdered in Copenhagen, Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish detectives, the abrasive and astute Poulsen and the charming and cool Degn, and they discover Eric Calder had more linking him to Copenhagen than just his famous Golden Clusters.

programme.title: The Village That Rose from the Dead
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby must unravel a sinister web of lies from both past and present in order to catch a killer in the ghost village of Little Auburn.

programme.title: Crime and Punishment
programme.desc: Barnaby learns how far some people will go for power when he investigates the death of a member of the Bleakridge Watch in the most remote village in Midsomer.

programme.title: Last Man Out
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter investigate the death of a star cricketer during a tournament, but could the dislike of a cricket format really be the motive for murder, or is there more at play.

programme.title: Red in Tooth and Claw
programme.desc: When Barnaby and Winter find a dead body covered in live rabbits, a sinister side to the local pet show is revealed. Is this a case of rivalry taken too far?

programme.title: Death by Persuasion
programme.desc: When a young woman slips away from a camp site where a Jane Austen fantasy event is taking place dressed in period attire, and is found stabbed in the woods with a quill, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter discover that the victim was a journalist interested in the village's healthcare drone delivery programme, and are forced to look back in time to find the killer.

programme.title: The Curse of the Ninth
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter uncover multiple motives when the winner of a fought-after music award is found strangled with a violin string moments before a performance, including a rivalry over the prize and a missing Stradivarius.

programme.title: The Dark Rider
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones investigate when the appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall foreshadows a number of deaths among an aristocratic family called the DeQuettevilles. Meanwhile, the family stage a Civil War re-enactment with their hostile neighbours and relive historic battles. Can the detectives uncover the truth about the DeQuettevilles and the ghostly rider in order to prevent more murders?

programme.title: Murder of Innocence
programme.desc: When convicted murderer Grady Felton returns to the village where he killed a boy years earlier, his arrival is met with anger from the locals. Soon afterwards, a barrister is killed in Midsomer and suspicion falls on Grady. Grady has a solid alibi, but Barnaby suspects that he is working with an accomplice - until Grady himself is targeted in an arson attack.

programme.title: Death and the Divas
programme.desc: The murder of a journalist has chilling echoes of a 1960s horror film starring Midsomer's own Stella Harris. When Stella's more famous sister returns after a 40-year family rift, the killings escalate, each of them reminiscent of a movie plot - is life - and death - imitating art?

programme.title: Written in the Stars
programme.desc: As darkness covers Midsomer Stanton during a total eclipse of the sun, amateur astronomer Jeremy Harper is killed by a blow to the head with a meteorite. Barnaby and Jones soon discover intrigue, sexual tension and academic rivalry are rife among the star-seeking community.

programme.title: The Sicilian Defence
programme.desc: Harriet Farmer wakes up after being in a coma since the night she tried to elope. Harriet's boyfriend Finn Robson has been missing since the couple tried to run away together a year before. Then the president of the local chess society, Edward Stannington, is found dead in a lake with an ice pick in his back. His damaged car is nearby and Kate finds a clue in his mouth.

programme.title: Schooled in Murder
programme.desc: When a woman is crushed to death by a giant round of cheese at the home of the world-famous "Midsomer Blue", Barnaby and Jones are soon on the case. Debbie Moffett worked at the dairy, founded by her colleague Jim Caxton, who seems more anxious about his precious cheese than Debbie's death. And later, Debbie's lover Oliver Ordish is garrotted with cheese wire and covered with cheese fly larvae.

programme.title: The Point of Balance
programme.desc: Midsomer is buzzing with excitement at the arrival of the annual Paramount Dance Extravaganza. Behind the sequins and smiles are deep running feuds and passions, and when the stakes are high, the desire to win has outweighed everything.

programme.title: The Miniature Murders
programme.desc: The worlds of miniature doll's houses and real houses collide when prolific real estate agent Alexander Beauvoisin is murdered in front of a crowd at the unveiling of a new doll's house collection at Midsomer Museum of the family.

programme.title: The Sting of Death
programme.desc: The Deddington's thriving bee empire has put Granville Norton on the map, but the lengths they will go to ensure they're never dethroned are extreme.

programme.title: Have Ozz Will Travel
programme.desc: The family tries to decide where to go on vacation. Sharon turns down Fiji because none of the hotels meet her standards, while Ozzy nixes a number of other locations for various reasons.

programme.title: Hawaii Five Ozz
programme.desc: Ozzy, Sharon and Jack head to Hawaii for their vacation. Ozzy continues to be miserable for a while but cheers up following a private luau. Jack goes diving in a shark cage. His friends invite strippers to the luau and behave in ways that embarrass him. The traveling party winds up leaving without Jack's friends when they fail to show up on time for their flight.

programme.title: Kelly Interupted
programme.desc: Kelly irritates her mother by getting a lip ring. Ozzy and Jack are convinced that Kelly's erratic behaviour and chronic illness are the result of drug use, but Sharon refuses to hear of it. Kelly eventually admits the truth to Sharon and enters rehab. Ozzy and Sharon don't believe she will stay at the facility for long.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Kelly struggles to adjust to life in rehab, and frequently calls home requesting various personal belongings. She wants to leave, but Jack urges her to tough it out. Jack celebrates both his birthday and a year of sobriety. Kelly arrives home and becomes frustrated by the curfew and other rules she must follow.

programme.title: Charity Case
programme.desc: Sharon and Kelly plan a trip to Kenya on behalf of a charity organization. Ozzy doesn't want them to go, as he fears they will be kidnapped or contract malaria. Sharon also has second thoughts after hearing more details about the trip.

programme.title: Number One Fan
programme.desc: A 25-year-old fan wins a charity auction for the right to spend the day with Sharon. Sharon is touched by the woman's generosity and invites her to spend the night at the Osbourne home. Meanwhile, Jack must attend an online traffic school after getting a speeding ticket.

programme.title: Lost in Translation
programme.desc: The family travels to Japan, where Ozzy is to receive the Legend Award at the Video Music Awards. Kelly also makes several personal appearances. One of the employees, Sam, meets with some family members whom he hasn't seen in years, but can only communicate with them through a translator.

programme.title: The Show Must Go Off
programme.desc: Sharon's talk show tapes its final episodes. Feeling mistreated, Sharon clashes with her bosses to the very end, showing up late on purpose and demanding money upfront.

programme.title: A Farewell to Ozz
programme.desc: Dr. Phil McGraw pays a visit to the house, where he holds a frank discussion with the Osbournes about drug abuse and other issues that have affected the family's relationships with one another.

programme.title: A House Divided
programme.desc: Ozzy appears on The Tonight Show with Jay Leno as a performer.

programme.title: Bark At The Moon
programme.desc: The family's dogs have been excreting far too many times in the house and ruining furniture in the process.

programme.title: Like Father Like Daughter
programme.desc: Ozzy releases his first solo album in six years.

programme.title: Won't You Be My Neighbour
programme.desc: Kelly complains that elder sister Aimee had booked her a gynaecologist appointment.

programme.title: Tour of Duty
programme.desc: Ozzy is working out with a personal trainer in preparation for an upcoming tour.

programme.title: Break A Leg
programme.desc: Ozzy is touring while Sharon returns home, planning to reunite with Ozzy in Houston because she misses him.

programme.title: Get Stuffed
programme.desc: Ozzy mixes alcohol with the pain medication for his foot injury and winds up stoned.

programme.title: No Vagrancy
programme.desc: Jack invites his friend Jason Dill, a professional skateboarder, to stay at the house.

programme.title: A Very Ozzy Christmas
programme.desc: Sharon tells Ozzy and Jack that one of their tour truck drivers had an accident the other day.

programme.title: Dinner with Ozzy
programme.desc: Ozzy talks to Kelly and Melinda about being put in jail for stealing.

programme.title: What Goes Up
programme.desc: Ozzy and Sharon visit the White House; Kelly performs at the MTV Movie Awards; Jack pines for Natalie Portman.

programme.title: Must Come Down
programme.desc: Disaster strikes as Sharon is diagnosed with colon cancer and Jack breaks his arm jumping off a Malibu pier.

programme.title: The Ozz Man and the Sea
programme.desc: Kelly takes off for her European singing tour; Jack makes his acting debut on "Dawson's Creek"; Ozzy tries to build a beach fire for Sharon and makes a comical attempt at deep-sea fishing.

programme.title: Beauty and The Bert
programme.desc: Kelly reluctantly brings home her first boyfriend, evoking motherly concern from Sharon, who tries to nip the romance in the bud.

programme.title: Smells Like Teen Spirits
programme.desc: Sharon makes amends with her father after not speaking with him for over twenty years.

programme.title: Meow Means No
programme.desc: Kelly recruits her friend Sarah to play the drums in her band.

programme.title: It's A Hard Knock LIfe
programme.desc: Kelly grows frustrated with all the appearances she must make as a recording artist.

programme.title: Cleanliness is Next to Ozzyness
programme.desc: Ozzy grows increasingly tired of the dogs and their tendency to defecate in the house.

programme.title: Viva Ozz-Vegas
programme.desc: The Osbournes pack their bags for Sin City as Ozzy prepares for a concert and Kelly celebrates her birthday.

programme.title: My Big Fat Jewish Wedding
programme.desc: Sharon and Ozzy decide to renew their wedding vows at a hotel on New Year's Eve.

programme.title: What A Boy Wants
programme.desc: The Osbournes struggle to come up with a gift for Jack's birthday.

programme.title: Fleas A Crowd
programme.desc: The pets suffer from a flea infestation, creating havoc around the house and leaving everyone miserable.

programme.title: Run Ozzy Run
programme.desc: Ozzy continues to work out with his trainer, Pete, who Ozzy jokes may be a robot.

programme.title: Fists of Fury
programme.desc: Ozzy and Sharon prepare to leave for a few days on a Hawaiian vacation.

programme.title: Mama, I'm Staying Home
programme.desc: Ozzy decides to stay home while Sharon, Melinda and the kids travel to New York.

programme.title: Tennis Racket
programme.desc: Sharon receives a peace offering from one of her folk-singing neighbours.

programme.title: A Little Ditty About Jack and Brieann
programme.desc: Jack becomes interested in Courtney Love's houseguest; Ozzy writes a new song.

programme.title: Angler Management
programme.desc: After 17 years of waiting, Ozzy fulfills his dream of taking Jack on a fishing trip.

programme.title: Bye Bye Babies
programme.desc: Jack and Robert fly to England to spend time at the Osbournes' other home.

programme.title: Ozz That Ends Well
programme.desc: Kelly has problems with Bert; Jack deals with violent sleep habits.

programme.title: Catching Up with the Osbournes
programme.desc: Season 2 starts off with a recap of the first season.

programme.title: Christmas Special
programme.desc: The family hold a Christmas party in their home, with guests such Eva Mendes and Brendan Fraser.

programme.title: The Show Must Go Ozz
programme.desc: Sharon faces pressure from the powers that be at her talk show.

programme.title: Car Jacked
programme.desc: Jack turns 18 and receives a car as a birthday present.

programme.title: Rebel Without An Ozz
programme.desc: Ozzy and Sharon fret about all of the time they must spend apart as she works on her talk show.

programme.title: Return of the Ring
programme.desc: Ozzy loses a diamond pinkie ring that is worth over $100,000.

programme.title: The Accidental Tourist
programme.desc: Ozzy has a horrible ATV accident while on a promotional tour with Kelly.

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: After three weeks in the hospital, Ozzy is released and continues to convalesce at his home in England.

programme.title: Scent of a Woman
programme.desc: Kelly annoys everyone, particularly Sharon, with her disgusting lack of personal hygiene.

programme.title: Pain in the Neck
programme.desc: Ozzy grows increasingly frustrated about being cooped up around the house.

programme.title: Ozzy Knows Best
programme.desc: Ozzy is upset by Kelly's tendency to wear revealing outfits when she goes out to clubs and parties.

programme.title: Valentine Daze
programme.desc: Kelly continues to spend time with Rob, but doesn't want to be his girlfriend.

programme.title: Sleepless in Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Ozzy begins suffering from insomnia. He eventually undergoes testing with a sleep disorder expert to determine the cause. Jack gets a tattoo of a cross on his chest, but Ozzy and Sharon do not like it.

programme.title: Have Ozz Will Travel

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian rushes to a dramatic emergency at Jackie Barlow's alpaca farm, where a new mum desperately needs his help. But rural North Yorkshire isn't always the ideal place to drive when time is of the essence, and Julian gets stuck behind not one, but two tractors.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: There's a royal appointment at Cannon Hall Farm as Matt helps a goat with a broken leg in front of a high-profile onlooker - Her Royal Highness Princess Anne. Julian treats a tiny tortoise and has to check if Nigel's cows are pregnant.

programme.title: Snow Babies
programme.desc: This day takes place in some of the coldest regions on the planet. Polar bear cubs, penguin chicks, fox kits, and elk calves are among the many animals featured.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: A special episode focusing on births and babies. Julian heads to a local farm where a cow is struggling in labour. And with bringing new life into the world such a vital part of a vet's job, Julian's also hoping to assist in the birth of a career.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter Wright treats a pet sheep with flystrike, resulting in maggots living in its ear. The Huddersfield team perform spinal surgery on a French bulldog. Julian Norton meets pet pig Pumba that has hay netting tangled around its teeth.

programme.title: At Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas but life never stops at the practice! At John Swales' farm one of his prize-winning Limousins is struggling to give birth. The calf won't budge and the lives of both mum and baby are at risk. Can Peter save them both or is he too late?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Collette and her son Cailean are fanatical ferret fanciers and have 39 at their home! But their prize-winning, champion ferret favourite, Teddy, has a problem. They've spotted a lump and Collette fears the worst. Can Peter save Teddy?

programme.title: More Autumn Babies
programme.desc: Our day is being spent hanging around with more of autumn's babies. Goofy panda cubs, meerkats, and a show-off baby jaguar are some of the babies featuring this time.

programme.title: African Savanna Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking us on to the vast African Savanna. With its endless grass plains, leafy acacias and tropical climate its one of the richest environments on Earth, supporting millions of animals. Among them we see featured baby elephants, lion cubs, and wildebeest calves.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: In the middle of a storm an an alpaca gave birth to a cria. Peter gets the call to see if he has more than just a chill. Julian introduces us to their rabbit Luna, but she has to learn to share as they take in a new stray Boris. In order to welcome him into the family Boris will need to be castrated.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: When the RSPCA receives a report that a couple who are banned from keeping animals have got new dogs, Inspector Clare Wilson is quick to act. But, when she arrives at the property, it looks like the job is going to be slightly bigger than first anticipated...

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Emily hopes that bringing a dog into their home will offer a calming influence to her Neurodiverse son Jacob. And will Digger the Jack Russell prove worthy of being emotional support for young Harper?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian returns to Jacki Barlow's alpaca farm to investigate a worrying lump in the mouth of one of the animals. Peter carries out dental surgery on a Yorkshire terrier and Julian examines a pygmy-goat.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian heads to the historic Harewood House near Leeds to check on some goats who are moving to a new enclosure. But catching them isn't going to be easy. In fact, it proves quite painful!

programme.title: Summer Babies
programme.desc: This time we see the baby animals in the summer. Among the animals featured are tigers, orangutans, and green sea turtle hatchlings.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A labrador needs surgery after eating the sock her puppies were playing with, and Peter must find another way to feed a foal that is unable to ingest its mother's milk. A cockatoo fights back when the vets attempt to file down its overgrown beak, two emergencies occur at the same farm in the middle of lambing season, and a newborn calf is running a fever, leaving the owners fearful of pneumonia.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian operates on a French Bulldog that has injured one of his 3 legs. Matt Smith rushes to a farm to try and save a ewe and her unborn lamb. Elsewhere, Peter and Shona have some donkey work to do at the Greens' farm to solve a problem.

programme.title: Spring Babies
programme.desc: The changing of seasons means changes for Earth's creatures. Spring is one of the greatest changes from the cool of winter to the blooming of the land. We spend time with the youngsters born at this time of the year. Red deer, reindeer, goats and baby lynx are among those featured.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Family of five the Bascals are looking for a new buddy for their dog, while Karina and her son Alex meet a bonded pair of Jack Russell Chihuahua brothers.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Pet Babies
programme.desc: We spend time hanging about with our favourite pets. Featuring puppies, kittens and baby rabbits among more exotic animals we keep for pets.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian visits house pig Pigley Scott, who has had a horse tread on his trotter. Father and son farmers are worried about Roger, their prize bull, who has a large lump on his neck that may be a tumour.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter Wright treats two kittens that have been dumped in a bag and set on fire. Shona performs an emergency Caesarean to try and save a cow and her calf. Julian hopes to help a dog suffering from a rare spinal condition.

programme.title: Urban Babies
programme.desc: A day in the life of the extremely cute baby animals that we encounter in our everyday lives.

programme.title: More Urban Babies
programme.desc: We are back in the towns and cities to visit babies who brighten our lives, some more unusual than you might imagine... Kangaroo joey, raccoon kits and fruit-bat babies.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Will it be a love affair when Elaine is paired with fellow single girl Hayley the blue Staffy? Plus, a family have the pick of two dogs, Rusty the kelpie and Lightning the Australian terrier cross.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian Norton and Peter Wright work together to try to save a working sheepdog. They are also both needed at a local farm, where a cow is in agony.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian Norton receives an emergency call from alpaca breeder Jackie, whose prize-winning female Cinderella is having a difficult labour. Peter Wright has to castrate Larry the chinchilla who is responsible for a population explosion.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: It's a landmark day at the hospital in Huddersfield, as Shona and the team use a new electro chemotherapy treatment on a pet pygmy goat's cancerous tumour. Peter heads into surgery with an elderly Lhasa apso who's been suffering with a painful eye problem.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter Wright receives an emergency call from his favourite farming clients, Steve and Jean Green, whose poorly calf Treacle has collapsed and remains in a weak condition. There is also food for thought for a pair of alpacas, who have been binge eating after breaking into their food store.

programme.title: More Baby Animals From Africa
programme.desc: The wild youngsters of Africa are the focus. A pair of cheeky Lion cubs head out on an adventurous prowl, go bobbing for greens with an adorable Pygmy Hippo, plus cruise along with some playful Camels, named mini ships of the desert.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Favourite stories and unseen footage from the veterinary documentary series. New scenes include Dave the baby emu, Dougie the pugnacious parrot, Bobby the police sniffer dog and highlights of a hectic lambing season.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter treats a lamb that was born with a life-threatening cyst full of spinal fluid on its head, which will require delicate and painstaking surgery to safely remove. Julian is called out in the middle of the night to save a cow that has experienced dangerous complications while giving birth, a pig is resistant to being castrated, and a dog swallows a bottle of e-cigarette liquid.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: When a baby alpaca's life hangs in the balance, Julian performs an emergency blood plasma transfusion on the front lawn of the Thirsk practice. Peter meets a cat with an unusual backstory, but who now has a serious eye problem.

programme.title: Beach Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking place alongside some of the beaches of the world, checking out the non-stop action both on shore and further out to sea.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Matt rushes to a local cattle farm to help Tilly the cow give birth. Mike and Rebecca have an amorous pony, who needs an appointment with Peter and Julian operates on a young girl's poorly guinea pig, but he is shocked by what he finds.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Pulfer gets a report of a starving dog in need of his help, but he gets a nasty sense of Déjà vu when he arrives at the address. A year earlier, Anthony had visited the property to investigate a complaint about a Staffie that wasn't being properly cared for...

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian's patients include a horse with infected hooves, while Peter Wright is worried about a pedigree cat that is in labour and also has to deal with an angry monitor lizard. The two vets find time to attend the Great Yorkshire Show.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian heads to the Taylors' farm where there's a double sheep emergency - a new mum and an expectant mum have both prolapsed. Peter meets Katie Perry - a superstar of a collie who requires emergency surgery.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: A young Ewe is struggling to birth, her not so little lamb has his head stuck which puts both their lives in jeopardy. If Peter pulls him out, it could kill mum, but a caesarean will take too long for the baby. They must make a difficult decision.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Australia and New Zealand
programme.desc: We hang out with the youngsters that live and play in Australia and New Zealand. A baby Koala backpacks around the bush with its mum, join Fur Seal pups for a rocking good time on the rugged shores of New Zealand and bound around with Kangaroo joeys.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Pomeranian Prince is ready to rule his kingdom - will the Acton family be his new loyal subjects' And will Winnie's obsession with chewing squeaky toys be his downfall with the Johnsons'

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian helps a pregnant ewe with a tricky birth. Peter must remove a large tumour from a dog's bottom. Julian investigates a mystery llama injury. A female rhea has been injured during mating season. And can Peter save a schoolgirl's precious pony?

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Lanita and her two grown-up kids meet a dog with a rough backstory, mum of five Danielle wants a furry friend to keep her company and avid cyclists Jo and Jarvie are ready to join the dog club.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Kiwis, the Bolton family meet a cheeky puppy. Kate and Neill are ready for a new four-legged friend after a bereavement and flatmates Amanda and Rob look for a canine addition.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: A mum-to-be is struggling to give birth to her very large calf. Julian needs to perform an emergency c-section, but issues arise so Julian drafts in help from another vet, Candela. Only their vast experience and quick thinking can save them.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian Norton, Peter Wright and their staff deal with more animal emergencies. This episode includes a dog facing an emergency operation to remove a tumour and a prolapsing sheep that has to be treated on the car park.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: When a complaint comes in about two skinny dogs, Inspector Herchy Boal is straight on the case. Staffie crosses Rocky and Bentley are both extremely underweight and in need of help, but is it just a decent meal these two need or is something else wrong?

programme.title: Australian Babies
programme.desc: Today we are in the wilds of Australia exploring the outback, the bush and even its beaches. Among the babies we see kangaroo joeys, platypuses and koalas.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: The largest abscess Julian's ever seen is on a bull's backside - a waterfall of pus is coming! Peter meets Thor the giant rabbit as well as North Yorkshire's best dressed dog. And, just a few hours old, a lamb is rushed into surgery.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter battles to save a mum-to-be and her unborn calf. There's a 'cuteness overload' when Julian meets Finlay and his beloved hamster, Christopher Nibbles. Bella, the much-loved rescue sausage dog, needs life-saving surgery. Can Peter save her? Julian visits an old friend, Dobby the lama - but Dobby may not be so pleased to see him. Peter pops in on elderly colourful farmers the Greens.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Julian rushes over to see worried and confused farmer Joe Holmes. He found one of his cows with afterbirth hanging out, so he thought she'd already calved. But there's no sign of a new arrival, so he suspects she's struggling to give birth.

programme.title: At The Great Yorkshire Show
programme.desc: The 159th Great Yorkshire Show, is the hottest date in the Yorkshire's farming calendar and one of the UK's biggest agricultural shows. Peter and Julian are called by farmers across the land to get their livestock into peak condition.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Asia
programme.desc: We head on an adventure through Asia, prowl around with some cheeky Amur Leopard cubs, go underwater to catch a baby Spinner Dolphin practice it's loops, plus watch some rare Giant Panda cubs grow up right before your eyes, via a den cam.

programme.title: More Winter Babies
programme.desc: We spend time chilling out with babies in the cold of winter. Shorter days and snow mean that the babies need their winter coats.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Hunky Tom Rigby meets his match in Keira the kelpie. And will this be it for serial dater Lily the pug when she meets human Lily and her family in the meeting pen?

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Two babies' lives hang in the balance. Peter rushes into Skeldale on his day off to try and save Richard Bell's lamb, who was badly injured when he was born just a few hours ago. And at Suzanne Benson's trekking centre, Julian's treating a very poorly one-week old llama called Noah.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Julian is called out to a calf with a large lump, while other patients include a pair of pygmy goats, a farm full of feral cats and Fern, a sick spaniel. The staff also find time to spring a birthday surprise on Peter Wright.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Southeast Asia
programme.desc: Get set to monkey around with a bunch of baby Orangutans, hanging out comes naturally. Asian Elephant calves are keen to have some good clean fun in the mud, while a rare Red Shanked Douc is ready to ride the branches and show off its tree surfing skills.

programme.title: Baby Animals From North America
programme.desc: North America is the destination in this episode. Tag along with baby raccoons as they explore the woods. Have a need for speed? Then zoom along some mountain rapids with a Moose calf. And if you like non-stop action, simply hang out with baby Bears.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Peter is struggling to find his feet in his new practice. But when a farmer rushes in with a heavily pregnant sheep who's struggling to give birth, instinct takes over as Peter deals with the emergency.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter treats two very poorly newborn calves. Julian tires to remove a huge tumour from a sheepdog and a sparky Shetland pony gives the vets the runaround.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian Norton treats a cow with a rare and complex problem. The cow's stomach has become displaced and moved to the wrong side of her body, causing pain and stopping her eating. Meanwhile in Thirsk, a baby roe deer is brought into the practice as it has stopped taking milk, and a dog has a large tumour removed in a tricky operation.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Matt delivers a calf, Peter removes a lump from a dog's eye, and Julian repairs a slipped patella on a cat and nips a sheep with a birth defect. Peter and Shona go 4-wheeling.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Julian needs as many extra pairs of hands as he can muster as he has to perform a caesarean section on a pregnant Great Dane. Later, young vet Matt marries his fiancee Katherine in front of all of his veterinary friends.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter gets an emergency call from Ivor Shaw. He's found one of his calves limping, and Peter suspects her little leg is broken. Julian is overwhelmed when 18 rats are brought onto the practice. A blind sheep and a stray dog are treated.

programme.title: The Devil's Forest
programme.desc: Based on true events. Filmmakers travel to Transylvania to document the world's most haunted Baciu forest which has a dark history of strange occurrences, ghost sightings and countless cases of missing people.

programme.title: Anaconda: Death Coil
programme.desc: Four friends visit a inherited cabin for nostalgia, but after finding a mutilated ranger and signs of a massive ancient anaconda, they're hunted by the creature and must survive the wilderness and uncover the land's dark history.

programme.title: Lone Star Shark
programme.desc: A group of virtual hunters unleash a deadly shark in a Texas lake, causing a young couple to fight for their lives during a peaceful fishing trip in a secluded cove.

programme.title: Lone Star Shark 2
programme.desc: A new victim has been chosen to face off against a ravenous shark in a Texas lake.

programme.title: Lone Star Shark 3
programme.desc: Two female survivors join forces to bring down the deadly group responsible for unleashing a hungry shark in a West Texas lake.

programme.title: Night of the Rising Dead
programme.desc: In a remake of George RomeroÄôs 1968 cult classic horror film, amidst a worldwide event where the dead awake and roam the earth as zombies, a small group of human survivors struggle to stay alive and fight off the wandering zombies who are intent on eating them and turning them into the walking dead.

programme.desc: Jess pitches in at Cylon Rolling Acres as owner Leslie Svacina runs her direct-to-consumer goat meat business.

programme.title: Nashville Hot Dove Sliders at Redstone Ranch
programme.desc: Jess and her husband Chris head to their favorite hunting grounds, Redstone Ranch, situated in the heart of the migratory dove flyway.

programme.title: Oklahoma's Wild Hog Sausage Roll
programme.desc: Jess heads to Oklahoma, where she takes aim at one of the state's estimated 1.5 million feral hogs. Then, she makes a wild hog sausage roll with jalapeño and cheddar.

programme.title: Fort Worth Barbacoa Feast
programme.desc: Jess and her good friends, Fort Worth pitmaster Joe Riscky and Chef Juan Rodriguez, prepare a traditional barbacoa feast.

programme.title: South Texas Deer Capture
programme.desc: Jess visits the East Foundation in South Texas to participate in a fast-paced, yet careful and methodical deer capture.

programme.title: Smoked Elk Sandwiches at Juniper Mountain Ranch
programme.desc: Jess and her friend Shaundi Campbell meet up with guides from Juniper Mountain Ranch in southeastern Idaho to cull an elk for her smoked elk sandwiches.

programme.title: Whole Hog BBQ with Pitmaster Pat Martin
programme.desc: Jess teams up with legendary West Tennessee pitmaster and whole hog expert Pat Martin to cook a hog overnight and enjoy a special cut of beef from Australia.

programme.title: Live Fire Venison Backstrap in Oklahoma
programme.desc: With the help of a local Oklahoma guide, Jess sets out to hunt an axis deer, then shares butchery techniques and prepares a delicious backstrap grilled over live fire.

programme.title: Northstar Bison Smash Burger
programme.desc: Jess visits Northstar Bison to learn about the small family-run ranch's breeding and processing operation, then prepares her signature smash burger.

programme.title: Texas Tomahawk from Wyatt Ranches
programme.desc: Jess heads to Wyatt Ranches in South Texas to check out the cattle ranching operation they've been running since 1965.

programme.title: The King of Open-Fire Paella
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

programme.title: Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

programme.title: Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
programme.desc: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

programme.title: Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

programme.title: Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

programme.title: Carne Adovada
programme.desc: Carne Adovada.

programme.title: Holy Mackerel!
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

programme.title: A Whole Roasted Hog
programme.desc: For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

programme.title: Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

programme.title: Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.

programme.title: Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
programme.desc: Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

programme.title: Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

programme.title: Amor en pelota; Me pertenece

programme.title: Sexo por fuera; Acoso en el parque

programme.title: Muere quemado; Baja costura
programme.desc: El hijo de Laura muere quemado, ella pide 50 mil dólares a su vecina por daños y perjuicios. Un concierto de Bruno fue viral porque se vieron sus genitales, su representante no quiere pagarle.

programme.title: Me gusta violada; En nombre de Satán

programme.title: La acosadora de hombres; La diva destronada

programme.title: Desecho familiar; Terapia engañosa
programme.desc: Patricio pide que la mujer de su padre inhabilitado venda la casa para pagar los gastos médicos. La mamá de Gabriela la envía a terapia para que dejara de ser gay y el terapista la tortura.

programme.title: Muerta viva; Bebé adicta al celular
programme.desc: La persona que le roba su identidad muere, y ahora parece que es ella quien quiere usurpar la identidad de una fallecida. Culpa a la cuidadora por la adicción al celular de su bebé.

programme.title: Deportación oportunista; Morcilla vegana
programme.desc: Rafael será deportado y pide llevarse a su hijo, quien cambió de sexo, pero la mamá se niega, quiere exponerlo en un reality. Lilian se enferma al comer morcillas hechas con sangrado menstrual.

programme.title: El silencio; El valor de la vida
programme.desc: Fernando acusa a su madre de permitir que violaran a su hija, le exige una indemnización. July tiene cáncer y es sostén de su familia, su pareja quiere el divorcio y que desaloje de la casa.

programme.title: Donaciones en disputas; Adicto a las manos
programme.desc: Chelsy le pide a Helen, la viuda de un bombero, que le entregue parte del dinero que recibió como donación cuando él murió. Vivian busca pareja y encuentra a un hombre con un fetiche muy raro.

programme.title: Me orino por tu moto; Los tacones de mi marido
programme.desc: Patricia pide compensación por su incontinencia urinaria, provocada por un movimiento brusco cuando iba en la moto con José. Daniela y Carlos discuten por la técnica del ejercicio con tacones.

programme.title: Las pájaras no tenemos hijos; La chupetona
programme.desc: Cristina exige que se declare la paternidad de Karel como progenitor de su hija; la niña fue producto de una aventura, pero el padre no quiere hacerse responsable, ya que alega que es gay y que los gais no tienen hijos. Gabi contrató a un chico para que fingiera ser su novio en la fiesta de su graduación, pero el chico no imaginaba que iba a participar en una competencia de chupetones en el cuello, y mucho menos que unos días más tarde estaría muerto por causa de ese chupetón.

programme.title: Lubricante traicionero; La víctima
programme.desc: Pepa culpa a Ariana de ponerle pegamento en vez de lubricante al dildo cuando hacían el amor. Rocío exige una compensación a Wilfredo por las violaciones, torturas y abusos que sufrió con él.

programme.title: Preñada en coma; El enredo de las maletas
programme.desc: Victoria despierta del coma después de dos años y, para su sorpresa, ahora es madre, denuncia violación. Andreína y Darlyn están en el aeropuerto con maletas idénticas, él se lleva la de ella.

programme.title: Su condición es otra; Enjaulados
programme.desc: Su hijo padece una discapacidad mental que provoca problemas de comportamiento, llamada X frágil, la madre lo sobreprotege. Por publicidad, encierran a un niño vestido de mexicano en una jaula.

programme.title: Mujer macho, seguimiento; Ya mi trompeta no suena
programme.desc: Lupe quiere desalojar a su hija Diana y a su yerno Ángel, porque él antes era mujer. Los mariachis van a dar una serenata y el trompetista se sorprende al descubrir la infidelidad de su esposa.

programme.title: Paraíso terrenal; Hermanos straight edge
programme.desc: María y Carlos tenían cuatro años de relación y en Navidad se descubre la infidelidad de uno de ellos. Carlos usa la violencia con los que no comparten su filosofía de vida.

programme.title: Gigantismo precoz; Mi hermano perro
programme.desc: Carina sufre una extraña enfermedad y su hermano Rasiel pide su custodia. Cuando su hermanito muere, los padres le regalan un perro, pero ahora el niño cree que el animal es el difunto.

programme.title: El regalo; Entre audición y audición
programme.desc: Jimena descubre que su papá le dejó una mensualidad de 20 mil dólares al hijo de Daniela, la vecina. Para triunfar en el mundo de la música, Jorge debe vender la casa que heredó de sus padres.

programme.title: Locos impulsos; Fotografió mi desgracia
programme.desc: Daniel busca cambiar de género para controlar el impulso de querer tener sexo con niños. Al emborracharse, Jennifer dañó las fotos de la boda de Verónica y, además, arruinó la fiesta.

programme.title: Daño Adderall; Doc Google
programme.desc: Paula acusa a su propia madre de darle a su hermana una pastilla para que mejore el rendimiento escolar, pero la niña dio positivo en drogas en un análisis en el colegio porque la pastilla contiene un componente que es considerado como droga. Claudia es hipocondríaca y para cualquier padecimiento consulta al llamado "doctor Google", donde encontró una web de un médico llamado Manuel, pero el hombre no es más que un estafador que solo receta aspirinas.

programme.title: La duda; Hogar anfitrión
programme.desc: Arturo demanda a Dayana, ella cree que su hijo mantuvo relaciones con su propia hermana. Francisco llega a casa de Rosalba por un intercambio estudiantil y ella resulta ser su madre biológica.

programme.title: Secreto húmedo; Nos hicimos millonarios
programme.desc: Manuel pide una orden de alejamiento para su hijastra quien cree que su hermanita se orina en la cama por un trauma. Una pareja encuentra 500 mil dólares, pero los billetes eran falsos.

programme.title: La donación de la discordia; Desechada en el pantano
programme.desc: Carlos pide el divorcio y la mitad de lo recaudado para la atención médica de su esposo Álvaro. Stephanie sale a divertirse con chicas, pero deja a Franceli en los Everglades porque es vieja.

programme.title: Violencia inducida; Viajero peligroso
programme.desc: Rosalía quiere separarse de Jorge porque no soporta sus episodios de violencia. En otro caso, Ana viaja sola por todo el mundo, publica los viajes en sus redes, Alberto la sigue y la viola.

programme.title: Chocando con el pasado; El milagro
programme.desc: José huye de su ex con el bebé de ambos, años después ella lo encuentra. Una niña embarazada dice que es virgen, la madre biológica habla de un milagro y el padre quiere filmar un documental.

programme.title: Founding father; Embarazada alborotada
programme.desc: Isabella y Gaby se aprovechan de un desamparado que les salvó la vida y gastan el dinero que recaudaron con la excusa de ayudarlo. La mujer de Ricardo está embarazada y lo abusa sexualmente.

programme.title: Niña descarriada; Me volvió loca
programme.desc: María se muda con su amiga y el padre de esta, pero él es un morboso, dice que lo provocan. Bella demanda a Omar por vender caramelos de marihuana, la reacción de su esposo fue matar a su hijo.

programme.title: Robo a distancia; El infierno
programme.desc: María apoyó a su esposa para que viniera a Estados Unidos y durante un tiempo le envió dinero, ahora pide que se lo devuelva. Lázaro exige la custodia total de la hija que tiene con Elisa.

programme.title: Candela; Pacto mal guardado
programme.desc: La clínica de Alison se incendió y ahora ella responsabiliza a Milagro y a su hijo, un paciente piromaníaco. Ángel y Daniela ocultan el motivo de la muerte de su hija, un video los delata.

programme.title: Bebé rechazado; Escuela boxing
programme.desc: Mario quiere terapia psicológica para su esposo Víctor, la custodia de su hija de seis meses o el divorcio. Mariela demanda al profesor de su hijo por haberlo golpeado, John la contrademanda.

programme.title: Mutilación femenina; Incesto emocional
programme.desc: Jesús y Estela le practicaron la mutilación genital a su hija, el novio de ella busca salvarla de otra operación. Carolina pide el divorcio porque la relación de la niña con el padre es dañina.

programme.title: Niño asesino; El yogurt de la discordia
programme.desc: Un niño irrespetuoso y violento, es capaz de amenazar de muerte a su propia madre. Iveth prepara yogures con fluidos vaginales, Yailyn le da uno a su hija y la contagia de herpes.

programme.title: Sueldo secreto; Dos pájaros de un tiro
programme.desc: Ana María quiere que Martín la compense salarialmente por pagarle menos durante dos años. Francisco pide que su ex-nuera desaloje el apartamento y le pague por incumplir el contrato de renta.

programme.title: Prima ALS; La desgracia de la familia
programme.desc: Luis acogió a su prima en su casa, pero la jovencita está descontrolada, su esposa le pide que la eche. Además, Carolina recibió en su casa a su hermano y el joven descubrió su pasado porno.

programme.title: Presente ausente; Amistad violenta
programme.desc: Su mamá muere y reaparece su padrastro quien quiere parte de la herencia. Reclama por una fiesta con sexo, droga y todo tipo de ilegalidades, pelean y rompen una tubería que inunda el edificio.

programme.title: Funeral de Ramón; Máquina del amor
programme.desc: En el funeral de su esposo se aparece un supuesto hijo del difunto que es transexual. En el sexo, él siempre quiere usar una máquina energética que le proporciona el placer que necesitan.

programme.title: El pene de David; Violador gana lotería
programme.desc: Diana quiere que su esposo David se opere para agrandarse el pene, pero él gastó el dinero en otra cosa. Jhony ganó la lotería y ahora Nayeli, a quien violó, le exige parte del premio.

programme.title: Miedo a los monstruos; Adolescentes calientes
programme.desc: María pide alejar a su hijo de Pedro, el padre, quien confesó sentir asco y repulsión por el niño que es discapacitado. Jennifer le facilita el sexo a su hija menor de edad, Javier la demanda.

programme.title: Matrimonio porno; Un problema de peso
programme.desc: Pablo es un actor porno que busca parejas en internet para burlarse de ellas y engañar a Yesenia. También, Liz tiene sobrepeso y baja autoestima; para colmo, la acusan de robo.

programme.title: Tráfico humano; Loqui locurita
programme.desc: Cumple prisión porque ella iba escondida en su camión cuando lo detuvieron en la frontera. No le quieren pagar al payaso porque su espectáculo fue muy sexual e inapropiado para los niños.

programme.title: Morir por ella; El milagroso
programme.desc: Antonella es una menor en prisión preventiva que viene a pedirle la emancipación a sus padres para poder donarle su hígado a la hija de la mujer que ella asesinó. Sus padres se niegan porque puede morir en la operación debido a su alergia a la anestesia. Gerardo es un pastor evangelista que tiene un hijo que supuestamente tiene el don de sanidad y recibe mensajes del señor; pero Rosmy duda de la veracidad de esa información, cree que el hombre está estafando a todos, incluso a ella.

programme.title: Quítale la licencia; Homofóbico enamorado
programme.desc: Le pide a su padre que entregue su licencia de conducir porque se comporta de forma agresiva cuando maneja. José no acepta que le gusta tener relaciones con hombres, por eso los golpea.

programme.title: Guerra de las roommates; Alumna acosadora
programme.desc: Demanda a sus "roommates" por su mal comportamiento, pero ahora no tiene un lugar donde vivir. Tiene relaciones con una chica que resultó ser una de sus alumnas, ella está obsesionada con él.

programme.title: Casino suicida; Mi adicción favorita
programme.desc: Débora es adicta a los casinos y está en la lista de ludópatas, su esposo busca administrar su dinero. Ernesto solicitó servicios de una chica para que lo cuide, ella dice que no está enfermo.

programme.title: En el nombre del señor; El santo pecador
programme.desc: Lázara demanda a Perla por hacer pornografía con su madrina, una anciana que padece Alzheimer. Un pastor muere en los brazos de su amante quien, públicamente, revela un gran secreto.

programme.title: Enamorada de Elsa; Invisible crueldad
programme.desc: Gabriela pide una orden de alejamiento para su ex, asegura que esta se enamoró de Elsa, un dispositivo inteligente modificado. José exige la custodia de su hija, la madre la pone en peligro.

programme.title: Por Maduro perdí a mi hijo; El lambón
programme.desc: Ana, al sufrir precariedades por la crisis venezolana, se ve obligada a dejar a su hijo con Mónica. También, Radel es un chico muy comelón que avergüenza a su novia cuando salen de fiesta.

programme.title: Venganza sucia; Mi casa me enloquece
programme.desc: Fue testigo de un supuesto abuso sexual y ahora los involucrados la amenazan. Siente que unos fantasmas la atacan y violan dentro de la casa que compró, por eso quiere devolverla.

programme.title: Volver a ser madre; La caridad del cobre
programme.desc: Deja a sus gemelas con una amiga por 15 días, pero regresa a los dos años. Glenda tiene una productora pornográfica donde los clientes se convierten en actores, una de las esposas la acusa.

programme.title: Twitch Prime; El novio de mi hija
programme.desc: Vanessa es taxista y transmite en vivo desde su auto, Luz la demanda por arruinarle la vida al manipular una grabación. Alejandra quiere emanciparse porque su mamá se enamoró de su pareja.

programme.title: Ladrona de sueños; Expuesta como una cualquiera
programme.desc: Alfredo sufrió un infarto cerebral y tiene distonía muscular. Ahora tiene una novia y quiere independizarse vendiendo la casa que tiene con su hermana para comprarse un apartamento. Magdalena y su pareja graban un vídeo sexual y por descuido termina en las redes.

programme.title: Ley vs. justicia; Falsa fama
programme.desc: Wilson demanda a Nubia, la esposa de su padre fallecido, por falsificar el testamento: la acusa de asesina. Janet cambia su imagen con las cirugías que paga Abraham, pero él se siente estafado.

programme.title: Trampa para deportar; Perdidos en locura
programme.desc: Steven sale de Colombia, huye de su familia homofóbica y trae dinero de dudosa procedencia. Por otro lado, Alexa desea morirse porque sufre cáncer de médula y la donante es su mamá.

programme.title: Desaparecida; Tremendo petardo
programme.desc: Una señora y su acompañante desaparecieron, le reclaman a las hijas que revelen el paradero. Por una cerca que nadie repone, un petardo impacta a una embarazada y le causa un aborto.

programme.title: El olvidado; Confusión fatal
programme.desc: El esposo de Katherine muere en una celda policial sin agua, comida y sin que nadie lo supiera. El hermano de Scarlet busca ayuda en el restaurante de Jean tras ser herido, pero se la niegan.

programme.title: Mafia en el género; Loca por casarme
programme.desc: Raymond es cantante, pero no quiere cumplir su contrato con la productora porque en lugar de promover su música lo usan para vender drogas. Lucí­a dice que no en plena boda y estafa al novio.

programme.title: Contrabando de pasto; Intolerancia a los trans
programme.desc: Detienen a Conni por tráfico de marihuana, su esposo puso la droga en su equipaje y ella no lo sabía. Andrea es un transexual que demanda a Eliza, dueña de un hotel, por discriminación.

programme.title: Muerte cerebral; Fantasía de play station
programme.desc: Lenin ordena desconectar a su mujer con muerte cerebral y se va a EE.UU., pero ella vive para reclamar lo suyo. Carlos construye una familia virtual y le da más valor que a su familia real.

programme.title: El costo del viaje; Locura en casa móvil
programme.desc: A Cándida le roban el auto en el garaje de la tienda donde trabaja y la despiden, ahora demanda a la exjefa. Javier acusa a Naomi de los destrozos en su casa y la aparición de drogas.

programme.title: Ilusiones rentadas; Instinto para dinero fácil
programme.desc: Marí­a contrata a unos actores vestidos de policía para intimidar a su hijo descarriado, pero todo resulta mal. Soraida se da cuenta de que York finge accidentes para cobrar la indemnización.

programme.title: El amor no cree en ADN; Falsos culpables
programme.desc: Luisa casa a su hija discapacitada con Andrés para optar por un tratamiento y ahora que la joven recibe una herencia quiere divorciarlos. Demandan a Jaime por publicar una noticia falsa.

programme.title: Con mis mejores amigos; Defecando en el restaurante
programme.desc: Tiene una hija con leucemia y ella le echa la culpa al padre. Ashley va al restaurante de Carlos con urgencia de ir al baño y al negárselo, no tiene más opción que defecar delante de todos.

programme.title: Familia toma venganza; Violencia infundada
programme.desc: A Juan lo secuestraron y lo violaron en Cuba. Todos los hechos fueron dirigidos por María, quien descubrió que él es un depredador sexual que persigue a menores y que fue a Cuba para tener sexo con su adolescente hija. Anisley ha despedido de su empresa a Sandro porque ha descubierto que tiene un récord criminal por violencia y, ahora, se siente amenazada porque lo ha visto frente a su casa.

programme.title: La comunión del terror; Protección con drogas
programme.desc: Eduardo tiene hijos, esposa y amante, en una festividad se vieron todos y acabó mal. En otro caso, Carlos y Katiuska descubrieron que Ámbar, la niñera de su hijo, es una ex drogadicta.

programme.title: Sembrado casero; Herencia sin derecho
programme.desc: Nicolás consume salvia como droga, sus efectos alucinógenos son potentes, su esposa le pide el divorcio. Yohaly y Marianela se disputan 350 mil dólares de herencia, pero no hay testamento.

programme.title: Triángulo tóxico; Cierra la boca
programme.desc: Deborah le regala un restaurante a Alejandro y ahora se lo quiere quitar, pero él lo perdió. Además, la hija de Gabriel y Paola es una niña muy delgada, solo come verduras y mira las calorías.

programme.title: Terminando con mi vida; Me ha engañado una escort
programme.desc: Víctor ha estado preso y ahora quiere confesar un crimen, pero su esposa se opone, asegura que él es inocente. Nathalie es perseguida por la mafia rusa porque la confunden con su amiga Valery.

programme.title: Venganza tardía; Sabías que la mataría y callaste
programme.desc: José Luis se venga de Rosario quien de joven lo violó con un palo de billar, él le hizo lo mismo. Cinthya denuncia a su cuñado y al padre de este por el abuso continuado y muerte de su hermana.

programme.title: Uganda Through the Eyes of a Chimp
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating country of Uganda from the perspective of an endearing alpha male chimpanzee named Toti, who strives to protect his community and keep it together.

programme.title: Anaconda: Silent Killer
programme.desc: Journey into remote parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth about notorious snakes, toucans, howler monkeys and tapirs.

programme.title: Africa's Lost Wilderness - Kenya and the Big Animals
programme.desc: This documentary explores the displacement of lions, elephants and other big game animals from the savannas of Kenya. It is also an intimate depiction of the people who still strive to live in harmony with the natural world.

programme.title: Megeti - Africa's Lost Wolf
programme.desc: The story of the Ethiopian she-wolf Megeti, who lost her pack and is suddenly completely on her own. Since it is essential for the survival of the young wolf to rejoin a pack, she wanders through the Ethiopian highlands in search of a new home.

programme.title: Maasai Mara, The Big Cats Sanctuary
programme.desc: Wildebeest, zebra, antelope and gazelle roam the savannah. The herds, along with their cubs, are seen as the perfect food source for predatory big cats, such as lions, cheetahs and leopards.

programme.title: Go Ape
programme.desc: Having a look at different species of primates, how they live, feed and survive, as well as looking at the similarities between apes and humans.

programme.title: Uganda Through the Eyes of a Chimp
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating country of Uganda from the perspective of an endearing alpha male chimpanzee named Toti, who strives to protect his community and keep it together.

programme.title: Anaconda: Silent Killer
programme.desc: Journey into remote parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth about notorious snakes, toucans, howler monkeys and tapirs.

programme.title: Rules Of The Realm
programme.desc: For many species the possession of territory is the ultimate goal. With good territory comes plentiful food, access to shelter, attraction to mates and safety to raise offspring - all tremendous strategic advantages in the wild. For a territorial species, their territory is their kingdom. Those that want it will stop at nothing to get it, and those that have it will fight fiercely to defend it.

programme.title: Nature's World Wide Web
programme.desc: To provide an edge to survive in their habitats, some animals have developed techniques that allow them to share information. Communication represents one of the most versatile and widely used strategies in the animal world. In both social and solitary species it is the transfer of information that lies at the heart of so many behaviours in the wild. For those that harness the power of communication, the advantage is theirs.

programme.title: Cunning Copulation
programme.desc: From microscopic single celled organisms to the largest animals on the planet, one goal is shared by all living things: to reproduce. For many creatures, finding a suitable mate to pass on strong genes and rear young that will survive to adulthood is a challenge that is met with a variety of strategies. In this episode we will observe the creative tactics animals employ to find the best mates and to win them over.

programme.title: Battle Plans
programme.desc: The ability to fight and win is essential to any animal living in the wild. The strategies of that fight are known as agonism, and it can be used to establish hierarchy, secure resources, win territory and seduce mates. In the wild, there are no guarantees. But those that master agonism have the best chance of seeing another day.

programme.title: Masters Of Attack
programme.desc: The real hard work for a physically powerful predator is in working out a strategy for attack.

programme.title: Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Whatever strategy an animal uses to withstand an attack, they will do what it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Battle Plans
programme.desc: The ability to fight and win is essential to any animal living in the wild. The strategies of that fight are known as agonism, and it can be used to establish hierarchy, secure resources, win territory and seduce mates. In the wild, there are no guarantees. But those that master agonism have the best chance of seeing another day.

programme.title: Masters Of Attack
programme.desc: The real hard work for a physically powerful predator is in working out a strategy for attack.

programme.title: Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Whatever strategy an animal uses to withstand an attack, they will do what it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Rules Of The Realm
programme.desc: For many species the possession of territory is the ultimate goal. With good territory comes plentiful food, access to shelter, attraction to mates and safety to raise offspring - all tremendous strategic advantages in the wild. For a territorial species, their territory is their kingdom. Those that want it will stop at nothing to get it, and those that have it will fight fiercely to defend it.

programme.title: Nature's World Wide Web
programme.desc: To provide an edge to survive in their habitats, some animals have developed techniques that allow them to share information. Communication represents one of the most versatile and widely used strategies in the animal world. In both social and solitary species it is the transfer of information that lies at the heart of so many behaviours in the wild. For those that harness the power of communication, the advantage is theirs.

programme.title: Cunning Copulation
programme.desc: From microscopic single celled organisms to the largest animals on the planet, one goal is shared by all living things: to reproduce. For many creatures, finding a suitable mate to pass on strong genes and rear young that will survive to adulthood is a challenge that is met with a variety of strategies. In this episode we will observe the creative tactics animals employ to find the best mates and to win them over.

programme.title: History's Deadliest Weapons
programme.desc: As the battle distance continues to grow with each new weapon, humans put their best minds to work refining and evolving their designs over the millennia to gain the upper hand.

programme.title: The Takeover
programme.desc: In under two centuries, favorite food brands span continents and cultures, spur innovation and technology, and forever change the food landscape.

programme.title: The Taste
programme.desc: Food preferences are influenced by dozens of factors, including genetics, environment and habit, but the taste is also about perception; the color, texture and weight of food are as important as the flavor.

programme.title: The Marketing
programme.desc: At one point, each and every food brand had to come up with a plan to get people to try them; today, the food and drink marketing industry is worth about $900 billion and growing.

programme.title: The Supply Chain
programme.desc: With every single bite or sip that people take, they participate in one of the most sophisticated journeys around the world ever taken; the global food supply chain is part of an $8 trillion network that produces over 4 billion tons of food annually.

programme.title: The Impact
programme.desc: Food brands travel around the world, stick around and change the places they visit; once the food is adopted by eager taste buds, it becomes part of local culture and tradition.

programme.title: The Future
programme.desc: Climate change, a global pandemic, and a booming world population mark an opportune time to be in the food business, not unlike the first wave of the industrial food revolution that gave people the first globally mass-produced, processed foods.
