programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.desc: Sizzling chops; sweet tomato and asparagus lasagnetti; mushroom soup; Stilton; apple and walnut croutes.

programme.title: Wonky Summer Pasta
programme.desc: Jamie prepares a delicious feast of wonky summer pasta, herby salad, and pear drop tartlets.

programme.title: Episode 12

programme.title: Jamie's Comfort Food
programme.desc: Chef Jamie Oliver welcomes his friends, family and viewers to his Essex home where he takes familiar British foods to the next level. The celebrity chef reinvents classic dishes and childhood favourites in addition to preparing new recipes, including the perfect burger-and-cheese toastie. The dishes Oliver creates, like a grown-up version of chicken Kiev and an updated sticky toffee pudding, bring back memories of holidays, celebrations and special occasions he has experienced in his life.

programme.title: Jerk Chicken In A Bun; Jamie's Houmous Tip; Rocky Road
programme.desc: Jamie spices up a barbecue chicken burger, shows how to make delicious homemade hummus, and whips up a Rocky road with the kids as a treat that uses lots of store cupboard ingredients.

programme.title: Spaghetti Puttanesca
programme.desc: Jamie cooks spaghetti alla puttanesca with homemade garlic bread and a fennel salad; he creates a chocolate ganache for dessert.

programme.title: Chicken Pie
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver makes chicken pie with French-style peas, sweet carrot smash, and berries, shortbread and Chantilly cream.

programme.title: Bean Burger, Charred Salad, Spicy Curry
programme.desc: Meat-free dishes include a black bean burger topped with fresh salsa, a charred crunchy salad with croutons, and a curry stuffed with spices.

programme.title: Swedish Meatballs and Pasta Pesto
programme.desc: Jamie cooks Swedish meatballs, celeriac and spinach rice, plus pasta pesto, and garlic and rosemary chicken.

programme.title: Moroccan Bream and British Burgers
programme.desc: Moroccan bream; couscous salad; pomegranate and harissa; British burgers; shred salad; pickles and things.

programme.title: Grilled Steak and Blackened Chicken
programme.desc: Jamie prepares grilled steak, ratatouille and saffron rice, plus blackened chicken and San Fran quinoa salad.

programme.title: Episode 17

programme.title: Cheat's Pizza
programme.desc: Preparing cheat's pizza; three salads; and squashed cherries and vanilla mascarpone cream.

programme.title: Amanda Holden, Two Way Chicken and DIY Kebabs

programme.title: Copper's Curries
programme.desc: Jamie shows London police how to prepare spicy foods; cellophane noodle salad; monkfish; mango lassi.

programme.title: Great Packed Lunches
programme.desc: Jamie shows pushbike couriers how to make great lunches; squashed cherry tomato salad; meatballs; calzones.

programme.title: 5 Simple Recipes to Cook at Home
programme.desc: A bite-sized clip selection of Jamie's most-loved recipes and kitchen moments.

programme.desc: Going meat-free a couple of days a week has got the Oliver household trying new ways of using vegetables in the dishes everyone knows and loves, so Jamie has pulled out all the stops for his mushroom toad-in-the-hole.

programme.desc: Jamie cooks crispy duck and hoisin lettuce parcels, chicken cacciatore, and spaghetti and smoky tomato sauce.

programme.desc: Moroccan bream; couscous salad; pomegranate and harissa; British burgers; shred salad; pickles and things.

programme.desc: Jamie makes jerk pork, grilled corn and crunchy tortilla salad, minestrone, poached chicken and salsa verde.

programme.desc: Jamie cooks Swedish meatballs, celeriac and spinach rice, plus pasta pesto, and garlic and rosemary chicken.

programme.desc: Green tea salmon; coconut rice and miso greens; modern Greek salad; spinach, chickpea and feta parcels.

programme.desc: Jamie prepares grilled steak, ratatouille and saffron rice, plus blackened chicken and San Fran quinoa salad.

programme.title: Farmhouse Roast Chicken; Creamy Prawn Linguine

programme.desc: Making roast chicken, and putting a British twist on spaghetti bolognese.

programme.desc: Chicken Kiev; spaghetti vongole.

programme.desc: Crispy Sea Bass; sweet potato mash; Asian greens; ginger lemonade; honey and yogurt ice cream.

programme.desc: Jamie Oliver shows how to cook kinda sausage cassoulet, warm broccoli salad, and berry and custard pie in just thirty minutes.

programme.desc: Vegetarian meal; mushroom sarnie; tagliatelle; pecan and vanilla ice cream.

programme.desc: Jamie coaches comedians on diet.

programme.desc: Jamie shares his clever shortcuts for a prosciutto-wrapped roasted pork filet served with a cheesy gnocchi gratin, then whips up a prawn curry that's both easy to make and impressive, perfect with his giant crispy rice cake.

programme.title: Baked Mushroom Soup; Cauliflower Remoulade
programme.desc: Jamie takes mushrooms to a whole new level with his deliciously cheesy baked mushroom soup, and gives a classic salad a tasty twist with his stunning cauliflower rémoulade.

programme.desc: Jamie creates a sausage pie using golden mashed potatoes instead of pastry, and gives fish and chips a healthy makeover.

programme.desc: Jamie rustles up pork steaks, Hungarian pepper sauce and rice, plus killer kedgeree, beans, greens and chilli yogurt.

programme.desc: Rosemary chicken; grilled polenta and porcini tomato sauce; happy cow burgers; old school coleslaw; corn on the cob.

programme.desc: Jamie cooks sticky squid balls, grilled prawns and noodle broth, plus sausage fusilli and creamy garden salad.

programme.desc: Sizzling chops; sweet tomato and asparagus lasagnetti; mushroom soup; Stilton; apple and walnut croutes.

programme.desc: This time the meal is spiced chicken, bacon, asparagus and spinach lentils; falafel wraps, grilled veg and salsa.

programme.desc: Jamie cooks grilled tuna, "kinda" Niçoise salad, Thai chicken laksa, and mildly-spiced noodle squash broth.

programme.desc: Thai-style crispy sea bass; veggie tray bake; sweet chicken surprise; and pineapple carpaccio, a tropical dessert made in minutes.

programme.desc: Sticky kickin' chicken wings; sirloin with aubergines; creamy garlic mushroom pasta; rum 'n' raisin ice cream.

programme.desc: Steak, liver and bacon; bubble and squeak mash and red onion gravy; Mexican tomato soup; chili nachos; veggie and feta sprinkles.

programme.desc: White fish tagine; carrot, mint and clementine salad; spicy Cajun chicken; smashed sweet potatoes; corn salsa.

programme.desc: Jamie makes roast chicken with a kimchi glaze, fluffy rice and slaw, followed by salmon stuffed with creamy prawns and wrapped in bacon and an all-in-one pink cake.

programme.title: Hank's Christmas Wish
programme.desc: "Hank's Christmas Wish" tells the heartwarming tale of a retired elf seeking a life of seclusion. However, his plans are interrupted when a group of unrelentingly cheerful townsfolk, brimming with the holiday spirit, come into his life. Through their unwavering kindness and infectious joy, they help him rediscover the true meaning of Christmas. Packed with yuletide laughter, chestnut-roasting moments, and Jack Frost-nipping faith, this cutesy film captures the essence of the holiday season.

programme.title: By God's Grace
programme.desc: In the tradition of a classic "A Christmas Carol", this film offers many lessons on the importance of giving and the cause and effect our choices have on others.

programme.title: Paper Angels
programme.desc: Abused wife Lynn leaves her alcoholic husband and moves with her children to another town, where their lives become entwined with that of another family in trouble. This film is inspired by the hit country Christmas song, Paper Angels, by Jimmy Wayne.

programme.title: Miracle on Christmas
programme.desc: During the Christmas holiday, Mary (Erin Bethea) experiences emotional trials that cause her to question her faith until a visitor (Brett Varvel) arrives and her husband (Jason Burkey) receives an unexpected miracle.

programme.title: Lucy Shimmers' Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: Second chances start when a hardened criminal crosses paths with a precocious little girl who is helped by an angel to change hearts during the holiday season.

programme.title: The Miracle Of The Cards
programme.desc: There's no such thing as miracles. That's what a skeptical reporter (Kirk Cameron) thought until he met Craig Shergold (Thomas Sangster). Craig is an eight-year-old boy with a brain tumor and less than a year to live. Looking for hope, his mother (Catherine Oxenberg) pushes to break the Guinness World Record for receiving the most get-well cards. They receive an incredible 1.3 million cards and shatter the old record. However Craig continues to get worse.

programme.title: Our Father's Keeper
programme.desc: A successful family man suffering from early onset Alzheimer's wonders away from home and gets lost into the world the day before Thanksgiving, causing widespread panic within his family. He is eventually "rescued" by a fatherless, thirteen-year-old homeless girl. Together, they forge a unique friendship that ultimately heals broken hearts and redefines the meaning of "family".

programme.title: Christmas on Salvation Street
programme.desc: Noah Davis is a Pastor in an affluent community. Depressed after losing his wife to illness, he is contacted by an old friend who has opened a mission in a rough inner city neighborhood. With Christmas approaching, he packs up and together with his two daughters, moves into Salvation Street Mission. Now the family must struggle with the challenges they face in the crime ridden community.

programme.title: The Messenger's Box
programme.desc: When high school student Jake Casper finds a small wooden box in the attic of his grandpa's antique store, his life is forever changed, especially when he discovers a secret compartment that appears to contain a nail used during Christ's crucifixion. Now, the more Jake learns of the power within the box and its purpose, the more obstacles he must overcome to get the box to a stranger before it's too late.

programme.title: We Three Kings
programme.desc: Amy, Catherine, and Charles Fay can't wait for their Uncle Henry to arrive for Christmas. This is the first year since Mama passed away and the children are working together to fill the void and put together a Christmas play at their church. With the help of Uncle Henry's new song, "We Three Kings", not only is the Christmas pageant a success, but the children learn truths about Jesus and the gifts that were given to Him by the Magi.

programme.title: Shoelaces for Christmas
programme.desc: When Jennifer's father forces her to volunteer at the shelter to teach her compassion and responsibility, she creates an unlikely bond with the staff and a special young guest which makes her realize the true meaning of Christmas.

programme.title: Finding Christmas
programme.desc: Mikey Finnegan, a 17-year-old from Philly, dreams of becoming a pro gamer. After a Christmas Eve attack leaves him in a coma, he travels back to Bethlehem. Guided by a Guardian Angel, he must find baby Jesus to return home.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: Stanley explores his former home of Tuscany; he participates in a wine bar crawl, celebrates the importance of the lowly loaf and samples dishes which use stale bread as the key ingredient.

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: In Sicily, Stanley tastes the grapes grown in the region's unique soils and reflects on Sicilian hospitality.

programme.title: Punjab
programme.desc: Anthony dives into the ever-changing state of Punjab with a trip to Amritsar, sampling cuisine at a roadside restaurant, a Sikh celebration and a free community vegetarian restaurant.

programme.title: Las Vegas
programme.desc: Anthony pals up with food author Michael Ruhlman as they visit the Huntridge Tavern and Jose Andres' restaurant é; Penn Jillette and former mayor Oscar Goodman are pokin' around.

programme.title: Lyon
programme.desc: Anthony and Daniel Boulud travel to Lyon, France, to visit the city's rich food culture and legendary chefs.

programme.title: Mexico
programme.desc: Anthony travels to Mexico City, Oaxaca, and Cuernavaca to talk with local residents who express their passion through food and later to journalist Anabel Hernandez on the drug trade-related violence's impact.

programme.title: Mississippi
programme.desc: Anthony explores Mississippi including the home of the "Pig Ear Sandwich," downtown Jackson's Big Apple Inn, also known as a Civil Rights Era gathering place; then on to an old sharecropper structure turned juke joint, Po' Monkey's Social Club.

programme.title: Thailand
programme.desc: Anthony treks to the Chiang Mai province of Northern Thailand where he catches up with celebrated chef Andy Ricker of Pok Pok restaurants fame to explore the country's diverse and various seasonal eating and drinking scene.

programme.title: Brazil
programme.desc: Visiting Bahia, the African heart of Brazil; the dance/martial art of Capoeira; legendary food vendors; Salvadoran fishing neighborhoods.

programme.title: Venice
programme.desc: Stanley explores the city's fascinating food culture due to its aquatic environment, as well as the countless influences from around the world throughout its vast and storied history.

programme.title: Piedmont
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci visits Piedmont which boasts a refined French heritage.

programme.title: Umbria
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci visits Umbria, nicknamed "The Green Heart of Italy"; with the highest consumption of pork per capita, Umbria is a carnivore's dream; from wild boar hunts to black truffle farms, Stanley explores all Umbria has to offer.

programme.title: London
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci explores how Italian immigration transformed the food scene in his adopted hometown of London; London is a culinary mecca where Italian food from every region gets a chance to shine.

programme.title: Calabria
programme.desc: Tucci discovers the history of beautiful and troubled Calabria, Italy, as well as the history of his own family; joined by his parents and Italian relatives, he reflects on the inspiration people draw from Calabria and why those who leave return.

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Tucci visits the island of Sardinia, Italy, famous for its harsh, rugged landscape, crystal blue ocean, and passionately preserved traditions; Tucci learns how Sardinian food culture varies wildly throughout the island.

programme.title: Sardinia
programme.desc: Tucci visits Puglia, a region famous for its fragrant olive oil, beautiful vegetables, cheeses, and durum wheat; he discovers how the Pugliese own their past and embrace the future on their own terms.

programme.title: Liguria
programme.desc: Tucci visits the Italian Riviera famous for the glamor of Portofino and fishing villages of the Cinque Terre; he tries Genoese pesto and discovers how Ligurians have learned to adapt to life in the difficult landscape.

programme.title: Shanghai
programme.desc: Anthony explores Shanghai by sampling classic cuisine at restaurants Chun and Fuchun Xiaolong, while locals voice their insight on their booming economy and expanding global influence.

programme.title: The Bronx
programme.desc: Superstars Afrika Bambaataa, Melle Mel, and Baron Ambrosia help guide Anthony through the music, food and art of the often misunderstood, most northern part of NYC.

programme.title: Paraguay
programme.desc: Anthony is thrust into Paraguay by investigating his great, great, great, grandfather, Paraguayan émigré Jean Bourdain, while sampling savory local dishes that include Bife Koygua, Bori Bori, and Sopa Paraguaya.

programme.title: Vietnam
programme.desc: Anthony travels to his first love, Hue in central Vietnam, as he visits the Dong Ba market, Vinh Moc tunnels, the Duyen Anh restaurant and the Citadel.

programme.title: Tanzania
programme.desc: Bourdain comes face to face with lions, elephants, and the great migration in Zanzibar, Tanzania, a one-time slave trade hub, and samples mandazi, grilled seafood and the famous Zanzibari pizza.

programme.title: Iran
programme.desc: Bourdain and his crew take their long-awaited first trip to Iran, sampling Dizi, Fesenjan, Biryani, and Tahdig; tour guides include Washington Post reporter Jason Rezaian and his wife Yeganeh Salehi, who were detainees of the Iranian government.

programme.title: Massachusetts
programme.desc: Bourdain takes a very personal trip to Provincetown; we visit The Atlantic House and The Lobster Pot where he started his culinary career, and he candidly discusses his descent into heroin addiction, recovery and other nuggets of his past.

programme.title: Jamaica
programme.desc: Bourdain travels along the Northeast region of Jamaica and explores life in Port Antonio and Winnifred Beach where he meets Bob Marley's producer Chris Blackwell, and visits the home of author Ian Fleming.

programme.title: Korea
programme.desc: Following a long absence, Anthony travels to South Korea; the country has undergone significant development since his last visit; he tries kimchi, fried chicken and vintage army stew.

programme.title: Miami
programme.desc: After sampling cow foot soup in Little Haiti, Anthony tastes the Miami nightlife with Questlove, Willie Clark and Iggy Pop.

programme.title: Scotland
programme.desc: Deep-fried haggis, a knife defense lesson and a trip to the Scottish Highlands are on the menu in Glasgow.

programme.title: Budapest
programme.desc: Anthony explores Budapest's cuisine; he tastes chicken liver, fisherman's soup, blood sausage and goulash; he visits a butcher shop; he drinks at Café New York.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Bourdain visits the capital city of Madagascar, Tana and joins film director Darren Aronofsky for some Malagasy cuisine.

programme.title: New Jersey
programme.desc: Anthony joins his brother Chris to enjoy some fried hot dogs in his old New Jersey stomping grounds, then heads to Atlantic City for some food and fun.

programme.title: Hawaii
programme.desc: Anthony joins travel writer Paul Theroux and Chef Andrew Le for a meal at an ancient oceanside fishpond on a hidden side of Hawaii.

programme.title: Beirut
programme.desc: Anthony travels to "The Paris of the Middle East" known as Beirut; a city well known for its incredible cuisine and infamous nightlife.

programme.title: Naples and the Amalfi Coast
programme.desc: Feasting on pizza in Naples; finding the freshest mozzarella and the best San Marzano tomatoes; enjoying spaghetti and zucchini.

programme.title: Rome
programme.desc: Stanley heads to Rome in search of the famous four pastas, orders rigatoni all'amatriciana, samples carbonara and tries a selection of cheeses and sausages made from the sheep and pigs farmed in the region.

programme.title: Bologna
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci explores Bologna, seen by many as the food capital of Italy; the region of Emilia-Romagna is home to globally renowned protected food products.

programme.title: Korea

programme.title: Miami

programme.title: Scotland

programme.title: Budapest

programme.title: Madagascar

programme.title: New Jersey

programme.title: Hawaii

programme.title: Beirut

programme.title: Naples and the Amalfi Coast

programme.title: Rome

programme.title: Bologna

programme.title: Milan

programme.title: Tuscany

programme.desc: A Las Vegas gambler wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's bride-to-be.

programme.title: Corrina, Corrina
programme.desc: A family devastated by grief meets a woman who helps heal the loss.

programme.title: 16 Blocks
programme.desc: A world-weary cop must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness.

programme.title: Mr. Wonderful
programme.desc: An electrical worker is eager for his ex-wife to get remarried.

programme.title: Disorderlies
programme.desc: Winslow Lowry (Anthony Geary) is a greedy man determined to get his hands on the fortune of his ailing and very wealthy uncle, Albert Dennison (Ralph Bellamy). As a way to hasten Uncle Albert's death, Winslow puts him in the care of three hapless orderlies -- Buffy, Markie and Kool, also known as the Fat Boys (The Fat Boys) -- but their jolly dispositions actually make the elderly man feel better. When Winslow steps up his devious efforts, can the trio stop him?

programme.title: Message in a Bottle
programme.desc: A lonely woman's discovery of a man's letter in a bottle leads to love.

programme.title: Big Girls Don't Cry ... They Get Even
programme.desc: Fed up with her dysfunctional family, Laura (Hillary Wolf) runs away from her stepsiblings, half-siblings, divorced parents and stepparents just before the family takes a trip to Hawaii, supposedly as a celebration for her forgotten birthday. Whether hiding out with Josh (Dan Futterman), the one stepbrother Laura likes, or hitchhiking with quirky strangers, Laura is determined to escape her family -- even as her family seeks to find her and their own equilibrium.

programme.title: Guilty by Suspicion
programme.desc: McCarthyism in the 1950s prevents a Hollywood director from working.

programme.title: Suburban Commando
programme.desc: Problems with his rocket compel space-traveling vigilante Shep Ramsey (Hulk Hogan) to spend some time on Earth. Plunking himself down in the middle of suburbia, he rents a room from Charlie (Christopher Lloyd) and Jenny Wilcox (Shelley Duvall). Shep attempts to acclimate himself -- he skateboards, he accosts a mail carrier -- but he's destined to be a fish out of water. But when his outer space enemies arrive and pick a fight with his new friends, Shep is ready to prove his mettle.

programme.title: Ready To Rumble
programme.desc: Gordie Boggs (David Arquette) and Sean Dawkins (Scott Caan) are best friends who operate a sewage truck and idolize pro wrestler Jimmy King (Oliver Platt). After Diamond Dallas Page (Diamond Dallas Page) dethrones their hero, Gordie and Sean embark on a mission to help King get his title back. When they finally track him down, however, they discover that King is not too keen on recapturing his former glory. Can the boys find a way to motivate the faded champ?

programme.title: El Cantante
programme.desc: This biopic explores the life of innovative salsa musician Hector Lavoe.

programme.title: Ghosts of Mississippi
programme.desc: A district attorney reopens the case against the murderer of Medgar Evers.

programme.title: Strange Brew
programme.desc: In their quest for free beer, bumbling Canadian brothers Bob (Rick Moranis) and Doug McKenzie (Dave Thomas) wind up working at the Elsinore Brewery. The hapless lads uncover a sinister mind-control plot spearheaded by Brewmeister Smith (Max von Sydow) and must stop the scheme, which also involves Uncle Claude (Paul Dooley), a member of the Elsinore family. As Bob and Doug try to prevent Smith from taking over the world, they also manage to drink plenty of their favorite sudsy beverage.

programme.title: Graffiti Bridge
programme.desc: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."

programme.title: Surf Ninjas
programme.desc: Brothers Johnny (Ernie Reyes Jr.) and Adam (Nicolas Cowan) are coasting through a fun surfer existence in Los Angeles when they are suddenly accosted by a band of ninjas. A mysterious warrior comes to their aid, later telling the brothers that they are the royal heirs to the throne of Patusan, an embattled island under the rule of a tyrannical leader (Leslie Nielsen). After discovering their untapped ninja skills, Johnny and Adam agree to travel to Patusan to overthrow the current monarchy.

programme.title: Fathers' Day
programme.desc: Jack (Billy Crystal) is a straitlaced lawyer with a loving wife (Julia Louis-Dreyfus). Dale (Robin Williams) is suicidal about his stalled career as an artist. The only thing they have in common is Colette (Nastassja Kinski), with whom they both had an affair years ago. Unbeknownst to the two men, she had a son, Scott (Charlie Hofheimer), who is now missing. After she tells Jack and Dale that one of them could be the father, the pair set out to find Scott and prove who the real father is.

programme.title: I Am Sam
programme.desc: A man with an intellectual disability fights for custody of his daughter.

programme.title: Cannonball Run II
programme.desc: The usual suspects return for a new breakneck, ocean-to-ocean free for all!

programme.title: Arthur (1981)
programme.desc: A drunken playboy decides to give up his inheritance for true love.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Love threatens to come between a drunken playboy and his inheritance.

programme.desc: A cutting-edge, live action/animated action adventure comedy about one white blood cell's (Chris Rock) race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus (Laurence Fishburne). Bill Murray stars as Frank, in whose body the action unfolds.

programme.title: Deep Cover
programme.desc: David Jason (Jeff Goldblum) is the biggest drug dealer in Los Angeles, and Russell Stevens (Larry Fishburne) is an undercover cop who wants to bring him down. Posing as a dealer, Stevens begins to earn the trust of the L.A. drug underworld, eventually making his way to Jason himself. But along the way he has to take his cover to depths he never thought he would have to see, including selling drugs and going to great lengths to eliminate potential competitors for Jason's drug cartel.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Senior Trip
programme.desc: High schoolers head to D.C. after the President responds to their letter.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons
programme.desc: In the Kingdom of Izmer, wizards use their magic to rule the land. The young Empress Savina desires to use magic for good, but the evil Profion plans to utilize his powers to usurp the throne from Savina and subject the kingdom to totalitarian rule. Profion gains control of the kingdom's golden dragons, while Savina sets out to win control of the even more powerful red dragons, gaining the alliance of a motley group of individuals along the way.

programme.title: Protocol

programme.title: Pleasantville

While David initially takes to the simplistic, corny world of the show, Jennifer sets about jolting the characters with doses of reality that unexpectedly bring a little color into their drab existence.

programme.title: Preacher's Kid

Angela brings some spirit back into Roy's life, and some of his disorder symptoms seem to disappear. programme.title: Where Demons Dwell
programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. His terror grows daily. His mother is unsure how to respond-until David is physically attacked by an unseen force. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren discover demons within him. They must act before he is lost to darkness.

programme.title: Haunted Past
programme.desc: As Deborah Utley begins experiencing paranormal events in her home, she turns to her faith for protection. But when her children are targeted by the entity she seeks the aid of paranormal investigators to end the cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Haunting of Summerwind
programme.desc: On the shores of West Bay Lake, Wisconsin, a mansion known as Summerwind stands between the living and the dead. Ginger falls in love with the house despite warnings and moves in with her family. As she restores it, a supernatural force pushes her husband toward madness. With their family unraveling, Ginger and her children fear the house will consume them all.

programme.title: The Forgotten
programme.desc: April and Matt buy a Victorian home in Salt Lake City, eager to restore it. But an unseen force detests change. Renovations stall, voices whisper, and April's son sees movement in his closet. Then, a dark entity appears, determined to drive them out. A medium warns that the house holds tormented children's spirits-and if they don't fight back, they too will become forgotten.

programme.title: Eternal Grief
programme.desc: After moving into a rural Indiana home, Jennifer Patterson hears voices and smells strange scents, suspecting the deceased former owner still lingers. Hoping to coexist, she stays-until the activity turns violent after her boyfriend moves in. Fearing for their safety, the couple seeks help from paranormal experts to uncover the dark truth behind their haunting.

programme.title: The Dark Side
programme.desc: America is full of forgotten cemeteries, some buried beneath new homes. Bobby Wilcott buys a historic manor in Indiana, hoping renovations will strengthen his marriage. But strange occurrences strain their bond-doors won't stay shut, lights flicker, and unease grows. Paranormal experts Ed and Lorraine Warren confirm the worst: a demonic presence is feeding on their fear.

programme.title: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: Carl, Keith, and Cynthia use a spirit board to contact a ghost in their home. At first, it seems harmless, but as violent activity increases, Keith senses danger. Carl, obsessed with the entity, ignores the warnings-until Cynthia is attacked. Realizing they've unleashed something sinister, the brothers call in a paranormal investigator to stop the terrifying presence before it's too late.

programme.title: Sallie's House
programme.desc: Deb and Tony are excited to start their life together in Atchison, Kansas. With their first child on the way, they settle into a charming home, hopeful for the future. After their son is born, his toys move on their own. Deb believes he has a ghostly playmate-until Tony suffers whispers, ghostly footsteps, and bloody wounds. A psychic warns that a darker force is using the spirit to wreak havoc.

programme.title: Black Magic

A ritual sacrifice unleashes a dark force that torments the household. A pastor's blessing fails, and paranormal investigators face their toughest case yet as they battle an evil entity that refuses to be controlled.

A psychic warns that spirits are drawn to their home-and to a gruesome secret hidden in the crawlspace.

programme.title: Saigon Noodles for Breakfast
programme.desc: Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favorite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chili Crab Claws.

programme.title: Bangkok's Night Market
programme.desc: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy.

programme.title: Malaysian Flying Noodles and Pork Bone Soup
programme.desc: In Kuala Lumpur, Luke meets the famous Mr Hung with a reputation for flying instant noodles and Mr Sou who cooks a hearty Pork Bone Soup with medicinal herbal properties.

programme.title: Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
programme.desc: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

programme.title: Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
programme.desc: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

programme.title: Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
programme.desc: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

programme.title: Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
programme.desc: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

programme.title: Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

programme.title: Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
programme.desc: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programme.title: Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

programme.title: Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
programme.desc: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

programme.title: Sipping Gin in Sapa
programme.desc: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

programme.title: The French Connection
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

programme.title: The Highland Fling
programme.desc: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

programme.title: The Three Amigos
programme.desc: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.

programme.title: San Fran Summer of Love
programme.desc: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.

programme.title: Brokeback Mountain
programme.desc: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.

programme.title: Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
programme.desc: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.

programme.title: Desperately Seeking Santa
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred are getting together for another extraordinary culinary Christmas adventure. Gordon arranged a trip to the official home of Santa. They are going to Lapland to enjoy spectacular landscapes and meet Father Christmas in person.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

programme.title: The French Connection
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

programme.title: Stage 16 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Stage 1 - FINLAND - ICEMAN
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Stage 2 - MARTINIQUE - 2024
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Stage 3 - HUNGARY - 2024
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Stage 4 - SERBIA - 2024
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Stage 5 - HOLLAND - 2024 - Part 1
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Stage 6 - HOLLAND - 2024 - Part 2
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Stage 7 - FINLAND - 2024 - World record breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Stage 8 - ESTONIA - 2024
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Stage 9 - PORTUGAL - 2024
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Stage 10 - POLAND - 2024
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Stage 11 - DUBAI - 2024 - Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Stage 12 - DUBAI - 2024 - Part 2
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Stage 13 - CYPRUS - 2024
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Stage 14 - SOUTH AFRICA - 2024
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Stage 15 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 1
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Stage 16 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 2
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Stage 01 - ICEMAN - Finland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Stage 02 - Latvia
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Stage 03 - Serbia
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Stage 04 - Italy
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Stage 05 - Holland Part 1
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Stage 06 - Holland Part 2
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Stage 07 - Worlds Strongest Viking - Finland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World's Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Stage 08 - Worlds Strongest Latino - Portugal
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World's Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Stage 09 - Worlds Strongest Truckpull - England
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Stage 10 - Poland
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Stage 11 - Hungary
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Stage 12 - USA Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events - including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal's Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Stage 13 - SCL USA Part 2
programme.desc: It's the final day of the Strongman Champions League's first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120-200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Stage 14 - Dubai Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Stage 15 - Dubai Part 2
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: Stage 16 - South Africa Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

programme.title: Stage 17 - South Africa Part 2
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World's Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

programme.desc: Romeo drops a bombshell on the Simmons family; Egypt's boyfriend Sam does sneaky business at a pawn shop; a secret engagement is exposed.

programme.title: Fireworks, Boom!
programme.desc: Angela and Romeo's rivalry comes to a head at Romeo's party; JoJo flies off the handle; a scandal strikes Salt-N-Pepa; Briana does something unexpected.

programme.title: A Proposal in the Heir
programme.desc: Romeo blocks everyone on social media and causes uproar, but Angela has receipts; Tee Tee and Tyran join forces to derail Sam and Egypt's trip to the altar, and warn Pepa and Treach before it's too late; Angela plans to squash the beef with Briana.

programme.title: No Run in the Oven
programme.desc: JoJo's baby fever causes dismay in Tanice, and he seeks marriage advice from Rev Run; Pepa warns Tee Tee to stop meddling in Egypt and Sam's relationship while Briana rages on; Ava breaks down over the legal battle with her father, Dame.

programme.title: Serving the Tee Tee
programme.desc: Angela and Briana's long-lasting feud comes to a head; a secret marriage shocks all; while Romeo is out of the country, Boogie takes his shot with Angela; a rumor spreads that Tee Tee is in love with Sam, and Lil Twist puts it on full blast.

programme.title: Yo Boogie Got the Next Date
programme.desc: With Romeo on ice, things fire up between Angela and Boogie; Tee Tee runs into some old foes; Sam is served a fair warning before he seeks Pepa and Treach's blessing to marry Egypt; Boogie opens up a rehab facility, but Dame smells a scam.

programme.title: Watch Out Sammy
programme.desc: Sam is shaken when he asks Treach for his blessing to marry Egypt; Panic strikes when Tee Tee's sabotage derails Sam's proposal; Rev Run counsels JoJo and Tanice while they navigate through their relationship issues before officiating their marriage.

programme.title: Is That the Joker?
programme.desc: Sam's proposal goes off without a hitch and triggers further investigation; Angela bursts into tears when she faces tragedy and heartbreak; Vanessa meets with Master P and is caught back in the middle of a major rivalry between Angela and Romeo.

programme.title: Nothing a Few Shots Can't Fix
programme.desc: All hell breaks loose at Egypt's 21st birthday when drama with Sam ignites and Tee Tee tries to shut the cameras down; Briana and Eric's wife, Aaliyah, nearly come to blows; Bow Wow shows up for Angela just when tragedy strikes.

programme.title: Love and War

programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he's touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Boston's (Un)Common Collection
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston's collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: C&O at the Beach
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country's coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it's a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag'N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Oddballs and Icons
programme.desc: Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free '55 Chevy he knows it's a too good of a deal to pass up.

programme.title: A Tale of Two DeLoreans
programme.desc: When a client puts out the call for a DeLorean, Tony finds two dramatically different contenders: one showroom-clean, the other frozen in time. It's nostalgia versus perfection as Tony helps figure out what's the best route for his client to take.

programme.title: Hot Rods and Porsches
programme.desc: Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer. Then, a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

programme.title: Mopar to Midair
programme.desc: Tony teams up with the Auto Archeologist, Ryan Brutt, to uncover one of the rarest Dodge Demons in existence. Then Tony follows the trail to make an offer on a movie-star, an Eleanor Mustang. With this deal, the sky's the limit!

programme.title: Unboxing a Mustang
programme.desc: Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle swap meet where there's rusty gold and an old Jeep waiting for him.

programme.title: Love Hurst
programme.desc: An iconic Hurst Oldsmobile emerges from years in storage and roars back to life in the shop. Meanwhile, a cold call takes Tony to a Chevelle project that creates more questions than it answers and the owner needs some help figuring out what to do with it.

programme.title: Oddballs and Icons
programme.desc: Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free '55 Chevy he knows it's a too good of a deal to pass up.

programme.title: A Tale of Two DeLoreans
programme.desc: When a client puts out the call for a DeLorean, Tony finds two dramatically different contenders: one showroom-clean, the other frozen in time. It's nostalgia versus perfection as Tony helps figure out what's the best route for his client to take.

programme.title: Kenny Roger's Family Values
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: SEMA: Inside Fuller's Head
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we'll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn't always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Motor Masters
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder's take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Viva Cuba!
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Scerif

programme.title: Magnus Walker's Secret Porsche Collection
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Chipper Jones' International Car Show
programme.desc: A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.

programme.title: Fuller's "2029" Majestic Build
programme.desc: Back to the future with a Majestic build from Fuller Moto that showcases 3-D printed parts, an electric motor, and hub-centric steering.

programme.title: The Fastest Man on Two Wheels
programme.desc: Horsepower and million-dollar sticker shock, from two and four wheels, dominate this edition of C & O.

programme.title: MODEL T
programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: DAN GURNEY
programme.desc: Ray finds a Gurney Eagle in a garage on Long Island. He wants to put the coveted machine back on the track at Indy to honor Dan Gurney. After intense restoration and scouring the globe for a Gurney-Westlake engine, the Eagle soars again.

programme.title: VINTAGE RACING
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous "Brawner Hawk" - from the Dean Van Lines team - that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car's original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: TWO JUNIORS
programme.desc: Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It's not a typical restoration, but it's certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: MACHINE MAGIC MARIO
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he's propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner - none other than Bill Elliott, aka "Awesome Bill from Dawsonville."

programme.title: HOLLYWOOD MAKEOVER
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray's case, it was the '58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: Power Play: Proline's Search for 3000+ HP
programme.desc: A need for speed in a Sleepy Georgia town has engineers pushing the boundaries to exceed 3000 horsepower.

programme.title: Turn of the Century Cars
programme.desc: Turn of the century cars?with wooden wheels?at 85mph?oh my!

programme.title: Hot Wheel's & an Urban Outlaw
programme.desc: Urban Outlaw and designer Magnus Walker weighs in on his beloved Porsche and the legend of Hot Wheels.

programme.title: Proving Provenance on a One-Off Ferrari
programme.desc: Tracing the origins and solving the mystery of a controversial all-aluminum bodied 512 BBI Boxer Ferrari.

programme.title: Twin City Turbos
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes Turbo in the Twin Cities; Ferrari Drifter Federico Sceriffo finds a home in Atlanta.

programme.title: 470MPH with Custom King George Poteet
programme.desc: Jaguar F-Type Project 7 crosses the Pond.

programme.title: Art & Oddities at Old Car City, USA

programme.title: The Unsung Hero in the Movie Ford v. Ferrari
programme.desc: Red carpet receptions for a Koenigsegg Regera.

programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan throw a couple hundred horses at a 2010 Camaro pace car with a new supercharger.

programme.title: 2004 Corvette Gets Shocked
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan upgrade the Federated Corvette with new suspension components.

programme.title: Hot Hybrid
programme.desc: High MPG doesn't have to be boring. Kevin and Bryan add a few of their own touches to a new Prius.

programme.title: 2004 Corvette Upgrades

programme.desc: With a rough running Impala in the shop, the guys check out the MAF sensor.

programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan give a Saturn a once over before it gets donated to Wheels for Hope.

programme.title: 2004 Corvette Completion
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan say goodbye to the Federated Corvette project and give a lucky Vette owner a new performance clutch.

programme.title: Pick-Up the Pieces
programme.desc: Like many projects, this 1954 Chevy 3100 restoration has stalled. So, we're going to help this owner pickup the pieces on this project by installing a new 350 engine, completely overhaul the front end, and bolt-on new bumpers. After were done, this truck will be ready to get wired and fired.

programme.title: Billie Hop
programme.desc: Sometimes Bruno will do a favor for a fellow Race Car Driver friend. That's why Top Fuel driver Clay Millican's old Dodge Cummins is in the shop. Like everything Clay drives, this truck is tortured and has broke a few things. Matt and Bruno get to play pit today on Truck U.

programme.title: Off-Road Toyota
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt have earned some vacation time, but before they get to take a break they need to finish work on the 2012 Toyota Tacoma 4wd. The guys transform a Toyota into a Expedition vehicle that can light up any path in its way.

programme.title: Trail Rocker
programme.desc: It's time for the ultimate axle reconstructive surgery.We install brand new Dana 44 axles on a 2008 Jeep Jk 4 wheel drive.

programme.title: Collector Truck
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno install a portable bedwood kit on a collector 1946 Ford Truck and we give the truck a mini restoration under the hood.

programme.title: Recovery Vehicle
programme.desc: If you're not prepared to break off-road, you might as well not even play. We'll show you what "must-have" parts you need to recover your off-road vehicle.
