programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars (Ryan Gosling) finds it impossible to make friends or socialize. His brother (Paul Schneider) and sister-in-law (Emily Mortimer) worry about him, so when he announces that he has a girlfriend he met on the Internet, they are overjoyed. But Lars' new lady is a life-size plastic woman. On the advice of a doctor (Patricia Clarkson), his family and the rest of the community go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Vamps
programme.desc: Bloodsucking party girls find their destinies at stake when one falls for the son of a vampire hunter and the other encounters a long-ago love.

programme.title: BloodRayne
programme.desc: In 18th-century Romania, after spending much of her life in a traveling circus, human-vampire hybrid Rayne (Kristanna Loken) escapes and plots to take down her evil vampire father, Kagan (Ben Kingsley). When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

programme.title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
programme.desc: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

programme.title: The Takeover
programme.desc: In under two centuries, favorite food brands span continents and cultures, spur innovation and technology, and forever change the food landscape.

programme.title: The Taste
programme.desc: Food preferences are influenced by dozens of factors, including genetics, environment and habit, but the taste is also about perception; the color, texture and weight of food are as important as the flavor.

programme.title: The Marketing
programme.desc: At one point, each and every food brand had to come up with a plan to get people to try them; today, the food and drink marketing industry is worth about $900 billion and growing.

programme.title: The Supply Chain
programme.desc: With every single bite or sip that people take, they participate in one of the most sophisticated journeys around the world ever taken; the global food supply chain is part of an $8 trillion network that produces over 4 billion tons of food annually.

programme.title: The Impact
programme.desc: Food brands travel around the world, stick around and change the places they visit; once the food is adopted by eager taste buds, it becomes part of local culture and tradition.

programme.title: The Future
programme.desc: Climate change, a global pandemic, and a booming world population mark an opportune time to be in the food business, not unlike the first wave of the industrial food revolution that gave people the first globally mass-produced, processed foods.

A future world leader becomes the star of a reality series; the seeds for ISIS are sown as the former leader of Iraq faces justice; one man risks his life to combat supersize meals; a space-airline is born; exploring the red planet.

The coming collapse of the planet hits the agenda of world leaders for the first time; a historic empire falls as technological and wizarding empires are created; a sporting superstar is born and icons are wrenched away at the height of their fame.

The USSR begins to lose grip on power in Eastern Europe, climaxing in the collapse of the Berlin Wall; the Chinese government stamps hard on student protests in Beijing; environmental disaster in Alaska; an earthquake sends shock waves in California.

In 1981, Prince Charles finally finds his bride, culminating in the wedding of the century; elsewhere in the world, events take an uglier turn with the attempted assassinations of various prominent leaders.

1977 holds celebrations in the form of Queen Elizabeth II's Silver Jubilee, the space shuttle's first test flight, and the release of "Star Wars"; it is also a year of terrorism, hijacks and assassinations.

programme.title: Killer Elite [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: The Mouse Trap
programme.desc: Stuck working the late shift at the amusement park arcade, Alex receives a surprise visit from her friends on her 21st birthday. However, their night of fun soon turns into a fight for survival when a killer dressed as Mickey Mouse crashes the party.

programme.title: Shiver Me Timbers
programme.desc: In Northern California during the summer of 1986, Olive Oyl, along with her cinema-obsessed friends and brother Castor, embark on a once-in-a-lifetime camping trip to witness the dazzling meteor shower accompanying the arrival of Halley's comet. But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

programme.title: In Flight
programme.desc: The night before Claire Reynolds' trip to Paris, she catches the eye of a mysterious, handsome stranger. That's the last thing she remembers before waking up on a plane with no recollection of what happened after that.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Timecop [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Andy needs some quick cash gets his younger brother into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit crimes.

programme.title: The Lost Princess
programme.desc: A billionaire gets transported to a bloody battle that leads him to an old castle in Morocco. He soon meets Hanna, who shares the tragic tale of her mother's forced marriage to a Saudi prince, and her secret love affair with a castle caretaker.

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: A Great Divide
programme.desc: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

programme.title: Brother Orange
programme.desc: In 2014, BuzzFeed writer Matt Stopera's phone was stolen from a bar in New York City. A year later, photos of storefronts and a man next to an orange tree mysteriously appeared in his iPhoto stream. Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Brotherhood Of The Wolf [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Crawdaddy
programme.desc: Amid the pandemic, Gwynn grows bored with her relationship with Adam. A sex dream involving their friend Lance ignites fantasies, transforming her COVID bubble into a chaotic love triangle.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: During the Cold War a secret organization created an elite squad of superheroes to defend the Soviet Union.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven
programme.desc: In this animated feature, canine casino owner Charlie (Burt Reynolds) is killed by gambler Carface (Vic Tayback), but returns to Earth from heaven thanks to the powers of a magical, rewindable watch. Charlie sets out to take his revenge on Carface by means of an elaborate plan that involves an orphan girl, Anne-Marie. But as the plan progresses, Charlie discovers that Anne-Marie is being exploited by Carface. Charlie must decide whether to change his mission from one of revenge to one of rescue.

programme.title: An All Dogs Christmas Carol
programme.desc: In this animated adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic book, Christmas is coming, and pooch pals Itchy (Dom DeLuise), Charlie Barkin (Steve Weber) and Sasha (Sheena Easton) decide to raise enough cash for injured pup Timmy to get a much-needed operation. Unfortunately, mean-spirited canines Carface (Ernest Borgnine) and Killer (Charles Nelson Reilly) rob the kindhearted dogs before they can give Timmy his present, prompting Charlie and the gang to concoct a ghostly plan to retrieve their money.

programme.title: The Secret of NIMH
programme.desc: Mrs. Brisby (Elizabeth Hartman), a widowed mouse, must move her children out of their home in a field before the local farmer starts plowing. Unable to leave because her son is ill, Mrs. Brisby seeks the help of nearby rats, who have heightened intelligence after being the subjects of scientific experiments. She receives an unexpected gift from the elder rat, Nicodemus (Derek Jacobi). Soon Mrs. Brisby is caught in a conflict among the rats, jeopardizing her mission to save her family.

programme.title: The BFG
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Sophie is in for the adventure of a lifetime when she meets the Big Friendly Giant. Naturally scared at first, the young girl soon realizes that the 24-foot behemoth is actually quite gentle and charming. As their friendship grows, Sophie's presence attracts the unwanted attention of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and other giants. After traveling to London, Sophie and the BFG must convince Queen Victoria to help them get rid of all the bad giants once and for all.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Tough Love

programme.title: Part 3: Broken Silence
programme.desc: Criminologist Prof David Wilson conducts a series of interviews with convicted murderer Bert Spencer, the man suspected of - yet never charged with - killing paperboy Carl Bridgewater in 1978.

programme.title: La Rusa
programme.desc: Tito es un hombre de 50 años que atraviesa una crisis personal y decide regresar a su ciudad. Cuando llega, se encuentra con un pueblo mucho más tranquilo y deprimido, dominado por la familia Crespo.

programme.title: Dead on Arrival
programme.desc: Amanda wants the head of a high-tech bank robber, while Nick seeks an antidote for the poison that is slowly killing him.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: The Elf TV Cut
programme.desc: Nick is haunted by night terrors stemming from a tragic murder he saw when he was young. After inheriting an old toy shop, he discovers a cursed elf doll sealed inside an ancient chest with a naughty list of his family's names written on it. He soon discovers that the elf was an evil conduit meant to unleash a supernatural killing spree during the Christmas Holidays by whomever set it free.

programme.title: Freaks
programme.desc: Kept locked inside the house by her father, 7-year-old Chloe lives in fear and fascination of the outside world, where Abnormals create a constant threat - or so she believes. When a mysterious stranger offers her a glimpse of what's really happening outside, Chloe soon finds that while the truth isn't so simple, the danger is very real.

programme.title: The Jack in the Box
programme.desc: When a vintage Jack In The Box is unearthed and donated to a museum in the heart of the woods, it's not long before a staff member realizes that the creepy clown doll inside has a life of its own and that his colleagues are dying one-by-one.

programme.title: Hoax
programme.desc: An investigative team travels deep into the wilderness after a group of campers are murdered by what may be Bigfoot.

programme.title: Darknet EP 3
programme.desc: A salesman enters a strange race to arrive at a meeting first; a woman applying as a nanny endures a disturbing interview.

programme.title: Wolf Blood S1 Ep11-Eolas
programme.desc: Maddy discovers a new wolf sense and can't get enough of it, but will this new obsession destroy her?

programme.title: 8213: GacyHouse
programme.desc: John Wayne Gacy murdered 33 young men and boys between 1972 and 1978 in suburban Chicago. 26 bodies were found in a crawl space beneath his house and 3 others were buried in the backyard. Although the house was completely demolished during the exhumation of the bodies, on May 15, 2004 a group of paranormal investigators wired the home that was built in its place with paranormal detection and surveillance equipment. The outcome of the investigation was grisly, terrifying and disturbing.

programme.title: A Perfect Enemy
programme.desc: After missing his flight, a successful architect meets a mysterious young woman. They strike up a conversation that grows stranger and more twisted until it turns deadly.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As convicted serial killer Ivan Mozer is being executed by the electric chair a prison riot breaks out, allowing him the opportunity for escape. He is assumed dead and the prison is soon closed. Eighteen months later a film crew arrives to shoot at the prison only to discover that Mozer is not, in fact, dead.

programme.title: Ghostville
programme.desc: When the living choose to seek communication with the souls of the dead, tempt fate by calling forth spirits in a state of unrest, tread where fear is sure to follow, they may find that all roads lead to Ghostville.

programme.title: Canada's Most Haunted
programme.desc: Frightening paranormal activity abounds in the Great White North. From mansions to sea ports, Canada has as much haunted history as Europe and America combined. Prepare for an exciting thrill ride to some of Canada's most haunted locations.

programme.title: 2020 Nostradamus
programme.desc: Nostradamus predicted the rise of Hitler, the nuclear destruction of Hiroshima and 9/11. New research reveals further predictions that indicate more peril is on the horizon.

programme.title: Better Criminal
programme.desc: A police officer is forced to work for two warring crime syndicates while under an internal investigation.

programme.title: Tai Chi Zero
programme.desc: Yang has arrived to learn, only to find that their Tai Chi is forbidden to outsiders. A mysterious man arrives with a fearsome machine, having to put their faith in Yang for help.

programme.title: The Ex-Files
programme.desc: Nick and Amanda both want Dr. Julian Heller's head -- as does Nick's ex-wife -- for selling human organs on the black market.

programme.title: The Frame
programme.desc: Amanda and Nick are accused of stealing a $20 million painting and meet up with another Immortal while trying to clear their names.

programme.title: Solum
programme.desc: A reality show on an uninhabited island where eight contestants must fight for their survival becomes more than it appears to be. Solum is not just a game -- it's a test, a selection process, and a mirror that confronts the truth of Human Nature, with the falsehoods of Mankind.

programme.title: Death Knot
programme.desc: Hari and her sister return to the village where they were born after the death of their mother, a practitioner of black magic. But the inexplicable suicides of several villagers cause the hostility towards the two to explode.

programme.title: Old Strangers
programme.desc: Three friends reconnect in a secluded mountain town after a long quarantine. While out for a hike, the trio stumble upon something dark and terrible in the deep woods.

programme.title: The Love Witch
programme.desc: A modern-day witch uses spells and magic to get men to fall in love with her, in a tribute to 1960s Technicolor thrillers.

programme.title: Evil Eyes
programme.desc: In the vein of Stephen King's THE SHINING, EVIL EYES tells the story of a screenwriter who is hired by an eccentric producer to write a screenplay about a ruthless serial killer. As he works on the script, devising unique and terryifying ways for his characters to die, similar deaths seem to be happening to the people around him.

programme.title: Apocalypse of Ice
programme.desc: Already in the throes of a viral pandemic, a massive polar vortex threatens to cover nearly all of Earth in ice. When it's discovered the only chance of survival from the cold is a 100-mile temperate zone near the equator, a virologist, with the pandemic's only cure, must reach the safe zone within 24 hours if humanity is to have any hope of survival.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: A couple and their daughter move to Colombia to take over a family manufacturing plant, only to realize their new home is haunted.

programme.title: Open 24 Hours
programme.desc: A former mental patient lands the graveyard shift at a gas station, where the isolation triggers her condition, bringing gruesome results.

programme.title: Vietnam! Vietnam!
programme.desc: Inspired by a series of articles by Thomas Duggan Goss. Vietnam:The People and the War - The Vietnamese in their normal daily routine. Their lives when having been affected by insurgents. Wives of prisoners of war in Vietnam talking about their incessant activities on behalf of their husband's plights.

programme.title: Skull World
programme.desc: Follows two years in the life of Greg Sommer, aka Skull Man, as he builds the Canadian chapter of Box Wars, an international underground movement of cardboard-based combat.

programme.title: Demons
programme.desc: A young rock band visits a deserted house to record their new album but things take a nightmarish turn when their Satanist manager attempts to open the gates of Hell.

programme.title: White Haired Witch
programme.desc: Based on one of China's most popular novels, the White Haired Witch tells a gripping story of kung fu, fantasy, revenge and death.

programme.title: The Beyond
programme.desc: Astronauts modified with advanced robotics are sent through a newly discovered wormhole. When the mission returns unexpectedly, the space agency races to discover what the astronauts encountered on their groundbreaking interstellar journey.

programme.title: D-Railed
programme.desc: Passengers on a train that crashes into a river must decide whether to risk waiting for help in the wreckage or take their chances in the murky depths below.

programme.title: Playhouse
programme.desc: In a remote Scottish castle, an irreverent writer faces terrifying consequences when his daughter falls prey to an evil curse lurking within the walls.

programme.title: They Look Like People
programme.desc: Suspecting that those around him are actually malevolent shape-shifters, a troubled man questions whether to protect his only friend from an impending war, or from himself.

programme.title: Undergods
programme.desc: An otherworldly journey through a Europe in decline - a collection of darkly humorous, fantasy tales about ill-fated characters and doomed fortune.

programme.title: Fifty Shades Of Black
programme.desc: Marlon Wayans stars in this hilarious spoof of the hit Fifty Shades of Grey franchise.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As Monty brings in the summer harvest, he gives advice on what to sow to keep the crops coming up to the end of Autumn. Carol Klein visits a woman who is losing her eyesight and gives her recommendations of plants that will be a feast for her senses.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: This time there's plenty to do to prepare for the season to come, and Monty Don is clearing out spent crops and mulching his asparagus. Joe Swift's been to visit keen gardeners, Wayne and Geraldine Hemingway, to see how they combine sustainability with their designer-style. Carol Klein's exploring the history of the rose at Coughton Court, one of our best rose gardens and Monty plants a new rose of his own. What happens when you have to downsize and leave your much-loved garden?

programme.title: Bury & Hackney
programme.desc: Monty Don visits two sets of ambitious gardeners, each facing challenges on a very different scale. One is a tiny urban courtyard in Hackney and the other is an outdoor area for a community.

programme.title: Essex & Ipswich
programme.desc: Monty meets two sets of gardeners who have unimaginable ambitions for their outdoor spaces. In Essex Denise has never ventured beyond the decking area behind her house. Meanwhile in Ipswich, a father and daughter plan to build a terraced allotment.

programme.title: Stockport & Tufnell Park
programme.desc: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice, but can Monty set them on the right track?

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives his top tips for filling gaps in the summer borders, using an array of plants to extend the season and take the garden into the autumn and beyond. Rachel de Thame explores a garden in Devon which has been transformed from a pig farm into a colourful paradise, and Frances Tophill discovers the surprising medicinal and homoeopathic properties of some of Britain's favourite garden plants.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is thinking ahead to the next year and makes a start on adding foxtail lilies to his borders, Rachel de Thame delves into the extraordinary world of bees, and Arit Anderson visits a green oasis where texture and form take centre stage.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty continues his preparations for the next year by getting some daffodils in the ground. He gives his summer-fruiting raspberries a prune, plants a fragrant honeysuckle on the Mound, and offers up some advice on how best to deal with that gardeners' nemesis, bindweed. Plus, Frances Tophill visits pioneering horticulturist Josh Sparkes at his experimental plot in Devon to uncover some sustainable food production secrets, and Nick Bailey reveals his beautiful new border at home.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Arit Anderson and Adam Frost explore the secret behind the enduring charm of East Ruston Old Vicarage. Carol Klein promotes an efficient gardening technique. Rekha Mistry focuses on her new vegetable patch.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Planning ahead for next year, Monty plants camassias and cyclamen for a spring display and sows hardy annuals into his cut flower beds, whilst in the veg garden he plants out strawberries.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives his tips on how to keep lawns looking their best throughout autumn. Rachel de Thame visits National Collection of asters in Worcester. Adam Frost discovers how the derelict garden of Peckover House in Cambridgeshire was restored.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill explains how to help tackle the decline of butterflies and pollinators in gardens. Carol Klein visits a garden brimming with late summer colour, and Joe Swift meets a couple who have transformed their urban space into a green oasis.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn well and truly under way, Monty shares his tips on how to get more for your money when buying perennials. Planning ahead for a vibrant spring display, he also creates a bulb lasagne in a pot and harvests his pumpkins.

programme.title: Rome
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Florence
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: The South
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty shows how to harvest and store potatoes. He also adds late summer colour to the cottage garden and prunes shrub roses. Carol Klein travels to Norfolk to meet Adrian Bloom, a member of a horticultural dynasty.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don tackles the perennial problem of what to grow in the shade beneath a tree, Carol Klein has a look at the crocosmia, and we meet a gardener in Derbyshire who has spent a lifetime growing and showing gladioli.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn well under way, some plants in the garden need to be brought in under cover. Monty Don makes a start by insulating his greenhouse to provide a winter home for all sorts of tender plants and gives his tips and techniques for ensuring their survival until next year. Carol Klein visits the garden of a tropical plant enthusiast to find out how he protects some of his exotic specimens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

programme.title: Blackpool/Cumbria
programme.desc: Two gardeners, each living on their own, are hoping Monty can help them. In Blackpool, Alex dreams of turning her boring backyard into a magical enchanted forest. Also in Bristol, Ross has taken on a very over-grown allotment.

programme.title: Leyton
programme.desc: In Leyton, Tariq and Sairah want to turn their dumping ground of a backyard into a sumptuous award-winning garden, suitable for entertaining friends and family. Both have competitive jobs in the banking sector and are used to winning at work but when it comes to gardening, they don't know where to begin.

programme.title: Cadeby and Sussex
programme.desc: One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

programme.title: Solihull
programme.desc: The team help Richard and Darren create a slice of New York's 'High Line' garden in Solihull. The garden has famously turned a disused train line into a thriving garden, mixing contemporary paving, grass planting and historical leftover train tracks.

programme.title: Appleton
programme.desc: In Warrington, the team answer an SOS from ten-year-old Oliver, their youngest applicant ever. Bike-mad Oliver wants something that no one else has ever asked the designers for: a BMX track in his back garden.

programme.title: Leamington Spa
programme.desc: The team are in Leamington Spa to help Robert and Gemma and their young daughter Darcey. The family want a place where Darcey can come out and play without fear of falling into nettles or injuring herself on the uneven and broken patio.

programme.title: Swindon
programme.desc: In Swindon, busy working couple Nicola and Anthony moved to their new house a year ago. They regard it as their forever dream home, but the garden is letting them down, and they hope to bring some Mediterranean glamour to it.

programme.title: Petersfield
programme.desc: Jeannie and Norman have spent their retirement making the most of their long garden in Petersfield, Hampshire, but they want to turn an area at the back into a secluded, calm, Japanese-inspired 'garden within a garden' just for them.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's apple harvest time, so Monty collects some of his windfalls to juice, plants a shrub in the Cottage Garden and pots up amaryllis bulbs for Christmas.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill is back at Powderham Castle in Devon, where she puts the finishing touches to a new herb bed. She prepares the vegetable beds for winter, planning for spring colour by planting tulip bulbs.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants a rose against a shady wall and checks on the progress of his supermarket garlic. Adam Frost visits a plantsman's paradise at Fullers Mill in Suffolk as the autumn colour emerges.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants a hawthorn hedge in the orchard, prunes a climbing rose and starts to plant tulips for next spring. He puts his dahlia tubers into storage and offers some timely advice for protecting plants over winter.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: After a busy winter, Monty plants up pots for early colour, shows how to move a clematis and sows veg for the year ahead. Adam Frost visits Ventnor Botanic Garden on the Isle of Wight. A gardener turned a concrete slab into her dream with containers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty makes the most of the longer days as he continues the rejuvenation of his Jewel Garden borders. Joe Swift meets a group of neighbours championing their front gardens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty adds herbaceous perennials to the Jewel Garden. Nick Bailey visits a gardener in Essex for matrix planting. Frances is at a garden in Bradford. A grower in Dorset is dedicated to dahlias, and a gardener in Cambridgeshire planted 35 trees.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty undertakes more seasonal jobs at Longmeadow. Arit Anderson meets a garden designer in Somerset who has worked in harmony with nature to create a garden on a former brownfield site.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don tackles autumn lawn maintenance tasks, Carol Klein is looking at burnets, and we meet a man who's dedicated himself to a North American prairie favourite, the echinacea.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don has plenty to be getting on with at Longmeadow. In his quest to track down some of the nation's most remarkable allotments, Joe Swift visits a tropical paradise in Runcorn.

programme.title: Wakefield and Swindon
programme.desc: A truck driver from Wakefield with a passion for flowers wants to create a perfect outside space for his girlfriend and burgeoning family, while in Swindon a widow wants to find the best way of turning her bleak patch of green into a cottage garden.

programme.title: Corris and Hayling
programme.desc: Monty travels to two corners of the country where the challenges he faces are very different. On the south coast he is presented with a front garden ravaged by salty winds, and in Snowdonia he helps a mountainside garden.

programme.title: Bromley and Dorset
programme.desc: Monty faces some of the most surprising plans yet - a Norwegian garden complete with waterfalls to be fashioned out of a tiny backyard in Dorset, and nothing less than a Japanese tea garden to be created out of a patch of ground in Bromley.

programme.title: Venice
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Croatia
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Greece
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Central Spain
programme.desc: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

programme.title: Southern Spain
programme.desc: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

programme.title: Northern Spain
programme.desc: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's full steam ahead at Longmeadow for Monty, who is busy getting the garden summer-ready. He is planning displays bursting with colour and scent, sharing some of his favourite foliage to create a tapestry of texture in shade.

programme.title: Waterfowl Hunting: The Ultimate Mixed Bag Morning

With mild weather keeping the birds scarce, it turns into a slow-burn hunt, as widgeon, a mallard and a rare gadwall hen fall over the decoys. Along the way, they explain how to tell a mature widgeon hen from a juvenile by its wing feathers.

programme.title: Would You Hunt with the 22 Creedmoor? Speed Test & Hornady Review
programme.desc: Can a .22-caliber rifle reach 1,500 yards? Todd Helms puts Hornady's 22 Creedmoor to the test with four loads: Precision Hunter, Match, V-Match and Superformance CX. He shoots groups and clocks velocities over the chronograph, and shares the Wyoming mule deer he took with the 80-grain ELD-X.

programme.title: Grit Pays Off! DIY Elk Bow Hunt with Brian Barney
programme.desc: Twelve days into a tough September elk season, Brian Barney and buddy Dylan Ness pack a lightweight spike camp into public-land bowls and glass for a mature six-point. With an hour of light left, they ditch their packs, sprint to the next ridge and use the terrain to stalk into bow range. Then comes the hard part: breaking down the bull and getting the meat off the mountain on no sleep.

programme.title: 3-Man Limit! River Duck Hunt with Wingmen

Todd Helms is joined by good friends Josh and Greg for some fellowship, and hopefully decoying a few ducks. Weather has been mild and the local birds are stale, but the guys manage to fill out a three-man limit on greenheads with some bonus geese in the mix.

programme.title: Sig Sauer Image Stabilizing Binoculars
programme.desc: Mike Eastman reviews Sig Sauer's Zulu6 HDX image-stabilizing binoculars. He shows how stabilization takes the shake out of glassing in the wind, why the 20-power model can replace a spotting scope in your pack, and how the upgraded HDX glass performs in low light.

programme.title: Public Land Beast! Bow Hunting Big Bulls with Brian Barney
programme.desc: Join Eastmans' Elevated podcast host Brian Barney on this Beyond the Grid episode to bow hunt elk in the rugged backcountry in pursuit of arrowing a bugling bull! This DIY bow hunt is packed with navigating new valleys, winter weather, and Brian's signature spot-and-stalk tactics. From glassing ridges at first light to heart-pounding moments with screaming bulls, this is elk hunting in the raw.

programme.title: Gnarly Iowa Archery Buck

programme.desc: We visit a friend in Kansas, chasing bobwhite quail among CRP, crops, and along woodlots.

programme.title: Fusion Well-Done
programme.desc: Cultures and cuisines unite on the griddle, blending spices, techniques, and traditions into bold, imaginative flavor fusions.

programme.title: Fusion Well-Done
programme.desc: Cultures and cuisines unite on the griddle, blending spices, techniques, and traditions into bold, imaginative flavor fusions.

programme.title: Panhandle of Florida Produces 187" MONSTER
programme.desc: In this episode we talk about the story of this 187 inch whitetail taken in the panhandle of Florida. With it being the first year that Jacob Combs, hunted this deer, the story is still absolutely remarkable, considering the location it was taken!

programme.title: Newbie's Lament
programme.desc: A Take Your Friend Hunting sweepstakes winner and his buddy join us at Ravenwood Lodge in Kansas, where head-high CRP, hardwoods and harvested crops hold hard-flying ringnecks - and a young shorthair gets her education.

programme.title: Turkey Tactics with Mark Drury
programme.desc: Mark Drury is one of the biggest names in turkey hunting and he sits down with host Todd Helms to dive into tips and tactics that will help you find more success in the turkey woods. Mark is more than just a turkey hunting machine, he's a great conversationalist and this episode is a fast-paced, fun listen that you'll want to replay over and over.

programme.title: Louisiana Sweeps
programme.desc: Jackie Bushman joins Troy and Jacob Landry in Louisiana with a local sweepstakes winner for swamp whitetails in warm weather.

programme.title: Indoor Archery
programme.desc: Buckmasters holds it's annual archery tournament in Alabama.

programme.title: Texas Sweeps - Buckmasters
programme.desc: Sweepstakes hunt in Texas at Montgomery Properties Ranch. Then Ed Welch with Millennium treestands hunts Alabama.

programme.title: Candletop
programme.desc: Join Willi on a Colorado Pronghorn hunt. Willi accumulated a lot of points over the years for this opportunity to hunt a limited draw area in Colorado. He takes a couple of days to check the area to see what's around and finds a very unique buck. He encounters a little twist before he can finally put his hands on bent-horned pronghorn.

programme.title: We almost lost our pintail! Duck Hunting | Wingmen by Eastmans' Hunting Journals
programme.desc: Go duck hunting with Todd Helms and his family. Jake Helms made sure hunting became a way of life for his sons, Todd and Scott. The guys get to relive childhood memories when they finally get the chance to all hunt together again. When Scott hammers a drake pintail another unforgettable memory is etched in the family photo album.

programme.title: Buckmasters rifle hunts Montana with Harris Hunts
programme.desc: Buckmasters takes a lucky sweepstakes winner to rifle hunt the river bottoms of Montana with Jacob Landry of Swamp People and Destry Harris of Harris Hunts. We tag along with some of the other hunters in camp that week as well

programme.title: The Last of the Water Towns
programme.desc: The DCD crew spends a day on the water fishing in an effort to complete the trifecta of a meat haul. Blake shows us where he spent much of his childhood and we get a glimpse of mother natures impact on community.

programme.title: Jacob Landry Tags a Tall-Tined Buck on the Yellowstone River in Montana
programme.desc: Every year, our Montana trips deliver - and this season was no exception. Usually, Jacob's tied up filming Swamp People for the History Channel and can't make it for archery season. But this year was different. With all his gator tags filled and a little time to spare, Jacob hit the banks of the Yellow Stone River in Montana for an unforgettable hunt. The Lord painted a perfect scene, and Jacob made the most of an incredible opportunity.

programme.title: El crimen del padre Memo
programme.desc: Es la tan esperada boda entre Toña y Brayan, pero Rocío le pide al padre Memo que sea él quien los case.

programme.title: Nunca digas de esta agua no beberé
programme.desc: Paco y Chío se despiden de Fran, quien vuelve a Estados Unidos. Paco tiene miedo de la soledad y toma una decisión que sorprende a todos.

programme.title: Volver al futuro
programme.desc: Los vecinos se quedan sin agua porque Germán no pagó el servicio. Además, tienen que arreglar algunas fugas de agua, pero Germán los convence de que mejor se compren una mesa de tenis de mesa.

programme.title: Intercambio escolar
programme.desc: Marco le pedirá a Alejandra que le falsifique su boleta a cambio de dinero. Magdalena al ver la boleta de su hijo, estará orgullosa y pensará en mandarlo a una de las mejores escuelas del país.

programme.title: Un héroe chapín
programme.desc: Los héroes no puedan entrar a los Estados Unidos para su presentación en Los Ángeles. Así que tratan de arreglar su situación y, al hacerlo, se descubren detalles del pasado de los héroes que nadie se esperaba.

programme.title: Motociclistas
programme.desc: Vítor quiere conquistar a una chica aficionada a las motos, por lo que convence a Albertano de formar una pandilla de motociclistas. La situación se complica cuando Vítor tiene que competir en una carrera contra el líder de la pandilla rival.

programme.title: Día del niño
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano deciden organizar un espectáculo de lucha libre en una escuela primaria y así compartir su buena fortuna con los niños, pero dos de los luchadores no llegan al evento y los guapos tienen que improvisar.

programme.title: Abuelo astuto
programme.desc: Don Arnoldo puede morir en cualquier momento y la familia López lo complace en todo lo que quiera. Pero el abuelo se entera de que su diagnóstico fue erróneo y no está dispuesto a renunciar a todas las atenciones que recibe.

programme.title: Cuando llegó el abuelo
programme.desc: Plácido echa a Don Arnoldo de la casa después de enterarse de que lo de su enfermedad era una mentira. Don Arnoldo desaparece, Plácido se siente muy mal por haberlo tratado así y recuerda los momentos que pasaron juntos.

programme.title: No habrá boda
programme.desc: Justo accede a que Gaby y Plutarco se casen, pero todo lo que pague de la boda se lo descontará a Plácido de su sueldo. Pero, ellos se enfadan y los López los ayudarán a reconciliarse y no quedar mal con Justo.

programme.title: La boda
programme.desc: Don Justo le obsequia a Plutarco unas argollas de matrimonio, pero las pierde. Plácido reprocha a su familia, su comportamiento en la boda de Plutarco y Gaby. En la luna de miel, a Plutarco le ocurre un accidente.

programme.title: El sueño angélico
programme.desc: María de Todos los Ángeles es una mujer que siente que se está haciendo vieja sin haber encontrado el amor de su vida. Ella tiene un sueño en el que los ángeles anuncian que pronto el amor de su vida va a llegar.

programme.title: El perro de los focos
programme.desc: María decide provocar un encuentro con Albertano para verlo directamente a los ojos y descubrir si es el amor de su vida. La vida de Albertano corre peligro y María se arriesga para salvarlo.

programme.title: El loco corte de pelo
programme.desc: Con la reunión de exalumnos de Federica a la vuelta de la esquina, ella se siente algo insegura por su apariencia. Entonces decide hacerse un arriesgado cambio de look.

programme.title: El genio bursátil
programme.desc: Ludovico se mete en problemas en el trabajo cuando trata de ayudar a Don Camerino en asuntos financieros. Tratando de resolver el desorden, Ludovico complica todo aún más, pero Junior lo ayudará a salir del problema.

programme.title: Welcome to ELEI
programme.desc: Los héroes llegan a Los Ángeles y piensan que su presentación va a ser en el estadio de los Dodgers. En realidad, son los invitados especiales del aniversario del mercado de East LA.

programme.desc: Vítor ha encontrado a la mujer de su vida y decide casarse con ella, pero Albertano hace todo por impedir esa boda, tras descubrir que ella es una peligrosa criminal.

programme.title: Sin dinero
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano se dan cuenta de que se han gastado todo su dinero. Ahora tienen que pedirle comida prestada a sus vecinos para poder sobrevivir.

programme.title: El papá de la nena
programme.desc: Los López preparan una fiesta sorpresa para La Nena. Carlos, el papá de La Nena reaparece inesperadamente y le cuenta cómo ha sido su vida.

programme.title: Martina y Ricky
programme.desc: Martina tiene su primer novio, pero las cosas se salen de control cuando se inventa una vida que no tiene y a su vez, él también tiene un secreto que no se imaginan.

programme.title: Cambio de cuerpos
programme.desc: Al tratar de arreglar la antena de la televisión, un rayo cae sobre los López, provocando que todos cambien de personalidad. Renata le pide ayuda a una curandera y Plácido descubre que todo era un sueño.

programme.title: Cambio de hábitos
programme.desc: A Renata se le ocurre desintoxicar a su familia, así que les informa que cambiarán sus hábitos alimenticios. Don Arnoldo escucha que La Nena ya tiene novio y aprovecha para chantajearla con comida.

programme.title: Los chiles de la discordia
programme.desc: Carmelo queda encerrado probando la alarma del negocio. María sueña que debe ganarse el corazón de Doña Lucha para conquistar a Albertano, y para eso prepara unos deliciosos chiles, aunque esto despierta un sentimiento de competencia.

programme.title: San Chambelán
programme.desc: María quiere celebrar su fiesta de quince años, pero para eso utiliza dinero que no es suyo. Doña Lucha entrena al Chino para ser chambelán. Albertano se ofrece a ser el chambelán de María.

programme.title: La Navidad perfecta
programme.desc: Ludovico sufre un infarto y muere. Santa Ninel le pide cambiar su forma de ser para antes de Navidad si no quiere morir. Ludovico hace todo por cambiar con su familia.

programme.title: Recuerdos
programme.desc: Ludovico habla de su familia: cuando conoció a Federica, cuando se enteró de que iba a ser padre y de otros graciosos momentos que han marcado su vida.

programme.desc: Paco recibe la visita de una ex quien le deja una bendición del pasado: se trata de Lucas, un hijo que él no sabía que tenía y que se queda a vivir en su casa a pesar de las protestas de Rocío.

programme.title: El niño espurio
programme.desc: Después de que Toña hace cuentas, Rocío descubre que Lucas es producto de una infidelidad porque aún andaba con Paco, así que le pide una prueba de paternidad para verificar que son padre e hijo.

programme.desc: Nena averigua que ella está embarazada.

programme.title: Amor de secundaria

programme.desc: Una amiga extranjera de Fran llega a pasar unos días al departamento, pero descubren que fue deportada de Estados Unidos. Sin embargo, crea una relación muy estrecha con Lucas.

programme.desc: Ludovico y Federica descubren que Martina y Fabio tienen una fiesta y se ofenden por no haberlos invitado. Federica y Ludovico interrumpen la cena de Martina y Fabio con sus nuevos amigos.

programme.title: Amor de secundaria
programme.desc: Paco consigue a un mudancero para llevarse las cosas de Rocío y casualmente se trata de Ismael, un exnovio de la Toña que, al reencontrarse con ella, reaviva la llama de la pasión y pone en riesgo su matrimonio.

programme.title: La deportada
programme.desc: Una amiga extranjera de Fran llega a pasar unos días al departamento, pero descubren que fue deportada de Estados Unidos. Sin embargo, crea una relación muy estrecha con Lucas.

programme.title: Un nuevo casting
programme.desc: Germán le pide a los vecinos que le den un aumento de sueldo, pero se lo niegan y decide renunciar. Lorena y Frankie están decididos a hacer todo lo posible para que Benito consiga actuar en un comercial.

programme.title: Sesiones espiritistas
programme.desc: Alejandra quiere ir a un concierto y necesita dinero por lo que decide iniciar un negocio de adivinación y esoterismo; Germán y Pedro deciden ayudar a Alejandra para que convenza a los vecinos que es adivina y así le den dinero.

programme.title: El exnovio de Doña Cuca
programme.desc: Dolida porque don Nacho olvidó su aniversario, doña Cuca inicia un romance con su exnovio el carnicero. Vítor y Albertano ayudan a don Nacho a recuperar el amor de doña Cuca.

programme.title: ¡Sálvese quien pueda!
programme.desc: Cuando su contrato con doña Olegaria está a punto de terminar, aparece Roger de los Santos, empresario que les propone manejarlos. A los héroes les encanta la idea, pero no quieren traicionar a doña Olegaria.

programme.title: Presuntos culpables
programme.desc: Doña Olegaria no puede competir contra Roger, así que se dividen la representación. La banda tiene una fecha en LA, pero ninguno de ellos puede entrar a EE.UU.

programme.title: Un héroe chapín
programme.desc: Los héroes no puedan entrar a los Estados Unidos para su presentación en Los Ángeles. Así que tratan de arreglar su situación y, al hacerlo, se descubren detalles del pasado de los héroes que nadie se esperaba.

programme.title: Welcome to ELEI
programme.desc: Los héroes llegan a Los Ángeles y piensan que su presentación va a ser en el estadio de los Dodgers. En realidad, son los invitados especiales del aniversario del mercado de East LA.

programme.title: Un mundo nos vigila
programme.desc: Los Héroes tienen que regresar por carretera a México. En el camino les roban la camioneta y los dejan tirados en el desierto donde son secuestrados por extraterrestres.

programme.title: El Chanfle
programme.desc: Chanfle Segundo es el utilero de un equipo de fútbol que, a fin de mejorar su situación económica, intenta vender una pistola para pagar los cuidados de su esposa embarazada. Debido a esto, se van creando divertidos enredos.

programme.title: Las travesuras del Chavo
programme.desc: Quico juega con sus amigos y hace que estos se sientan celosos cuando no les presta su globo. El Chavo se enfada porque no puede comprar un globo y termina pinchando el de sus amigos.

programme.title: El mozo revoltoso
programme.desc: El Mil Caras se fuga de la cárcel. Don Ramón se ofrece a pintar la vecindad a cambio de las rentas que debe, pero los niños provocarán un desastre jugando a los pintores.

programme.title: La enfermedad de la Chilindrina
programme.desc: La Chilindrina le hará una broma al Chavo. Los Caquitos son acusados de robar un bebé. Los niños le juegan una broma a Clotilde. Don Ramón tendrá que aguantar los berrinches de La Chilindrina, al no querer tomar su medicina.

programme.title: El sarampión
programme.desc: Chespirito, el Metichito, desenmascara sin querer a Shory frente a sus dos novias. Para evitar pagar el alquiler, don Ramón inventa que la Chilindrina tiene sarampión, pero por mentiroso, todos los inquilinos pagarán las consecuencias.

programme.title: El Chanfle II
programme.desc: El más extraño de los fanáticos del balompié, se ve envuelto en muchos enredos a causa de su honestidad.

programme.title: El huerfanito de la lotería
programme.desc: A Chespirito lo mandan por un huérfanito de lotería y creará una confusión entre su patrón y la novia.
